reviews.title: Much noisier than advertised - 65 decibels - but cleans well
reviews.body: The product description says the noise level when running at maximum speed is 50 decibels. I used a sound meter (with no other noise in the room) and found the actual noise level is 65 decibels. That's false advertising in my opinion. I had to move more than 12 feet away before the noise level dropped to 50. The other fan speeds are much quieter and sleep mode is basically silent, but that means the fan is not pulling much air through the filter so the air quality in the room dropped greatly overnight. It cleans well at the higher speeds and the phone app was easy to use.

reviews.title: Clean Design, Strong Performance, and Decent App
reviews.body: The Blueair 311i Max has been a great addition to our bedroom and has dramatically helped air quality having pets and as someone with typical seasonal allergies. Setup was easy and intuitive, and connecting it to the app was straightforward. The design is modern and clean, so it blends into the room instead of looking bulky or industrial. If you are researching air purifiers, it is important to understand how coverage ratings work. The large square footage number is typically based on running the unit at maximum speed and achieving roughly one air change per hour. In practical use, most people run these at lower speeds for noise and filter longevity. For meaningful air cleaning, around 4 air changes per hour is commonly recommended, and if you are more sensitive to allergens you may want even more. These units are designed to clean a room, not an entire home, so sizing appropriately is key. In day to day use, this model performs very well for particulate matter (PM) like dust, pollen, smoke particles, and general airborne debris. Auto mode responds quickly to PM spikes and adjusts fan speed accordingly. On lower speeds it is very quiet and unobtrusive in a bedroom. At higher speeds you will hear airflow, but it is smooth and not harsh. What is nice is that it has a power loss recovery where it will return to its last set mode when power is restored in case of a power outage. One thing that really stood out to me is how much dust, hair, and other allergens the pre-filter alone traps. It is honestly a little shocking and really puts into perspective how important a quality filtration system is. Even with consistent pre-filter maintenance, when I eventually replaced the main filter it was clearly very dirty with trapped particulate matter. That alone justified the investment. For maintenance, you can vacuum the worst of the trapped debris off the fabric pre-filter, but a proper wash is really recommended. Just slip it off, wash it, let it air dry or gently tumble on low, and put it back on. The app will remind you about filter life and maintenance, including pre-filter cleaning, which is helpful. When it was time for replacement, I switched from the standard filter to the Allergen version. I have been happy with its performance, although I did not notice a dramatic difference compared to the standard filter. Moving forward, I may go back to the regular filter depending on availability and cost. Blueair also offers a SmokeBlock option with a higher carbon density if VOC/ odor control is more of a priority. It is worth noting that this unit focuses primarily on particulate filtration. While it will help somewhat with Volatile Organic Compounds (VOCs) over time, serious VOC removal requires a significant amount of carbon or carbon zeolite media, which brands like Austin Air are known for. Something I am considering in adding to further improve home air quality. The app is well done and practical. It shows general PM trends, logs spikes, and allows manual control. Being able to adjust it from bed is a nice convenience. It has an auto mode, night (turns off less) and then 3 manual fan speeds as selectable options on the device. App will provide you with some additional timers options, smart location options to turn device off and on when you leave the home etc and gives a little more granularity to the fan speeds allowing you to dial in a speed that you like. I don't use these all I will usually leave it on Auto or manually set a speed. Overall, if you size it correctly for your space and expectations, this is a well-built, effective room purifier. It looks good, runs quietly, is easy to maintain, and delivers strong particulate performance. I would definitely recommend it for bedrooms or medium-sized living spaces where clean air matters. I am very happy with this purchase!

reviews.title: Excellent air purifier
reviews.body: I purchased this air purifier to supplement a larger Blueair unit (211i MAX) have for cleaning the majority of our 1171 sq ft condo. This purifier sits in the main hallway to cover areas the larger Blueair unit does not. The setup was fast out of the box. Wi-Fi is enabled, so it was just a case of adding it to my BlueAir app on my phone and connecting it to my home network. The device provides detailed air quality readings on the app and can be programmed for on/off schedules, display brightness and air filter life; the latter is important to know when deciding to reorder new filters. Maintenance is quite easy: each month, I vacuum the outer pre-filter and open the unit (turn power off) to vacuum the filter chamber. The app will advise if the pre-filter needs cleaning. There is a geofence option [called 'Welcome Home', to turn the purifier off if you are away at least 3 km and turn it on within the radius. The unit is well-made and does the job and why I purchased a second unit.

reviews.title: Love our little air droid
reviews.body: My husband has seasonal and dust allergies, and suffers with some pretty considerable symptoms every day, year round, and this brand was highly recommended. I'm glad I chose the 311i Max model which can clean a much larger space, such as one floor of our house. My husband experienced an immediate improvement in his symptoms. The app is helpful. I love being able to track particle levels in our home, and it's amazing how closely my husband's symptoms track with the pollutant levels it displays. I see big spikes on the app display whenever our air conditioner kicks in - then my husband's symptoms gets really bad for a little while until the air clears. So the app display helped us understand that we need our vents cleaned. I'm not sure I love auto mode. I've got to watch it more closely for a while to be sure, but I don't know if it really speeds up the fan fast enough when there's a spike in indoor pollutants. Overall I love it though. It's improved our lives. There's so much less sniffling, sneezing, coughing, and watery eyes. We now drag this thing to our bedroom every night, and to our main living space every morning, so I'll keep an eye out for a good sale and likely get a second one.

reviews.title: Game changer.
reviews.body: I only just got this yesterday and used it last night for the first time but I feel compelled to write a quick review already. This thing is a game. changer. Ever since moving to Texas, I suffer from terrible seasonal allergies. I never have in my life until now (turns out I'm allergic to a handful of trees that are native around here. Fun.) Some years are worse than others but this year is baaad. For the past few weeks my mornings have had me waking up congested and unable to breathe, blowing wads of snot out of my nose (sorry!), and with a itchy/scratchy sore throat. First thing I do is take an allergy pill and wait in misery until it finally seems to kick in around mid morning. (I've had a terrible time finding meds that work too. It just sucks.) I don't know why I never thought to get an air purifier. I guess when I thought of air purifiers I'd always think of the fancy Dyson ones that cost hundreds of dollars. I mean, puh-lease. Not happening. Then I found this little guy. Had great reviews, was the perfect little size for our master bedroom (216sqft), and reasonably priced with reasonably priced replacement filters. In a plee of desperation I talked my husband into us trying it. It got in yesterday (quicker than expected, yay!). I immediately unboxed it upon getting home from work and plugged it in. It says you only need to run it for about 15-20 minutes on high to cycle the room but I set that little baby on high with a two hour timer and let it run. When it was time for bed, I set the 6 hour timer on sleep mode. The sleep mode is great. It's a lot more quiet than I expected. I still expected to be able to hear a little white noise from it (which doesn't bother me at all) but unless I lift my head off the pillow and really listen, I can only just baaarely hear it. And I have it on my side of the bed about 3 feet away. Our home air system is louder than it on sleep mode. If you enjoy white noise, you could probably just run it on low and be fine. It has a button to turn off the indicator lights at night too so you don't have bright lights keeping you awake if that's a problem for you. Anyway, I woke up this morning with NO allergy symptoms. None. No congestion, absolutely clear nasal passages, and NO sore throat at all! I'm blown away. I'll try to come back and revise this review if my opinion changes but after the first night and the relief I was FINALLY able to feel from my allergies this morning I absolutely rate this thing 5 stars. Worth every penny!

reviews.title: So far so good
reviews.body: Bought one for my mom and one for my sister in law. Good thing I bought it for my sister in law because a couple months later the devastating wildfire in the Palisades of Los Angeles happened. So the entire LA county was full of smoke. Hopefully it helped but I'm not entirely sure how well it cleans the air because the amount of air that gets pushed out the top is not as forceful as my own air filters at home. My decades old Hunter air purifier has a ton more air flow it's almost like a high power fan. But I think it is able to move so much air because it doesn't have a pre-filter like all the new air purifiers use. It just uses replaceable HEPA filters and I know it works because I see all the dust it catches in the filter before I have to replace it. As for the Levoit it has a pre-filter which catches most of the dust and dirt but you never know how much actually gets through to the actual HEPA filter. I recommend the Levoit for smaller bedrooms, it's too small to do anything in a large room. At least it's fairly quiet on the lowest and middle setting.

reviews.body: Edit to original review: it’s been several months at this point and I have two in our small farmhouse. They work amazing, best purchase we’ve made. So far: it’s perfect, surpassed all expectations, ALL. Backstory: we’re living in a house from the late 1800s, that has been dormant for about ten years until we moved in a couple years ago. We have five pets, four cats which are strictly indoor and use an automatic litter box (Popur S7 which does great for the smell, it can only do so much though) and one fat, lazy, stinky pitbull. The house is musky, it’s old, it had way too much mold in the detached basement when we moved in. And the pets? They stink bad too, this is coming from someone who is very particular about the house smelling good. The litter box is horrible, the dog is gross, the house is old. I went searching for an air purifier, I’ve been wanting the SHARK never change, but couldn’t break down and buy it for $300. Didn’t try it out, can’t say if it’s good or not. While I was looking at reviews, I found the shark had only 5,000 reviews on Amazon, and it was at 4.3 stars. Okay, that’s not too bad. But this Levoit one had over 100,000 reviews and 4.8 stars. That’s nuts in comparison. I done a lot of looking on Reddit and found that the shark wasn’t even mentioned in the majority of good quality reviews, so I disregarded it. This specific one happened to be in budget and also has amazing reviews. We received it last night and set it up this morning, yep this morning, in our cat’s litter box room which is also unfortunately our closet. That room is the worst room of the house in my opinion. It’s been running for about 6 hours and I already notice a huge impact. It’s easier to breath, the air doesn’t feel so heavy, and the litter box is nonexistent, even right after they use it. Hubby sprayed cologne on himself and not 20 seconds later I walked in and it was gone, already sucked away. I put a box fan on it to help circulation and have it on 3. I’m buying another. Maybe two more. If I remember I’ll come back and review again when it gets a little later in the month. We’re leaving for vacation next Monday, so I’m curious how it will hold up against the cats stagnant litter box, which usually stinks pretty bad when we get home after a week. TLDR; Amazing for pet odor, amazing for muskiness. Perfect and worth every penny.

reviews.title: Use daily in our home!
reviews.body: We have 2 in our house and looking to purchase a 3rd. Love these things! Ours run all the time and after a couple of years are still going strong! I've recommended them to quite a few people. I can't attest to any personal allergy relief since my immediate family doesn't really suffer from much (maybe due to the purifiers) but I do feel a peace of mind having them in our home, especially with pets! Does a great job to trap dust and debris. I am always very surprised to find how much these things pick up when I check/change the filter. I also appreciate the white noise that it gives off. We do run ours on the 3 setting most days and it provides a nice background noise, which is a personal preference for my family. There are 2 other lower settings which are much much quieter. The purifier is easy to use and easy to maintain (filters can be a pricey). I will actually clean the filter a few times before purchasing new and have found that works great for us and saves an extra buck. We have two white ones and find that they look nice and blend in well with the rooms they are placed in. One of the purifiers is in a space between the living room and kitchen area (most traffic and use) and the other is near our home office and entry. I feel that they do a good job for the space size. Would definitely recommend!

reviews.title: A lifesaver in wildfire season.
reviews.body: Impressive. It is whisper quiet, and extremely effective. I’ve been sick all week from the wildfire smoke in the Denver area. I happened to be talking to a friend on the phone when I received my LEVOIT air purifier. I set it up while we chatted and within half an hour I could tell that the air quality had improved. I was breathing easier and my friend said she could hear it in my voice - it wasn’t as rough and nasally. It says it is for a room up to 222 square feet, but it is portable (under 10 lbs), about the size of a wastebasket, it plugs in to a regular outlet, and I can physically only be in one room at a time. It cleared the air so quickly that I can probably manage with just the one for the rest of the wildfire season. But it was very cost-effective, under $100, so I may go ahead and get another one for the kitchen next week. (I am a senior on a fixed income, but this is a necessity if I want to be able to breathe in my own house when the air quality outside is so bad.)

reviews.title: Levoit Air Purifier Home Allergies, Asthma
reviews.body: I love the Levoit Air Purifier! It is very quiet all of the time, but if you use the night time sleep mode, you can just barely hear it at all. The fan has three speeds as well as the sleep mode. You can set the sleep mode for up to 8 hours, the best I remember. I do use sleep mode but not with the timer. You can turn off the display panel and I do that at night because I prefer a totally dark room. I run it all day on low and so far, a week out from getting it and setting it up, there are no signs of anything that needs to be cleaned from the outside as I've seen in other reviews. I don't have any pets, just nasty carpet. I call it nasty, because all carpet is nasty to me. I dislike carpet so much! I don't have a choice, though. I think the filter is supposed to last around six months, so we shall see. I bought a replacement filter when I bought the purifier and several filters for the humidifier, as well. It looks like I may have to change the Humidifier filter once a week as a week out, it is starting to turn brownish-yellow around the top of it. I don't smoke and do try to keep an extremely clean place, so not sure what the discoloration is. I'm the only one who has ever lived here. I use distilled water but also bought the demineralization kit and extra filters for the humidifier in case I run out of distilled water and have to use tap water. I clean the humidifier every day. It's not hard to do once you do it. I love the modern look and it is built very well. It's really not hard to use at all. I believe it is super effective combined with my also Levoit Humidifier. I have them on opposite sides of my small bedroom as I couldn't put my humidifier under the smoke alarm. My skin feels much softer and cleaner using the both of them. I could instantly tell a difference in how well I could breathe using the them. As before purchasing them, I couldn't breathe out of my nose at all. The humidity is brutal here. I have been able to get the humidity down to 58, which is something the local meteorologist said couldn't happen in these heatwave temperatures! Ha! I only use GENUINE LEVOIT filters and they're a bit more costly, but I prefer to use the real deal and have less problems/headaches. It can be a bit catchy to find them on Amazon and the generic ones keep popping up; however, I went straight to the Levoit store to get the genuine ones. Blessed to be able to somewhat better control my Asthma and all-season Allergies with the help of these two awesome products! Thank you, Amazon and Levoit! Sorry for combining reviews but I need to do a copy and paste for the humidifier as it will save me time doing it this way.

reviews.title: Fingers crossed this helps my allergic dog!
reviews.body: I got this air purifier for my bedroom. My dog has a very severe dust mite allergy. He was literally disintegrating. His hair was falling out and his dandruff was like a blizzard. He had full body yeast and it smelled like a dirty gym sock on steroids. Despite having no carpet, rugs and bedding that are washed weekly, and dust mite covers on both of our beds, he was still miserable. He is so allergic that out of desperation I'm trying everything I possibly can to minimize his exposure while his immunotherapy does its job. The vet said that short of having hospital level air purification I would never get rid of all the dust mites, but I can limit his exposure with air purifiers, so we are giving it a try. There's no way I can accurately gauge how much this air purifier is reducing the dust mites, but it has to be better than it was before I got it. My dog gets 3 medicated baths a week and is about to start immunotherapy, so I can't really credit any progress to the air purifier alone, but there is no doubt it will help reduce the total number of dust mites he is exposed to. I also got a larger air purifier for my living room/kitchen. I live in a camper currently as I recently moved and am building a home. Since we live in cramped quarters with less ventilation than a sticks and bricks home, the dust mites and other allergens are far more concentrated. I've noticed since having these two purifiers running that our home smells fresher and cleaner, any smells do not linger. I've tried my hardest to deep clean any dust collected around the house in all the little nooks and crannies that you can't see and hopefully the purifiers will help keep that to a minimum. For some reason even in the dead of winter we seem to have a lot of dust. Again, probably because the space is so small. It seems the smaller the space, the bigger the mess! Thankfully it doesn't take as long to clean a smaller space. I'm not sure if I'll ever really know how effective these are, but I can say I've noticed a big difference since I got them in the quality of the air. We have wood heat so there's not a furnace constantly blowing air around. They provide air flow in what used to be pretty stagnant areas in the winter when the a/c isn't running. The stinky sock yeasty dog smell has been reduced quite a bit, and any other lingering smells like cooking or flatulence from my gassy teenager don't tend to hang around as long lol. So they have been a win-win! They seem to work very well. I don't use the timer features because I let them both run 24/7, but it's nice to have that as an option if it's ever needed. I really appreciate the small footprint of this purifier because there's not much room in a camper. I have it on my bedside table. You can see in the picture about how big it is next to my 40oz swig. Even on high it's very quiet, but I'm one of those "can't sleep without a fan" people so I enjoy the sound lol. Between this and the fan at the foot of my bed pushing air towards it, our air in the bedroom ought to be squeaky clean!

reviews.title: Awesome air purifier
reviews.body: Excellent Compact Air Purifier for Small Spaces 5.0 out of 5 stars Compact, Efficient, and Quiet – A Game-Changer for Allergy Sufferers I’ve been using the Levoit Core 300 Air Purifier for about two months now in my 200 sq. ft. bedroom, and it’s exceeded my expectations in every way. As someone who deals with seasonal allergies and pet dander from my cat, I was looking for an affordable, reliable solution to improve indoor air quality without breaking the bank or taking up too much space. After researching options, I settled on this model, and I’m thrilled with the results. The setup was incredibly straightforward – just unbox, remove the plastic from the filter, plug it in, and you’re good to go. The design is sleek and modern, with a cylindrical shape that fits neatly on a nightstand or floor corner without dominating the room. At around 8.7 inches in diameter and 14.2 inches tall, it’s compact enough for apartments or offices, yet powerful for its size. Key features include a 3-stage filtration system: a pre-filter for larger particles like dust and hair, a True HEPA filter that captures 99.97% of airborne particles as small as 0.3 microns (think pollen, mold spores, and fine dust), and an activated carbon filter to tackle odors, smoke, and VOCs. It has three fan speeds plus a sleep mode that dims the lights and runs ultra-quietly at just 24dB – quieter than a whisper, making it perfect for nighttime use. There’s also a timer (2/4/6/8 hours) and a display lock to prevent accidental changes. In terms of performance, this little unit punches above its weight. It refreshes the air in a 219 sq. ft. room up to 5 times per hour on high speed, according to the specs. I tested it during a smoky day from nearby wildfires, and within an hour, the air felt noticeably fresher – no lingering smells or stuffiness. reviews.title: Piccolo e silenzioso
reviews.body: È piccolo, perciò non ci si può aspettare miracoli, ma se vengono rispettate le indicazioni del produttore utilizzandolo in stanze delle adeguate dimensioni, lavora benissimo, e purifica l'aria correttamente. Tutto sembra essere costruito con ottima qualità: plastiche, incastri, motore ventola ecc... Perfino il filtro sembra essere ben costruito e di qualità superiore rispetto ad altri della stessa fascia di prezzo. Ha una regolazione di 3 velocità delle quali solo la massima è rumorosa ma non molto fastidiosa, infatti la velocità intermedia è appena udibile (pari ad un soffio) e mai fastidiosa anche stando nelle vicinanze. Alla prima velocità è praticamente impossibile udire qualcosa e questo è un pregio ENORME rispetto ad altri purificatori in commercio della stessa categoria. Questa velocità si presta benissimo per il riposo notturno. Nessun ronzio o rumore. Questo, forse, credo sia possibile anche grazie al motore/ventola in corrente continua, infatti il purificatore viene fornito di un piccolo alimentatore che si trova nella confezione. In essa vengono forniti anche 3 "feltri" per la diffusione delle essenze naturali da inserire in un apposito cassetto laterale quasi invisibile. Nel complesso quindi un ottimo purificatore poco ingombrante, con un buon rapporto qualità prezzo e soprattutto poco rumoroso e che vale la pena acquistare.
reviews.body_en: It is small, so miracles cannot be expected, but if the manufacturer's instructions are respected by using it in rooms of adequate size, it works very well, and purifies the air correctly. Everything seems to be built with excellent quality: plastics, joints, fan motor etc... Even the filter seems to be well built and of higher quality than others in the same price range. It has a 3-speed adjustment of which only the maximum is noisy but not very annoying, in fact the intermediate speed is barely audible (equal to a breath) and never annoying even if you are nearby. At first speed it is practically impossible to hear anything and this is a HUGE advantage compared to other purifiers on the market in the same category. This speed is perfect for night sleep. No hum or noise. This, perhaps, I believe is also possible thanks to the direct current motor/fan, in fact the purifier is supplied with a small power supply which is found in the package. It also includes 3 "felts" for the diffusion of natural essences to be inserted in a special almost invisible side drawer. Overall therefore an excellent, compact purifier, with a good quality/price ratio and above all not very noisy and worth buying.

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.body: I previously owned one purifier, an AIRROMI purifier. I kept it near the litter box because phew my cats can be stinky. Unfortunately, one of my cats recently started showing symptoms of asthma. And hearing those attacks he has is honestly extremely scary, knowing I cannot offer him direct relief. So I made the decision to get a second purifier, a bigger one this time. But not just one, I got THREE! Maybe a little over kill but I want to ensure my cat is OKAY! I have had them for about a month and there has been ZERO asthma attacks from my cat. So it is fair to say that all the bad allergens in the air have been going straight to the filter. My boyfriend works in HVAC and he said the HEPA filter combined with the activated charcoal works great for catching particles and allergens. I have yet to open it up to see the damage; the purifier has an alert that will show up on the control panel, letting you know when it is time to change the filter. I will come back and update with pictures once I change the filter on at least one of the purifiers. There is about 3 modes on the purifier, Automatic, Speed 1, 2, 3 and Pet mode. Automatic is hardly detectable in terms of noise. Pet mode and the highest mode are very loud though. I don’t mind the white noise, so I could sleep with it no problem, others might have a problem. As for looks, I think she is really pretty! I absolutely love the reader on the front that determines the air quality, all of ours sit at a range of either 5-7. I very interestingly found that my purifier in my room almost hit 400 after a hot shower, and it did not go down, the numbers fluctuated between 150-350. I unplugged it and then it read 005 again…not sure what that was about, but it only happened once, so I did not think much of it.

reviews.title: Perfect for elderly parent with pets
reviews.body: I bought this for my mom. My siblings don’t visit her because they claimed pet hair/dander was severely triggering their allergies. I thought they were making it up because I personally never had any kind of reaction. Well, I recently I went to visit Mom for a few hours as I normally do, and the trifecta of dust, dander, and pet hair hit me like a ton of bricks. For 3 days, I was having coughing fits, wheezing, and my eyes were itchy and felt like there was dust in them 24/7. My mom already has COPD and frequently complains about being short of breath, so realizing that she was casually breathing all of this in 24/7 completely freaked me OUT. That said, I went on the search for an air purifier and ended up pulling the trigger on this one and can finally report on well it works. Even though at first my mom wasn’t happy that I spent money and bought this for her, after I set it up, she allowed me to leave it running on high if it meant there could be a chance that it might make her air quality suitable for my siblings start visiting again. Well, 6 weeks later, I was able to convince my siblings to come with me to mom’s house to visit for Christmas because now there she has a good air purifier. Upon entering my mom’s house with my family, the first thing I noticed immediately was how much lighter the air way. Before this filter, the air was thick, heavy, and DUSTY. Afternoon light filtering through the blinds would reveal clouds of pet hair and dust particles swirling around like smoke. Now? Nothing! No dust in the air when sunshine is coming though the windows. The second thing I noticed was that the smell of litterbox went from 100% to 40-50%. My family had a wonderful, comfortable holiday visit with my Mom, they were shocked how much of a difference this machine made. No one had any of their allergies triggered. YAY!! My mom, who originally wanted to hate this machine, finally confessed that she’s breathing a lot better lately & believes that it’s due to this machine improving her air. She leaves it running on auto now, when she cooks, it kicks into high gear until the numbers go down. She loves it a lot. Highly recommend this machine.

reviews.title: Buy it Now
reviews.body: I had been struggling with terrible allergies in my home, so I bought this air purifier on an impulse after reading reviews. I’m honestly so glad I did because the difference has been incredible. Setup was unbelievably easy. All I had to do was take it out of the box, remove the plastic wrapping from the filter, plug in the power cord, and turn it on. Within the first night, the air quality reading dropped from 159 to under 20, which really impressed me. The biggest thing I noticed was how much fresher and cleaner my home felt almost immediately. I could actually tell a difference in the air quality, especially when waking up in the morning. It’s also surprisingly quiet, even when running for long periods of time, so it doesn’t disturb sleep or everyday activities. Update after over a month of use: this has honestly been one of the best purchases I’ve made for my home. The improvement with my allergies was night and day. I used to constantly wake up congested and sneezing, and now my symptoms are so much more manageable. My house gets less dusty which makes less sweeping and dusting. My favorite feature is the automatic mode. It adjusts the fan speed on its own depending on the air quality, which is so convenient. I especially notice it when we’re cooking dinner — the purifier automatically ramps up to a higher setting while the air quality changes, then lowers itself again once everything is back to normal. I also appreciate that it works so effectively without needing constant adjustments or attention from me. It has become one of those appliances I barely think about anymore because it just quietly does its job in the background. Looking back, I only wish I had purchased it sooner.

reviews.title: El purificador que comprar si no se necesita automatizar
reviews.body: Compré uno de diseño similar hace tiempo y me agradó mucho, opté por este secundario porque tiene lo mismo menos la conexión a wifi lo cual no es sumamente necesario si estás seguido en casa. La verdad la potencia del ventilador me impresionó, por cuanto aire alcanza a mover. Tengo perros y traen mucho polvo y pelos, es fascinante como el modo automático logra prender el ventilador a alta potencia en cuanto entran y se sacuden, la tierra que tiene es una acumulación de mes y medio, a pesar de estar algo tapado sigue logrando mover y limpiar bastante aire. Solo me gustaría que el cable fuera más largo para no tener que usar una extensión o que tuviera algo para colgarse.
reviews.body_en: I bought one with a similar design a long time ago and I really liked it, I opted for this secondary one because it has the same thing except the Wi-Fi connection, which is not extremely necessary if you are often at home. The truth is that the power of the fan impressed me, because of how much air it can move. I have dogs and they bring a lot of dust and hair, it is fascinating how the automatic mode manages to turn on the fan at high power as soon as they enter and shake it off, the dirt it has is an accumulation of a month and a half, despite being somewhat covered it still manages to move and clean a lot of air. I just wish the cord was longer so I didn't have to use an extension cord or had something to hang on to it.

It does its best work in one room, but I have noticed that the room its in has less dust. Ive also noticed it is a little if a deoderizor, which is great for someone who has a sensitive nose. Overall, yes its a little expensive upfront but the design of it, the quality of its work, and being able to finally sleep through the night is priceless. I dont know about its longevity but I did buy a very small and older version from this manufacturer 3 years ago and its still going.

reviews.title: Quiet, Smart, and Effective for Bedrooms
reviews.body: I've been using the Levoit 200S-P in a bedroom, and it's been a great balance of performance, noise level, and convenience. Setup took just a few minutes, and pairing it with the VeSync app was straightforward. I like being able to check the air quality, adjust the fan speed, create schedules, and turn it on before I get home. Auto mode works well and usually keeps the fan quiet unless it detects a noticeable change in air quality. It's nice when I'm cooking and the lights will blink red indicating the air quality has changed and it will kick on high speed. For everyday use, it's very quiet on the lower settings, making it easy to sleep with. On the highest speed it moves a lot more air, but as expected it's much louder. I typically leave it in Auto mode and rarely have to adjust it. The filter has done a good job reducing dust and everyday odors in the room. While no air purifier can eliminate every smell instantly, I've noticed the room feels fresher, and there's less dust settling on furniture over time. It's also very easy to clean. A few things to keep in mind: replacement filters aren't the cheapest, and this unit is best suited for bedrooms or other smaller spaces. If you're trying to clean the air in a large open living area, you'll probably want to step up to a larger model like the Core 400S or 600S. Overall, if you're looking for a reliable, easy-to-use smart air purifier for a bedroom or office, I'd recommend the Levoit 200S-P. It's quiet, simple to maintain, and has performed exactly as I hoped.

reviews.title: Fresher Air

I've already cleaned off the front and the screen twice in two weeks, so that shows it working, but I still have some dust and hair floating around just not quite as bad, however I did shave my long thick hair coated dog and that helped alot! From the reviews I expected more out of this, my allergies haven't changed I'm still congested and use meds for that, but I also have various food allergies. I put this unit in a high traffic area and center of living room and kitchen. I've noticed my TV doesn't have near as much dust and hair accumulation on the screen. For the price it's okay, it doesn't compare to the real expensive ones perhaps, but it does help.

reviews.title: No es True HEPA certificado, sensor de pésima calidad, publicidad engañosa
reviews.body: Pros: - Disminuye un poco el polvo en la habitación Contras: - No sirve para los 1875 pies cuadrados (174m2) que indica en su publicidad. En efectos prácticos sólo sirve para 388 pies cuadrados (36m2) como lo indica en la última foto la publicación. Se requieren más de cuatro cambios de aire por hora para que un filtro de aire sea efectivo y esa cantidad sólo la alcanza en un cuarto de 36m2 y a MÁXIMA VELOCIDAD (punto importante). - Sólo es grado HEPA a MÍNIMA VELOCIDAD. Lo pueden consultar en la página oficial del producto. No es un filtro HEPA certificado. Incluso quitaron la leyenda de filtro HEPA del propio filtro, como se observa en la imagen. Los obligaron a remover algo que, básicamente, era falsa publicidad. - A MÁXIMA VELOCIDAD además de no ser HEPA fácilmente alcanza 60db de ruido, más menos, como se escucha en el video. Es extremadamente silencioso en primera velocidad para dormir, pero en tercera y cuarta no es para que estés dentro del mismo cuarto. - El sensor siempre esta en azul, calidad de aire "óptima". Aún encerrándolo en un cuarto donde hay moho es incapaz de detectar dichas partículas. Sólo se pone en rojo cuando barres el cuarto dónde se encuentra el filtro, sólo detecta partículas verdaderamente grandes. Ni al cocinar frente a él baja la "calidad del aire", aún si se te está quemando la comida. Así que el modo automático básicamente no sirve de mucho. Esto contando que el sensor se limpió y calibró como se indica en las instrucciones. Casi casi tienes que encender y apagar un cerillo frente al sensor para que detecte el humo y la luz pase de azul a roja. - Trae muy poco carbón, si tu problema es olores, te vas a consumir este filtro en semanas o pocos meses, no en 1 año. - Plástico barato de muy mala calidad. El panel se rayó a la primera pasada de una tela de microfibra. En las fotos se ven detalles de lo barato que se ven todos los materiales
reviews.body_en: Pros: - It reduces the dust in the room a little. Cons: - It is not suitable for the 1875 square feet (174m2) that it indicates in its advertising. In practical terms it only serves 388 square feet (36m2) as indicated in the last photo of the publication. More than four air changes per hour are required for an air filter to be effective and that amount is only achieved in a 36m2 room and at MAXIMUM SPEED (important point). - It is only HEPA grade at MINIMUM SPEED. You can check it on the official product page. It is not a certified HEPA filter. They even removed the HEPA filter legend from the filter itself, as seen in the image. They were forced to remove something that was basically false advertising. - AT MAXIMUM SPEED, in addition to not being HEPA, it easily reaches 60db of noise, plus less, as heard in the video. It is extremely quiet in first gear for sleeping, but in third and fourth it is not for you to be in the same room. - The sensor is always blue, "optimal" air quality. Even if you lock it in a room where there is mold, it is unable to detect these particles. It only turns red when you sweep the room where the filter is located, it only detects really large particles. Even cooking in front of it does not lower the "air quality", even if your food is burning. So auto mode basically doesn't do much good. This is assuming that the sensor was cleaned and calibrated as indicated in the instructions. You almost have to turn a match on and off in front of the sensor for it to detect smoke and the light to go from blue to red. - It comes with very little carbon, if your problem is odors, you will use up this filter in weeks or a few months, not in 1 year. - Cheap plastic of very poor quality. The panel was scratched on the first pass of a microfiber cloth. In the photos you can see details of how cheap all the materials look.

reviews.title: Reduces Allergy Symptoms, Quiet, & Convenient
reviews.body: I was waking up in the middle of my sleep because of my terrible allergy symptoms for the past few weeks (lots of sneezing, runny nose, watery eyes, itchy eyes/throat/ears) so I decided to get this for my bedroom. It has been a game changer! I started sneezing/watering/itching a LOT LESS since turning this on, and the air just feels a lot fresher now! I love it! The UX is great too! It's so convenient to be able to use your phone to control fan speed (you can choose 1 of 4 levels or do any % of max fan speed you want under the DIY mode), turn the interface lights on and off (great for keeping it dark at night to sleep), turn the purifier itself on/off, and keep track of what the air quality is like (there aren't numbers afaik but it gives you 4 levels of either very good, good, moderate, or bad and these show up as different colours of light on the ring around the power button of the machine as well), check how much filter life is left as a % (so far it seems to go down 1% per 3 days, which I guess should last about 300 days). As for noise, it is super quiet on levels 1 & 2. I can't even hear it from across the room! Levels 3 & 4 are definitely audible across the room, but not terribly bothersome. I sometimes like the white noise. I'd recommend it! (So far at least; I've only had this for 3 days so I'll update if anything happens) Edit: Just had the forest fire smoke drape our city with opaque yellowish-brown skies. The air purifier helped some during the day, but now the smell is seeping into my apartment. It’s a bit better in my bedroom where the air purifier is, but I can definitely smell that burning smell now. I will also note that the sensor says the air quality is “Very Good” though the graph has dipped a little. From what I remember reading, there are 2 types of air quality sensors (IR and laser) and the one this unit has is not as accurate. We had some of the worst air quality in the world for parts of the day and it’s saying it’s “Very Good” which is a huge stretch… All this to say, don’t trust what it says about the air quality.

reviews.title: Great filter for the air, bad sound for your ears
reviews.body: I really liked this Dreo Air Purifier when I first started using it. It cleared the air well and pulled up a lot of pet hair. The air felt fresher and cleaner too. Unfortunately, the fan started with a very low, grating sound which over the course of a couple weeks became louder and louder to the point I could even hear it above my TV and it was so annoying I had to turn the Dreo off when I was in the room, or put it on sleep mode. The sound was high pitched, metal on metal. I tried putting it on sleep mode and it definitely quieted down. The next morning, I put it back on auto and it was ok. However, when I came home from work, the loud grating sound was in full annoying screeching mode. I turned it off and set up my return. I ordered a different brand which works to clean the air, yet doesn't clean up the pet fur like the Dreo. Maybe I should have tried a second Dreo yet I was concerned the grating sound was an issue with this product as I had read a couple other reveiws with that stated the same problem. So the functionality of this air filter is definitely 5 star, yet the sound quality is a 1. Hopefully Dreo fixes the sound problem because this is a great air filter. I would be willing to try it again at some point.

reviews.title: Amazing! Color coded display on the front helps a lot! Best I've ever had. App is great too!
reviews.body: This air purifier has been amazing in my basement! I have cat litter down there, so having something constantly cleaning the air has made a noticeable difference. I leave it running on Auto most of the time and let it do its job. Its got a really nice LARGE display on the front….it gives real-time look at the air quality instead of just running silently and leaving me guessing. The color indicator is also a nice touch. A quick glance tells me how the air is doing. You want it to be blue which is best setting. We had incense sticks burning upstairs, and I could see the purifier detect a change in the air. It was pretty cool watching the readings react as the air changed! It makes the air monitor feel much more useful than just having one that sits there! The Auto mode has been my favorite. I don't have to adjust the fan. It can respond to changes in the air and handle the fan speed on its own. I can leave it running while I'm doing other stuff and not worry about it. The app works really well too. I can check the air quality from my phone and see what is happening without walking over to it. The controls are easy to understand, and I like having the extra information available through the app. Getting everything connected was easy. I created an account, sat beside it, and synced it with the app. No issues whatsoever. The design also looks great. It has a modern appearance and doesn't look out of place in my basement. The display gives it a high-tech feel too. I can leave it running without it becoming the main sound in the room….honestly its running right now and I cant hear a thing. On turbo mode its abit louder, but that’s to be expected. I really like having the air quality information right in front of me. Ive had many air filters before and none had this….between readings, color indicator, Auto mode, and phone app, there are plenty of ways to keep an eye on the air. The filter viewing window is also handy for checking its condition. Its super large and the whole front is clear so you don’t even have to open the device to see what shape your in.. For my basement, this has been an amazing addition. It reacts to changes in the air, and I can monitor everything from my phone. It looks modern, works easily, and has become something I just leave running in the background. Definitely one of my favorite home devices! I would highly recommend to anybody!

reviews.title: Affordable and effective for dust and allergens
reviews.body: We moved into an incredibly dusty townhouse, I have terrible allergies, and we discovered our neighbors are chain smokers. We now have 3 Levoit air purifiers in our home: Vital 100 (non-smart version), Core Mini and Vital 200S. I initially bought the Vital 100 and put it in our bedroom because I have terrible allergies. It collected a ton of dust and helped a lot with the allergies. I thought I didn't need the smart version but in hindsight the availability of specialty filters and the remote control would be very helpful. It's relatively quiet although on high it's too noisy for me to sleep with. I absolutely love that you can turn the all the control lights off. We tried using this for the cigarette smell but it wasn't very effective except when the smell was very light. It did completely abolish cooking smells though. If I could go back in time I would have ordered the 100S instead but this one works fine. The smoke smell from the neighbors comes into our house through the laundry room which is a very small room. I bought the Core Mini to try to combat it. The Core Mini doesn't really do much to get rid of smells and was definitely overwhelmed by the smoke so now we move it around the house now when the pollen level is high. It works ok for dust and allergens but the range isn't great; you need to be right next to it to notice a difference. On low and medium speed it's barely audible and high is relatively quiet but overall the fan isn't very powerful. The lights on this one automatically turn off after a few seconds making it bedroom friendly. If I could do it again, I would have skipped this one and bought one of the larger ones sooner. Lastly, in an attempt to mitigate the smoke coming from next door, we got the big boi Vital 200S with the add on smoke specialty filter. So far it isn't able to remove the smell while they're smoking but it does cut down the severity and will clear it eventually provided the source stops for long enough. It's amazingly quiet on the lower speeds. It's pretty loud on the higher speeds but the fan moves a ton of air around. I'm disappointed that the auto mode doesn't detect the smoke smell but I can use the app to turn it to high speed as soon as I smell it. You don't have to use the app but it's really easy to set up and connect. The app allows you to set schedules which is really handy and as I touched on earlier, it works as a remote control. As with the others, you're able to turn the lights off completely so it's good for bedrooms. We've only had this running a few days but I'm pretty impressed with what it can do.

reviews.title: Great small sized air purifier that does some heavy lifting
reviews.body: I got this air purifier for my bedroom as my sleep can be disturbed by air quality pretty easily. I was highly skeptical of this product at first as the price point to me indicated that it might be cheap in terms of quality of the product but so far it has been pretty impressive. On even the lowest setting, it has substantially improved the air quality not just in the bedroom but in the adjoining room so we're looking at space of about 200-300 square feet or so. I would say I can breathe easier at night with it and my comfort level while sleeping has increased a bit. The air after it's been running for a bit smells and just seems fresher and I am considering getting a second one to see if it can handle a much larger area. Noise is pretty low on it's lowest "normal" setting and the night mode feature drops the noise to almost silent, but not quite. At it's lowest setting, there is an odd whine, for lack of better words that can just barely be heard. This whine was an annoyance at first but you get used to and can ignore it. It still works well on the lowest setting to keep the room fresh so it's a good deal. Setup was easy as can physically, however I cannot as yet speak to the application setup as I haven't gotten to that. I treat air purifiers as non-smart devices but I do plan to at least try to integrate it with Home Assistant and if that doesn't work I may try integration with Amazon Alexa. I'll update the review when that happens. Durability of the purifier long term is unknown, though the filters do seem very easy to replace and their price point does make them economical enough to justify getting a filter instead of replacing the entire air purifier. Summary: Good, powerful little air purifier that can sit on a dresser or nightstand, relatively quiet with some caveats. Long term durability is unknown but still was a good buy overall.

reviews.title: 1000% RECOMMEND!
reviews.body: I bought this purifier because I really wanted one that I could turn on from my phone while laying in bed, since I am completely blind in the dark due to my vision impairment, and I don't necessarily have anywhere to place this type of electronic near my bed that was the major deal breaker for me. This air purifier is about the size of a PS5, but a little more convenient due to the cylinidrical shape of it. The app set up is easy and it allows you to auto order a new filter through the app via a scheduled set up. I have mine set up for every 6 months and you can tell the difference between the 2 filters after those 6 months.... the app also will tell you the life on your filter left and will tell you the air quality/ pollen count outside of your home. All the modes do exactly as they say and the sleep mode is ultra quiet which is nice. I've been using this air purifier for almost 2 years now and it is still working great. You can immidetly tell when you take it out of the box that it is a good high quality purifier and not a purifier where they say its high quality and after a week it stops working... My last purifier was lmof a lower quality and stopped working with-in a year, but also I paid $50 for that one and I didn't have a dog at that time. It is so nice to have a higher quality purifier that works exactly as it says on the ads. The app also includes other Levoit electronics you can add to your account so you have all your Lwvoit products in one spot on your phone which I think is so mice and easy. The app is also really easy to use and to set up everything on, it looks and feels very professional and easy which I really enjoy. I love opening up my app and seeing all my Levoit electronics in one spot, ready to turn on or off, or to change any mode it's on to something different. You can aslo set up a schedule of when you would like your devices to turn on and off and what mode to use whenbit does. The purifier has been so helpful with my allergies as it takes about 10 minutes for my severe allergy symptoms to begin subsiding a good amount after coming inside from walking the dog. To some 10 minutes may sound like a long time, but to someone with really really REALLY awful allergies 10 minutes is well worth the wait... Also, the air suction is powerful enough where I have to wipe I'm purifier down with a clean and dry paper towel to get some dog hair off of the sides where the air flows into the machine. It's also kept the infamous "dog smell" from settling in my room. I highly recommend this purifier it's great and if/when this one goes, I will definitly be purchasing another Levoit brand...

reviews.title: Skeptical About Used? This Changed My Mind
reviews.body: I chose the Amazon box option mainly so I could check whether the item shipped safely and arrived without damage to the outer packaging. The Amazon box itself arrived in good condition, but the Core 200S-P’s box was damaged, likely because it had not been handled carefully during a previous shipment. Since I bought it in Used – Acceptable condition, I inspected the purifier carefully. I found no issues with the unit itself. It came with what appears to be a new filter, had no strange smell, and works perfectly, just like my other Core 300S-P, which I recently bought new. I also bought a second unit in Used – Good condition. The only thing I noticed was a black scuff mark on the bottom of the purifier, as shown in the pictures, but it does not look like actual damage. The box for that one also appeared to have been damaged during a previous shipment. From my experience buying used items on Amazon, that seems fairly common, and it is probably one reason the price is lower when the manufacturer’s box is damaged. I ran it for an hour on level 3, the highest fan speed and it seems to be working perfectly. Afterward, the room smelled cleaner and felt easier to breathe in. I also found no visual issues. After comparing it side by side with the Core 300S-P, I honestly think the Core 200S-P is a better fit for bedrooms, while the Core 300S-P is better suited for larger rooms. Overall, it was definitely a steal at $53.36 for both of the units and I’m very satisfied with this purchase. 🙏 Update after 2 weeks: I’ve just check the filters it also surprising picks up more than just dust, it picks up tiny mosquito!!! 🦟 we have left the living room sliding door open because of the renovation so this is proof to be a life saving from these annoying little pest

reviews.title: Surprisingly effective — glad I stuck with it
reviews.body: This was my first time ever using an air purifier, so I was pretty skeptical even after reading all the good reviews. The first few days were honestly a little discouraging because my bedroom still smelled kind of funky. I live in an older house, and getting certain smells out of the rooms has been a big priority while I finish setting everything up. But after about a week, the difference became really noticeable. Now it’s actually refreshing to walk into my room. I’m really glad I didn’t give up on it early. I also share my bedroom with a Husky, and there’s no dog smell anymore — which is huge. The fan is pretty quiet, and even when I turn it up, the sound is kind of soothing. It actually reminds me of the ocean waves from my trip to Ormond, FL, which is a nice little bonus. The filters are easy to insert and remove (I haven’t had to replace mine yet, but I tested it out just to see), and the whole unit feels simple and user‑friendly. Overall, very happy with this purifier. It took a little time, but it absolutely did its job.

reviews.title: Indispensable.
reviews.body: Je ne sais pas par où commencer, mais en tout cas, je suis super satisfait. L'appareil a un joli design et on sent la qualité. Sur l'écran tactile, il y a tout ce qu'il faut. Ce que j'adore, c'est le fait qu'il soit connecté à l'application. Elle est vraiment super simple et complète sans en faire trop. On peut voir sur les photos qu'il est indiqué quand il faut changer le filtre (par exemple, il affiche 100 % quand il est neuf) ; on peut donc suivre son état d'usure au fur et à mesure. En plus, juste en dessous, tout est prévu : 1. Il y a un lien « acheter le filtre » 2. Ce lien vous redirige directement sur Amazon 3. Le filtre coûte actuellement 25 €, ce qui n'est pas trop cher puisqu'il faut le changer tous les 3 à 6 mois C'est vraiment bien pensé. La notice est en français, mais j'avoue qu'on n'en a pas vraiment besoin car tout est expliqué étape par étape dans l'application. L'appareil dispose de 3 modes : 1. Mode silencieux 2. Mode moyen 3. Mode fort : utile pour purifier une pièce rapidement (pendant une demi-heure par exemple) avant de baisser la puissance. En mode fort, le ventilateur s'entend forcément assez fort, mais c'est pour l'efficacité. En mode moyen ou silencieux, on ne l'entend presque plus. Il y a même un mode veilleuse (on peut le voir sur une de mes photos) qui diffuse une petite lumière la nuit. On peut également désactiver tous les voyants si c'est gênant, par exemple dans une chambre d'enfant. Pour l'instant, je suis très satisfait et je recommande mon achat.

What I love is the fact that it's connected to the app. It's really super simple and complete without overdoing it. We can see in the photos that it is indicated when to change the filter (for example, it displays 100% when it is new); we can therefore monitor its state of wear as it progresses. In addition, just below, everything is planned: 1. There is a “buy the filter” link 2. This link redirects you directly to Amazon 3. The filter currently costs €25, which is not too expensive since you have to change it every 3 to 6 months It’s really well thought out. The instructions are in French, but I admit that we don't really need it because everything is explained step by step in the application. The device has 3 modes: 1. Silent mode 2. Medium mode 3. Strong mode: useful for purifying a room quickly (for half an hour for example) before lowering the power. In strong mode, the fan is obviously quite loud, but that's for efficiency. In medium or silent mode, you can almost no longer hear it. There is even a night light mode (you can see it in one of my photos) which emits a little light at night. You can also deactivate all the lights if it is annoying, for example in a child's bedroom. For now, I am very satisfied and I recommend my purchase.

reviews.title: Excelente
reviews.body: El producto llegó a tiempo y en buen estado. Aunque el manual viene en inglés, es súper sencillo hacer el montaje y encenderlo. Tener la app en el celular hace más fácil controlarlo y pude conectarlo con Alexa sin ningún problema, además de que en la app te avisan el tiempo de vida que tiene el filtro, para poder monitorearlo y cambiarlo cuando sea necesario. El purificador me ha funcionado muy bien, tiene 3 niveles, el más alto es el más ruidoso aunque no es molesto, muy parecido al ruido generado por un ventilador, el modo para dormir es una maravilla, prácticamente no se escucha nada y puedes programar a qué hora se apaga lo que me parece muy práctico. Cuando llegó lo encendí en la recámara y una hora después ya notaba la diferencia en el aire, tengo alergias y sentía el aire más fresco para respirar y dormí muy a gusto sin estornudos ni tos. El filtro lo limpié con la aspiradora y fue muy sencillo, aunque no se elimina todo el polvo que se acumula, si se lleva gran parte lo que sin duda ayuda a que dure y filtre mejor por más tiempo. Sí lo recomiendo, cumple bien su función y no considero que el precio sea excesivo.
reviews.body_en: The product arrived on time and in good condition. Although the manual comes in English, it is super easy to assemble and turn it on. Having the app on your cell phone makes it easier to control it and I was able to connect it with Alexa without any problem, plus the app notifies you of the filter's lifespan, so you can monitor it and change it when necessary. The purifier has worked very well for me, it has 3 levels, the highest is the loudest although it is not annoying, very similar to the noise generated by a fan, the sleep mode is wonderful, you practically cannot hear anything and you can program what time it turns off which I find very practical. When it arrived I turned it on in the bedroom and an hour later I could already notice the difference in the air, I have allergies and the air felt fresher to breathe and I slept very comfortably without sneezing or coughing. I cleaned the filter with the vacuum cleaner and it was very easy, although it does not eliminate all the dust that accumulates, it does remove a large part of it which undoubtedly helps it last and filter better for longer. Yes, I recommend it, it does its job well and I don't consider the price to be excessive.

reviews.title: Makes a noticeable difference!
reviews.body: When my elderly cat (18 this summer! Cat tax included in review) was diagnosed with asthma, it meant that all three of us who live in my apartment (my husband and I plus cat) all have some sort of allergy or respiratory issues from different things. I've always had allergies to things like dust and pollen, and my husband had recently developed a cough and post nasal drip that the doctor could find no particular cause of. I happened to be browsing on Prime Day after looking into air purifiers and got this one for a very affordable 60 bucks. The reviews said it worked great just out of the package and setup was easy, and they were right. No assembly, nothing to fuss with. Just remove the plastic from the filter, pop it back in and plug it in. The difference was noticeable very quickly. Husband has basically stopped coughing and his post nasal drip has reduced significantly. I also noticed he isn't snoring anywhere near as loudly as he was before. My own allergy symptoms have alleviated; my sinuses used to feel stuffy which made it harder to fall asleep, but that's basically solved. My own post nasal drip has also noticeably improved. Even my cat's asthma noises have improved. I'm sort of shocked to encounter a product that actually noticeably solves a problem. Shortly after buying it, I had a small fire in my oven. Everything was okay, but the smoke was obviously a problem. I decided to put the air purifier on the counter to see what the number went up to- 130! But about an hour later, the number on the panel read about 10 or 12, and the normal range for my apartment is between 5-17. It has a sleep setting, but we keep it on 1 during the night because it's so quiet. I like to keep it on 2 during the day because it's still just light background humming. One thing I thought was nice is that there's a QR code on the side of it to link you to the correct filters to buy when you need to replace them. However, out of all the things that could actually use an app, it doesn't have one. It could be nice to have a really simple one that records the PM number so you could have an idea of the air quality patterns in your home. At the same time, it's refreshing that it doesn't have one lol My apartment is 1,300 square feet so technically this little guy should be making some difference on the whole thing, but it might be better to have it in a more central location for that; I like it in the bedroom though, since it's made such a difference in our symptoms that were impacting our sleep, and my cat mostly stays in the bedroom so it just makes sense for us. 10/10, really happy with it!

I've had other air purifiers no difference on sound.

reviews.title: Registers air quality and adjusts fan accordingly
reviews.body: This machine automatically senses changes in air quality and adjusts the fan accordingly. Tried it in various rooms where our air quality varied between 8 and 20 and the fan stayed on low, however it turned to full and the red light came on when the wok started to smoke! (I can’t recall what number it registered this to be as I was impressed at the light and fan speed!) Not tried this overnight on sleep mode as the air quality has been good, though the low fan speed isn’t obtrusive so can’t imagine it disturbing sleep. I can imagine this will be great for the damp weather, new furniture smell removal cleaning and dusting days and also spring pollens. The carbon filter pieces had space between them so I googled if that was normal and apparently it is, as small molecules bounce around before getting trapped. I have bought the same model again for a family member with allergies and asthma, after buying two smaller models and finding fault with both.

reviews.title: Good purifier with a company that cares
reviews.body: This air purifier has its pluses and minuses, I bought this because, I have a small bedroom that has poor ventilation and needed something to help with air quality in that room. On the plus side, it is quiet, you can minimize the light on it, and the filters are easy to find and replace. However, my main problem is all the little ventilation holes around the base are nearly impossible to clean. After my first attempt at the review the company has since reached out to me and offered some cleaning solutions. They said “ We recommend gently cleaning them with a soft, dry cloth. If needed, a slightly damp cloth can be used, but please ensure the unit is unplugged and completely dry before turning it back on.”the second minus is the filters can be pricey, however, they are slightly pricey for me. They are do run at a cheaper price than most others major companies out there. The company also reached out to me and offered me a couple of free filters to get me by so they really do care. It is not a horrible air purifier I just wish they would have designed the outside a bit differently. However, I do appreciate there a company that listens to their consumer ,and really wants to change things. It’s not that often that companies do that, so if you’re looking for an air purifier that works from a company who really does care this is the one for you.

reviews.title: Great app, small and quiet, love the pre-filter

The app is actually fantastic and very easy to use. Love that Alexa connects and helps me change up settings and that has been flawless. The auto functions works beautifully, as I can watch the device change color and change settings according to air quality. If I blow out a candle, spray perfumes or leave my bedroom door open I can see it work in real time. There is still some dust that settles in my bedroom but overall the air smells so much better. I live in brick ranch built in the 60's and a lot of the building materials, including tile and cabinets are original. I also live in the hot and humid Deep South so that combo is not great in the summer. This really gets rid of the damp and musty smells. I have a ton of an allergies and this really helps me sleep at night. Very pleased and just bought a second one for another bedroom.

reviews.title: Amazing, wish I had gotten one sooner. Much better than average air filters.
reviews.body: I have had several air filters over the years and have always been slightly disappointed with them and unsure of whether or not they are truly helping. After doing a lot of house cleaning and dusting, I wanted something to help maintain cleaner air so I tried this. I can honestly say this is one of those rare semi life changing purchases. I immediately noticed a marked change in my indoor air quality as a long time allergy sufferer and being sensitive to smoke, pollen and other contaminants. The change was much more significant compared to other air filters I have tried. I keep mine on the medium setting and run it 24 hours a day. It's surprisingly quiet and the subtle noise doesn't bother me at all when reading or watching tv, I actually prefer it as a source of white noise. I can breathe and sleep so much better now and it also heavily reduces odors from cooking. It's so good that I bought another one for a separate room. I also like the extra features like pet mode, the air quality sensor, and smart device features. The air sensor is surprisingly accurate and changes if I dust or clean nearby or cook something a little smokey. I haven't tried the app and smart features yet but they're nice to have as an option. The filter is very easy to set up and I haven't had to replace it yet. Truly cannot recommend it enough.

reviews.title: Great Purifier to Help Daughter with Dog Allergies
reviews.body: We got this air purifier after our daughter was diagnosed with dog allergies. We do have a golden doodle and while our daughter doesn't have strong allergic reactions to our doodle (she does to other shedding dogs) the allergist recommended we get one for her room. We put this purifier in our daughters room and leave the door closed at all times. While hard to truly measure its effectiveness, her room doesn't have dust settle on furniture like the rest of the house and her ceiling fan doesn't collect dust like others, or at least at a MUCH slower rate. Love the ability to lock the screen so she cant mess with the settings. The purifier runs very quiet and in sleep mode you can barely tell its on. Love that the lights on the display turn off when it's dark in the room. For the price I am very impressed with its performance. It is not too big but cant exactly be hidden easily. Fortunately it looks nice and is not too industrial looking. We've had it for almost a year now and have had no issues at all. The filters seem very high quality and although a little expensive, the the filters do last a while. Overall we have been very impressed with its cleaning ability, different mode settings and features, quietness, and would say its fairly inexpensive for all that. We just ordered the 200S to put in the main living area.

Love the ability to lock the screen so she cant mess with the settings. The purifier runs very quiet and in sleep mode you can barely tell its on. Love that the lights on the display turn off when it's dark in the room. For the price I am very impressed with its performance. It is not too big but cant exactly be hidden easily. Fortunately it looks nice and is not too industrial looking. We've had it for almost a year now and have had no issues at all. The filters seem very high quality and although a little expensive, the the filters do last a while. Overall we have been very impressed with its cleaning ability, different mode settings and features, quietness, and would say its fairly inexpensive for all that. We just ordered the 200S to put in the main living area.

reviews.title: A Breath of Fresh Air — Literally
reviews.body: I'll be honest, I wasn't sure how much of a difference an air purifier would actually make, but this one proved me wrong almost immediately. The build quality alone tells you this is a serious piece of kit — it feels solid and well-made, not like something that's going to fall apart after a few months of use. What really won me over, though, is that you can genuinely feel the difference in the air. It's hard to describe until you experience it yourself, but the room just feels cleaner and fresher after it's been running for a while. Setup was a breeze — no complicated instructions or frustrating app configuration. I had it up and running in minutes, and scheduling it to fit my routine was just as straightforward. One of my favorite things about this purifier is how quiet it is. Some units sound like a small jet engine no matter what mode they're on, but this one operates at a level where you can easily forget it's even there. No constant background hum disrupting conversations, sleep, or focus. The auto mode is a standout feature. It intelligently ramps up the fan speed when it detects a drop in air quality, then gradually winds itself back down once the air is clear again. It's the kind of smart, hands-off functionality that makes you wonder how you managed without it. You're not babysitting settings it just handles itself. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a reliable, quiet, and genuinely effective air purifier.

reviews.title: It's doing a very good job for me.
reviews.body: Update to my previous comments: It's been 2 years since I purchased the Vital 100S and it has worked very well for me. Until ... I just purchased a replacement filter for the unit this month. I considered buying the knockoff filters because they were significantly cheaper than the Levoit replacements. The only reason I went with the Levoit branded replacement filter was because it looked like it included the washable pre filter. I specifically wanted another pre filter as a backup in case something happened to the one that came with the unit. They are not flimsy, but neither are they invincible! What if I tear it, or lose it, or my dog eats it (which could absolutely happen!) ? The knockoff brands made it very clear in their product descriptions that the pre filter was NOT included with the replacement filter. However, the product description for the Levoit replacement filter uses phrases like "3 in 1", "washable pre filter", and the pictures of the product show the pre filter and DO NOT specify that it isn't included. I am very disappointed with this order and Levoit's shoddy advertising. And I want a spare pre filter, but it seems I can't find one for love nor money! I bought the Vital 100S. Like many reviewers of this product, I purchased it because the wildfire smoke had infiltrated my house. I never ever thought that I would be "that" person - someone who needed their own atmosphere! But the irritation in my nose and throat motivated me to buy this unit for my well-being. The reasons I chose this model are: the true HEPA, of course! Also the 3-stage filter. The CADR was good for the size of my rooms (I have open concept on the main floor, and a vaulted ceiling upstairs) the pre-filter is cleanable and I like the fact that I can also get specialized filters for Pet, Toxin and Smoke (in case things get really crazy!). The reviews are excellent and the price is right. I am seriously considering buying another of Levoit's units for the upstairs! I have not used any of the "connected" features so I cannot comment on those. The unit is easy to unpack and I was able to start using it immediately. It is very presentable; it's also light enough to be portable because I've been moving it from room to room (when the wind shifts sometimes the smoke comes into a different part of the house). It's super easy to use; I love the control panel, you just tap on it to turn it on, set the fan strength, and activate the timer. The first 2 fan settings are so quiet that I can barely hear that the unit is on. The third setting is a little louder but it IS moving a lot of air after all! I've only had it 2 weeks so haven't had to clean it or change the filter. One thing I didn't consider thoroughly was the placement of the unit. In order to work properly any air purifier needs to be kind of in the middle of things. Proper placement of an air purifier is between 3 and 5 feet off the ground, with about 3 feet of open space around it. Luckily, the 100S fits well with my decor and is light enough to put on a table or my bookshelves. I was worried that it might vibrate a lot and eventually shake itself off the table but it's staying put quite well. So far, I am very satisfied with this purchase.
