reviews.title: Nice Instant Pot With a Couple of Drawbacks
reviews.body: PROS: 1) Aesthetically pleasing appearance in my upgraded light kitchen, much prettier than my other black and stainless Instant Pots. Even the panel is mostly white. Color is a soft white or very light off white, not stark white which I was hoping for. 2) Much quieter than my other 3 and 6 quart Instant Pots. No loud obnoxious beeps. 3) The release button is on the front of the lid rather than next to the pressure release spout making it much much safer to use. 4) The glass lid from my 6 quart Instant Pot unit fits this container so they are interchangeable. A huge plus since the unit doesn’t come with a cover for refrigeration. 5) I love the wider shorter bowl which makes it easier to cook and serve. 6) I like that it has both high and low temperature settings for Slow Cook unlike my 3 quart Instant Pot. CONS: 1) Cord is cheap and flimsy, nothing like the more substantial 3 pronged cord on my other Instant Pot units. This was a huge downgrade. And it’s black, an eyesore on this otherwise very pretty unit. Should have used a better quality white cord. I’m purchasing a sleeve for it. 2) Electric Cord is not detachable like with my other Instant Pot units so you can’t replace it in case you want something longer or shorter or better quality or just want to remove it for storage. 3) You can’t purchase additional replacement containers in this size and shape which I was able to do with my other Instant Pot units. Hopefully they’ll eventually manufacture them. But in the meantime the one container is all I have. 4) The Pressure Cook/Steam settings have only one temperature unlike my other stainless Instant Pot units which had both low and high options. I consider this a rather significant downgrade. After using it several times and judging by how long it takes to heat up, cook, and depressurize the temp seems to be high. Disappointing as I always used the low temp setting before. Overall I like the RIO except for the cord and that I can’t buy extra containers. So far it’s working well. I’ve already made soup, pasta, and rice which came out perfect.

reviews.title: Nice Instant Pot With a Couple of Drawbacks
reviews.body: PROS: 1) Aesthetically pleasing appearance in my upgraded light kitchen, much prettier than my other black and stainless Instant Pots. Even the panel is mostly white. Color is a soft white or very light off white, not stark white which I was hoping for. 2) Much quieter than my other 3 and 6 quart Instant Pots. No loud obnoxious beeps. 3) The release button is on the front of the lid rather than next to the pressure release spout making it much much safer to use. 4) The glass lid from my 6 quart Instant Pot unit fits this container so they are interchangeable. A huge plus since the unit doesn’t come with a cover for refrigeration. 5) I love the wider shorter bowl which makes it easier to cook and serve. 6) I like that it has both high and low temperature settings for Slow Cook unlike my 3 quart Instant Pot. CONS: 1) Cord is cheap and flimsy, nothing like the more substantial 3 pronged cord on my other Instant Pot units. This was a huge downgrade. And it’s black, an eyesore on this otherwise very pretty unit. Should have used a better quality white cord. I’m purchasing a sleeve for it. 2) Electric Cord is not detachable like with my other Instant Pot units so you can’t replace it in case you want something longer or shorter or better quality or just want to remove it for storage. 3) You can’t purchase additional replacement containers in this size and shape which I was able to do with my other Instant Pot units. Hopefully they’ll eventually manufacture them. But in the meantime the one container is all I have. 4) The Pressure Cook/Steam settings have only one temperature unlike my other stainless Instant Pot units which had both low and high options. I consider this a rather significant downgrade. After using it several times and judging by how long it takes to heat up, cook, and depressurize the temp seems to be high. Disappointing as I always used the low temp setting before. Overall I like the RIO except for the cord and that I can’t buy extra containers. So far it’s working well. I’ve already made soup, pasta, and rice which came out perfect.

reviews.title: Makes cooking easy & foolproof
reviews.body: I’m relatively new to using the Instant Pot, but so far I love it. It makes cooking beans so much easier. It’s super functional, especially during times when you forget to lay out meat to thaw earlier in the day and feel pressed on timing. You can stick dry beans and frozen meat right in for cooking instead of having to wait hours to soak or thaw. I will say I wouldn’t rely completely on it being the “faster” option though simply because it does take a significant amount of time to depressurize, especially when it comes to food like soups where there’s a large quantity of liquid. I have a household of 4 and it’s great for us, though sometimes I do wish it had more room, but during my research I learned that the bigger Instant Pots take even more time to come to pressure and to depressurize so I just went with the 6 quart option and I’m satisfied with it. It is hard to remove the smells off of the inner ring when cleaning so definitely follow the instructions for using one inner ring for sweets and the other for savory foods (it does come with 2 rings). I’m not the best cook, but this allows me to cook way more things that I otherwise wouldn’t even attempt on my own because this kind of makes it a foolproof process.

reviews.title: Defective Lid Design - Don't waste your $$$
reviews.body: I purchased this large instant pot because we like to make bone broth and others students and soups and so I bought the biggest one I could find. Thinking that instant pot would be easy to use was a huge mistake. I cannot get past the installing the lid to perform a test run. This is a poorly designed system. You need to fiddle with this large red O-ring and get it to into the lid somehow I've done this about 15 times now and I'm able to get it in there so that when you turn the lid upside down the rings stays, but I can't get the lid to seal on the pot. The lid is impossible to push down by myself to lock and then trying to turn with a rubber, O-ring is not working at all. I think this is a huge design flaw, and this is not easy to use. I should just be able to open and close and not have to fiddle with this O-ring. I can't even get beyond the Test. I called the product support line. The one 800 customer service number listed here and they want me to send email photos of the product when it's brand new out of the box and there's no one that could talk me through tips and tricks of getting the top on. The customer support person hung up on me after putting me on hold and never call me back. They probably have too many complaints on this product. I would give this zero stars andreturn it if I could, but I think it's past the window so I guess this is going to be a donation because who has time to fiddle with this thing I've already spent hours trying to just steam water on the test. It's impossible. I am very experienced at using scientific instruments as a chemist, working in a lab and I figured an Instant pot in your kitchen should be something that ANYONE can do and I don't see how people are using this if I can't get it to work unless there's something defective with my unit.

reviews.title: Interesting Recipes, but Not a Strong Cookbook
reviews.body: I had a hard time deciding what to make of this book because I genuinely liked many of the recipes, but I do not think it works particularly well as a cookbook. The ebook version, at least, jumps into the recipes without much of an introduction or any meaningful explanation of Instant Pot cooking. Even if a cookbook is not specifically aimed at beginners, I still expect some basic guidance about the equipment, settings, timing, and common techniques. The recipes themselves are often appealing, but many are too simplified. They give you the basic idea without enough detail to make me feel confident that the finished dish will turn out exactly as intended. I appreciated that every recipe includes a picture, but the images did not work for me. Many look overly artificial, and some do not appear to match the actual recipe. For example, a recipe calling for a bone-in turkey breast is paired with an image that appears to show a boneless one. That kind of mismatch makes the visual guidance much less useful. What is missing most is personality. This feels like a collection of recipes rather than a thoughtfully constructed cookbook. There is very little context, technique, voice, or guidance to make it feel special. The saving grace is the recipes themselves. There is a surprisingly interesting range of dishes, and quite a few sound genuinely worth trying. That variety is what brought the book up to a middle rating for me. To be honest, parts of this cookbook frustrated me more than I expected, but there are still enough promising recipes here that I would try several of them.

reviews.title: Nice Instant Pot With a Couple of Drawbacks
reviews.body: PROS: 1) Aesthetically pleasing appearance in my upgraded light kitchen, much prettier than my other black and stainless Instant Pots. Even the panel is mostly white. Color is a soft white or very light off white, not stark white which I was hoping for. 2) Much quieter than my other 3 and 6 quart Instant Pots. No loud obnoxious beeps. 3) The release button is on the front of the lid rather than next to the pressure release spout making it much much safer to use. 4) The glass lid from my 6 quart Instant Pot unit fits this container so they are interchangeable. A huge plus since the unit doesn’t come with a cover for refrigeration. 5) I love the wider shorter bowl which makes it easier to cook and serve. 6) I like that it has both high and low temperature settings for Slow Cook unlike my 3 quart Instant Pot. CONS: 1) Cord is cheap and flimsy, nothing like the more substantial 3 pronged cord on my other Instant Pot units. This was a huge downgrade. And it’s black, an eyesore on this otherwise very pretty unit. Should have used a better quality white cord. I’m purchasing a sleeve for it. 2) Electric Cord is not detachable like with my other Instant Pot units so you can’t replace it in case you want something longer or shorter or better quality or just want to remove it for storage. 3) You can’t purchase additional replacement containers in this size and shape which I was able to do with my other Instant Pot units. Hopefully they’ll eventually manufacture them. But in the meantime the one container is all I have. 4) The Pressure Cook/Steam settings have only one temperature unlike my other stainless Instant Pot units which had both low and high options. I consider this a rather significant downgrade. After using it several times and judging by how long it takes to heat up, cook, and depressurize the temp seems to be high. Disappointing as I always used the low temp setting before. Overall I like the RIO except for the cord and that I can’t buy extra containers. So far it’s working well. I’ve already made soup, pasta, and rice which came out perfect.

reviews.title: Durable non-stick pot and features that other models at this price don't have
reviews.body: While this is a pretty standard pressure cooker for this price point, I chose this one because most don't have a sous vide function. Overall I am happy with it. I have a higher end brand at home, but purchased this during an extended stay with family and it's been perfect in that context. So far I have not noticed a big difference between this model and the name brand. In at least one respect, this model is better. The non-stick pot seems far more durable than the name brand. I haven't been careful with this pot, and in a few weeks of heavy use (like once a day), there's no discoloration or dinging through the non-stick coating. As noted, it has a sous vide function. Don't sleep on this, getting pre-marinated meat at the market and popping it in the water bath without even opening the packaging is incredibly nice; the meat turns out great, it's incredibly forgiving, and there's zero clean-up. It's particularly choice for dinner parties where everyone hangs out beforehand and you want to be able to serve hot food as soon as everyone sits down. Only down side compared to a standalone sous vide is that you're limited to the area of the pot (though the pot is big so it fits most jobs), and the time to heat the water is long compared to the standalone. A few minor quibbles: the yogurt function is not great.. There is no built-in boil function, so that must be done independently. I had been very happy with the name brand version, as there is very little scalding, which is the big down side of doing it stove-top. You can use the saute function to boil in this model, but you have to babysit it more. The non-stick pot does a pretty good job of avoiding scalding but I don't trust it enough to walk away like you can with other models. Given no boil feature, the Comfee basically holds the milk to the yogurt temperature. That means you have to have a thermometer to test the temp yourself prior to adding the cultures, or risk killing them. Other models self-regulate and let you know when you can add the cultures. You also cannot easily add time if you check the yogurt and it's still too runny. A minor issue, but a surprising one. I'll still use this to make yogurt, but I'm guessing the sous vide function is a better way to do the post-boiling steps. Second, the manual is pretty worthless. The model works like most pressure cookers, but the buttons are not quite consistent with other brands ("Level" is not the best choice of description). So, I wouldn't give this model to, e.g., my mother who's never used a pressure cooker before, as it would likely be too confusing. I'm a frequent user of other models and have been for years, and I even found it a little less clear than I'd like. On top of this, unlike name brands, there is no real quick start guide or recipe book. Not an issue for me, but might be for some. Third, the pressure valve is a little subtle and a little spitty(?) It always takes me a second to feel out which way is sealed and which is open, as the markings are faint and the rise between the two is subtle. Fancier models either make this really clear, or automatically seal when you close the lid. The valve on this feels very old school. And because the release is manual (turning the valve by hand rather than sliding a button, e.g.), it requires more care to quick release the pressure without burning yourself. The release spigot tends to spit a little, so I find I need to be very careful. On other models, I would trust my pre-teen kid to be able to use it without any worry, but for this model, I'd be worried they'd hurt themselves from carelessness. Finally, the choice of included extras is a little unusual: a rice cup (3/4 cup, as you'd get with a rice cooker), a rice paddle, a deep serving spoon, and a trivet. I didn't notice markings inside the bowl that show how much water you add per rice cup serving, so I'm not entirely sure why the rice cup. The rice paddle is an unexpected positive, though I suspect most people who are frequent rice eaters probably already have one that came with a rice cooker. Still, perhaps a good thing for college students or others who have limited space for small kitchen appliances who may actually use this as a rice cooker. I do like the included spoon, as I keep it in the pot when not in use and thus always have it for serving directly from the cooker. The fact that it's right there is a good way to never use metal on the non-stick surface. All that said, the durability of the pot is a much bigger deal than the minor negatives, all of which can be worked around. At this price point, the features and build seem on par with more expensive models, other than the throwback valve.

reviews.title: I guess I like kitchen gadgets now...
reviews.body: I was always pretty anti-kitchen gadgets. The InstantPot seemed like just another thing that did stuff I could already do on my stove or oven. Boy, was I wrong. I honestly am in disbelief how much I love using this thing. It is so versatile that I use it more than anything else in my kitchen, except maybe the sink. The reasons why? Well, for starters it’s super easy to clean. Instead of making a mess with multiple pans and pots and lids with food stuff splattering everywhere, the InstantPot is one thing that’s fully contained. When the timer ends I take out the food, clean the pot, and wipe down the lid and little “gutter” and that’s it. Two, it’s so FAST! Now, granted some things will feel like they take the same or similar amount of time when pressure cooking because the machine has to build pressure. BUT, the difference is that I can set this and LEAVE! When it’s ready it beeps and I can choose to keep the food warm or have it stop cooking when the timer is done. What really sold me on finally purchasing this is the air fryer attachment. I’ve been wanting an air fryer so this was much cheaper than buying everything separately. I will say that while I do love the air fryer it’s probably not the best on the market. When using a two-tiered basket, whatever is in the top portion *will* be more cooked than the bottom. This is a problem I will try to fix by simply removing the top portion when it’s cooked and letting the bottom cook longer until it’s done. Not ideal, but for delicious air fried food ans the convenience of having these capabilities from one machine at this price, I’ll make do. I recommend purchasing an InstantPot cookbook to accompany this. It will help acquaint you to how this machine can be used, even if the cookbook is more oriented towards one of the models without the air fryer. What do I use this for? So far I’ve made vegan chana masala (yum!), vegan banana bread (yum!), air fried Brussels sprouts (yum!), truffle fries (you get the idea). I’ve also used this to steam food to make dog food for my pup with allergies. One of my favorite things to use this for is dry goods!! I will dump a whole bag of dry beans or quinoa or whatever in the pot, add spices, water, set it, and it’s done to perfection so quickly! I’ll then can everything and freeze it so I have beans and quinoa on hand all the time whenever I need them for a meal! It’s the best! Not to mention the pressure cooker seems to really INFUSE whatever you’re cooking with the spices you choose. The beans I’ve made with this I’ve eaten plain they were so so tasty! I live with roommates but this has been the best purchase ever. I’m lucky to have the room to store it, but it’s also great because they can cook on the stove or in the oven if they want, and I have everything I need right in this InstantPot so no one has to wait on anyone to clear out before they can do their own thing. Things I wish it did differently: - I wish the display showed seconds. Minor inconvenience but the display in general makes it feel cheap. - I wish the display showed what setting it was on and what action it was currently doing. For example, a small icon for “pressure cooking” so you can remember that you chose the correct setting. Or a little icon that showed it was building pressure so you don’t think you didn’t hit “start” or something before waking away. Also, something that showed the current temperature inside instead of what you set it to so you know how things are cooking or heating up/cooling down. - A persistant beep every minute or so when food is finished cooking.

reviews.title: Multifunction kitchen device that works? This must be 2020...
reviews.body: Grabbed this on black friday promo as it saved on counter space combining instant pot and airfrier. Haven’t trued the dehydrator, but both of its primary functions work well. Makes better rice than American rice cookers, but so so compared to a Zojirushi. Thanksgiving was easier with this as it saved over space and made air fried potato skins the MVP casserole topping and brussel sprouts crisp. Cleaning the air fry lid might be difficult one day, but didn’t seem to need much the first few weeks of repeated use. Also has slow cooker capability. Importantly, the bucket is stainless steel, so no teflon flakes to give you cancer when it inevitably starts flaking off. The air fry basket may have a teflon coating though, so be careful with washing it and poking contents during mid cycle turns. The interface is clunky, but better than having bluetooth and an app that stops working after the latest ios release and makes the thing stop working altogether after an unwanted or failed firmware update pushed out to better steal your personal info and sell it to advertisers. PSA: “smart” speakers or fridges or tvs are not smart to buy, particularly if they have no “dumb” or disconnected capabilities. If you do buy a smart device and keep it airgapped (offline) don’t let it ever connect as devices denied updates for a time may brick themselves when first connected years later because they attempt to jump through too many updates simultaneously. This killed a grandparent’s walmart tv in good working order after being plugged into ethernet for the first time post relocation move as the manufacturer had never considered a user going from firmware v 1.1 to 4.1 in one jump rather than 1 to 2 to 3 to 4. (Steps off soapbox). Yeah, this thing is worth it despite breaking some of Alton Brown’s kitchen device rules. Replaced my crock pot, rice cooker, lack of dehydrator, and lack of airfrier. Don’t make popcorn in it unless testing your smoke alarm or trying to get guests out of your house. Shouldn’t have to say this, but don’t dishwasher the electric parts like the frier lid.

reviews.title: Excellent Deal!
reviews.body: I was on the fence about buying a pressure cooker but saw the potential utility of it seeing as I live in Arizona and the weather is warming up (too dang fast) and this could help prepare home cooked meal without turning on the oven or stove. I have ZERO regrets about purchasing this item. It has saved me time, money, and effort. I simply marinate animal protein the night before, take it out of the fridge when I get home from work, and put it in the pressure cooker as I wind down and relax a little after getting home. I cooked a whole soy sauce, garlic, and ginger marinated chicken in 29 mins. I paired it with rice made the night before and some microwave steamed broccoli. Definitely recommend this item to any and everyone!

reviews.title: Muy práctica, eficiente y totalmente recomendable.
reviews.body: La olla a presión eléctrica ha sido uno de esos electrodomésticos que realmente te hacen la vida más fácil en la cocina. Después de usarla varias veces, puedo decir que es una herramienta muy práctica, eficiente y sorprendentemente rápida para preparar comidas completas sin estar pendiente todo el tiempo. Lo primero que destaca es la facilidad de uso. Los controles son bastante intuitivos, con programas automáticos para diferentes tipos de alimentos como arroz, carnes, sopas o frijoles. Literalmente solo agregas los ingredientes, seleccionas el modo y la olla hace el resto. Esto ahorra mucho tiempo, especialmente en días ocupados. En cuanto al rendimiento, la presión cocina los alimentos mucho más rápido que los métodos tradicionales. Carnes que normalmente tardarían horas quedan suaves en menos de una hora, y los sabores se mantienen muy bien concentrados. También ayuda a ahorrar energía porque el tiempo de cocción es mucho menor. La seguridad es otro punto fuerte. Se nota que está diseñada con varios sistemas de protección, como cierre seguro de tapa y liberación controlada de presión, lo cual da tranquilidad al usarla incluso si no tienes mucha experiencia con este tipo de equipos. La limpieza también es bastante sencilla. La mayoría de las partes internas se pueden desmontar fácilmente y lavar sin complicaciones, lo cual siempre es un plus en la cocina diaria. En resumen, la olla a presión eléctrica es un excelente electrodoméstico para cualquier hogar. Ahorra tiempo, cocina bien y es muy fácil de usar. Ideal tanto para personas que cocinan a diario como para quienes quieren simplificar la preparación de comidas. Le doy 5 estrellas sin dudarlo.
reviews.body_en: The electric pressure cooker has been one of those appliances that really make your life easier in the kitchen. After using it several times, I can say that it is a very practical, efficient and surprisingly fast tool for preparing complete meals without having to worry about it all the time. The first thing that stands out is the ease of use. The controls are quite intuitive, with automatic programs for different types of foods such as rice, meats, soups or beans. You literally just add the ingredients, select the mode and the pot does the rest. This saves a lot of time, especially on busy days. In terms of performance, pressure cooks food much faster than traditional methods. Meats that would normally take hours become soft in less than an hour, and the flavors remain very well concentrated. It also helps save energy because the cooking time is much shorter. Security is another strong point. It is noted that it is designed with several protection systems, such as secure lid closure and controlled pressure release, which gives peace of mind when using it even if you do not have much experience with this type of equipment. Cleaning is also quite simple. Most of the internal parts can be easily disassembled and washed without complications, which is always a plus in everyday cooking. In short, the electric pressure cooker is a great appliance for any home. It saves time, cooks well and is very easy to use. Ideal for both people who cook daily and for those who want to simplify meal preparation. I give it 5 stars without hesitation.

reviews.title: Easy Instant Pot Meals
reviews.body: I’ve been using my Instant Pot more lately, so I was excited to check out The Latest Instant Pot Cookbook for Beginners by Dorothy Milburn. What I liked right away is that the recipes don’t feel intimidating, even if you’re still figuring out all those buttons and settings on the Instant Pot. The instructions are straightforward and easy to follow, which is exactly what I need on busy days. There’s a nice variety of recipes here, from soups and stews to poultry, seafood, meats, veggies, and even desserts. I especially like having so many everyday meal ideas in one place because sometimes I just stare at my pantry and have no clue what to make. The recipes also make cooking feel less like a chore and more like something I can actually enjoy. Another thing I appreciated is that the cookbook focuses on flavorful meals without making the process overly complicated. As someone who doesn’t always have hours to spend in the kitchen, I love recipes that let me get dinner going and move on to other things. I think this is a great cookbook for Instant Pot beginners or anyone who wants simple, comforting meals without a lot of fuss. It gave me several recipes I’m looking forward to trying, and it definitely made me want to use my Instant Pot more often. Definitely worth keeping handy for those busy weeknight meals!

reviews.title: Can’t wait to try other recipes
reviews.body: Instant Pot Cookbook by Dorothy Milburn is a practical and user-friendly guide for anyone looking to get the most out of their Instant Pot. The book is well organized, making it easy for both beginners and experienced cooks to find recipes that suit their tastes and skill levels. Milburn provides clear instructions and helpful tips, reducing the intimidation that many people feel when using a pressure cooker for the first time. One of the cookbook's greatest strengths is its variety of recipes. From hearty breakfasts and comforting soups to flavorful main dishes and delicious desserts, the collection offers something for every meal. Most recipes use everyday ingredients, making them accessible and affordable for home cooks. The cooking times are clearly stated, helping busy individuals prepare meals quickly without sacrificing flavor. The author's writing style is straightforward and encouraging, making the recipes easy to follow. Many dishes can be customized to suit dietary preferences or ingredient availability, which adds to the cookbook's practicality. While some experienced cooks may wish for more advanced techniques or gourmet recipes, the simplicity is one of the book's greatest advantages for its intended audience. Overall, Instant Pot Cookbook by Dorothy Milburn is an excellent resource for anyone who wants to save time in the kitchen while preparing satisfying homemade meals. Its clear guidance, wide range of recipes, and emphasis on convenience make it a valuable addition to any home cook's collection. I would recommend this cookbook to beginners and busy families looking for reliable, tasty, and efficient meal ideas.

title: Instant Pot Pro Plus 6 Qt 10-in-1 Electric Pressure Cooker, Black
bullet_points: 10 Cooking Functions: Pressure cook, slow cook, sauté, steam, sous vide, can, make rice, yogurt, use NutriBoost for extra texture, or simply keep your meal warm—all in one appliance with intuitive touchscreen controls.

Smart Guided Cooking: Pair with the Instant Connect App to explore 2,000 plus interactive recipes, complete with step-by-step instructions. Monitor progress, adjust settings, or switch functions—all from your phone, in real time.

reviews.title: I like that the app has a "Timed Venting" option
reviews.body: Updated 12/29/24 - My Instant Pot timed venting wish has finally come true, so I just changed my rating to five stars. They added a new app option when timed venting is selected, so now you can choose the amount of time you want to vent the pot. It takes the guessing game out of using the timed venting feature. It's the addition I have been hoping for ever since they added timed venting to the app. Updated 9/27/24: They just added a new notification feature to the app and I really like it. You get a push status notification when the pressure cooker starts preheating, then moves to the cooking cycle, then goes into venting mode and when it completes the venting cycle. It's particularly helpful to get notified when it goes into the venting process in case you want to precisely time the venting based on what you are cooking. It's a helpful enhancement. Original review - I have an older model 6 QT Instant Pot Pro and I wanted this new one for its ability to connect to wifi, so I can use the app to control it. I especially like that the app has an extra venting option that is not available on the panel of the Instant Pot itself. It's a "Timed" option (see photo) that I actually discovered by accident when I was programming a cooking cycle. It's not explained anywhere in the documentation or even in the app, but it's very helpful when doing grains where I want it to natural release for a few minutes and then quickly finish the release without manual intervention. This is where the "Timed" option comes in. It seems to kick in about five to seven minutes after natural release starts. It varies, maybe based on how full the pot is, but since there's no documentation, it's just a guess on my part. It works great because I can be anywhere in the house and not have to rush to my kitchen to manually change the venting to quick release. I really love being able to monitor the progress from my iPhone and see when it has finished whatever cycle I've chosen. The cooking pot itself is different than my older model. It has two handles on it so it makes lifting the hot pot out of the unit so easy. I also like that it automatically seals itself when you lock the lid. No more manually turning a small knob from venting to sealing. That makes it foolproof. It cooks the same way as my older model, but these new options make it my preferred pot. It doesn't have as many preprogrammed settings as my older model, but I never really used those anyway. I like to use the standard pressure cook option and choose the cooking times and the pressure and venting levels myself. I took one star off because "Timed Venting" is not a feature on the unit and it's not explained in any documentation, but it's offered as a feature in the app. I think they need to point that out somewhere and not leave it up to consumers to find it by accident or have to guess to see how it works.

reviews.title: Techies like us, love having Bluetooth accessibility! Great InstantPot!
reviews.body: Our original InstantPot just "bit the dust." We LOVED having it and it produced many, many wonderful memories meals for us. While we mourned the passing of our "Old Faithful" InstantPot, I decided to start researching other electric pressure cookers and again, we came back to InstantPot and wanted to see what options they had. After reading all of the reviews and articles on this particular model, I told my wife 'PLEASE, PLEASE get me this one for Christmas!" She said, you can go ahead and order it but you're not allowed to open it until Christmas! Like anyone, I said YES!!!! I opened it and then downloaded the app being that it is Bluetooth compatible. I cannot tell you enough, what a pleasant surprise it was, to see just how easy it was to set up and connect via our home WiFi. I can now use the app to set the time, the release time, etc. It's amazingly friendly to use and works great. One thing I will tell you is that if you, like me, use the Saute' mode, to first brown meat, you can NOT start hte InstantPot in this mode via the app. You must physically hit the start button in order to have the Saute' mode come on. Yes, you can set it up in the app but cannot physically start the InstantPot in this particular mode. I know I"m repating myself but I want to make sure that everyone understands this. To me, it's a safety feature and I can appreciate why it's done this way. The last thing you want to do is to accidently have your InstantPot start in this mode while you're away or remote. PROS: Excellent quality, every time I turn it on, it immediately conects to the WiFi and can be accessed via the app CONS: None noted at the time of this review.

reviews.title: So far it's pretty great
reviews.body: There are a ton of youtube videos, showing you not only how to use it but how to make one pot dinners. It's easy to use, wifi is easy to set up which afterwards connects whether you are using the app or not, to show remaining cooking time. I only have basic cooking skills, so I prefer to watch the youtube videos for recipes than the app for now. Food prep always takes the longest, but once you have everything ready, put the food in, close the lid, set the time and wait for it to finish. When you set a time according to a recipe, that is the actual Pressure Cooking time. The unit has to preheat before Pressure Cooking time begins, and that's several minutes depending on the model. Then the unit has to vent the pressure (choice of Natural, Pulse, or Quick Vent.) Be careful with Quick Vent as it may make some meats tougher than if you simply waited for the Natural vent process. If you enable push notifications, it will tell you when preheating has ended and cooking has begun, and of course when cooking has ended and venting has begun (you'll likely hear the venting process from the next room. Everything but the base is dishwasher safe on the top rack, BUT, you should use a milder soap like when washing by hand, not the regular somewhat harsh dishwasher soap. The stainless steel pot didn't come quite as clean as it should have, so a little scrubbing in the sink made it bright again. You could always wash it with your regular dishwasher load (but not the other parts (lid, sealing ring, some small vent parts.) I'm pleased with my purchase and have planned a whole week of cooking meals in it. I'm currently using a simple recipe of chicken, onions, honey, soy sauce, and garlic. Smells good.

reviews.title: Better Features than Older Models - But Several Important Differences
reviews.body: This is my second instant pot. My IP Ultra model recently died so I had to upgrade. Here are several important differences from previous models: 1) The inner pot has two hand holders - this is great because the previous models would swirl around when stirring. This new version prevents that from happening. 2) The cord is not removable - not a huge deal, but wondering why they would make this change. The cord is located in the back left corner. So plugging into an outlet on the back right made for a strange bend in the cord. Wondering why they can't simply place the cord in the back middle. Not a deal breaker for me, but you should be aware of it. 3) Steam valve: this works a bit differently than other models. No way to manually vent or release steam. It has to be done through the control panel. It is possible to change the setting mid-stream, but there is a delay of a few seconds once you input on the control panel. 4) Older IP accessories may not work - I used to do Pot-in-Pot cooking with a 2 level PIP on top of a trivet. This worked fine in my Instant Pot Ultra. But the first time I tried it in my IP Pro Plus, the pin got stuck, and the lid locked closed. I couldn't open it because the pin needed room to clear. I managed to figure a way out to open it by turning the pot upside down. But this new IP seems to have a slightly lower clearance. So you'll have to use a shorter trivet, or a shorter PIP. Otherwise your lid may get stuck in locked mode. The bluetooth/wireless feature seems nice, but I tend to use the pot while I'm at home anyway. So I'm not sure how helpful it will be over time. But you do have the ability to turn on the IP while you're away from home. It involves downloading an app and connecting your IP to the wifi. The phone app gives notifications when the pre-heating is done, so thats a nice feature. The other main reason I bought this was because of the pressure canning. You can fit up to 4 quart size mason jars to can food. This is really nice. Because of its higher temperature/pressure abilities, this IP can theoretically cook food faster vs older models. I haven't tried it out yet. They also have a feature called "Nutriboost". This is simply a feature where the IP lets out steam periodically. Food in the inner pot then gets agitated. If this is done periodically throughout, then the food gets stirred. Its good for things like risotto and dhals where you want a smooth consistency. Its a nice feature but the name is a little misleading -- nothing about this boosts nutrition. It is simply a fancy way to stir your food while pressure cooking.

reviews.title: USED item sold as NEW
reviews.body: UPDATE: Received replacement and it's the WRONG (older model with fewer features) in the box! This is insanity. Our previous Instapot died 3 days ago, and we needed another before Thanksgiving. The new one clearly arrived in a VERY used condition. Looks like someone cooked a few meals in it, then used it as a bowling ball. Shame on the manufacturer store for trying to pass this off as new. Returning immediately. Update 2: The replacement pot was in the correct box, but had a different Instant Pot in it. The ouside of the box very clearly says Instant Pot, and the device inside also is an instant pot, the same model as our old one but not the upgraded version we bought. Contacted Instant Pot directly to see what can be done about getting the WRONG item in the RIGHT box. Their incredibly lame and disappointing response is "We don't sell that" I can find the exact same model we ordered on their website. The one they "don't sell" Final update: Contacted Amazon and explained the situation. They immediately refunded our money (thank you). We ordered again without much hope. To our surprise, the package that arrived today was the correct pot in the correct box finally Buyer beware, the device itself is fantastic but if your box comes with tape all over it you probably didn't get what you ordered. I am leaving this at 1 star because Instant Pot customer servicw was absolutley abyssmal and refused to even try to correct the situation. I would buy from a local appliance store vs. online because of this...getting what we ordered has been a lot of uneccesary drama. The pot itself can be reviewed now: The set in handles that keep the pot from spinning around while you sautee are fantastic. They fit firmly in place and make lifting the pot out easy. The liner pot is MUCH higher quality than the regular instant pots. The disc bottom is thicker than the original pots, and fully 3 ply clad, and it shows. There is no convex in the center of the bottom so you can keep food where you want it. The steam release is variable and no touch. The 3 setting options are great and require much less attention/timer setting. It is also MUCH quieter than previous models. The Keep Warm setting can now be used as a reheat setting, with a high, medium, low and custom temp. The Nutriboost setting is useful for gently shaking the pot while cooking to help blend better and keep food from sticking to the bottom initially. The buld seems very sturdy, very pleased over all with the additional features and functions of this pot. Would recommend, but suggest buying in person to avoid getting scammed.
reviews.body_en: UPDATE: Received replacement and it's the WRONG (older model with fewer features) in the box! This is insanity. Our previous Instapot died 3 days ago, and we needed another before Thanksgiving. The new one clearly arrived in a VERY used condition. Looks like someone cooked a few meals in it, then used it as a bowling ball. Shame on the manufacturer store for trying to pass this off as new. Returning immediately. Update 2: The replacement pot was in the correct box, but had a different Instant Pot in it. The ouside of the box very clearly says Instant Pot, and the device inside also is an instant pot, the same model as our old one but not the upgraded version we bought. Contacted Instant Pot directly to see what can be done about getting the WRONG item in the RIGHT box. Their incredibly lame and disappointing response is "We don't sell that" I can find the exact same model we ordered on their website. The one they "don't sell" Final update: Contacted Amazon and explained the situation. They immediately refunded our money (thank you). We ordered again without much hope. To our surprise, the package that arrived today was the correct pot in the correct box finally Buyer beware, the device itself is fantastic but if your box comes with tape all over it you probably didn't get what you ordered. I am leaving this at 1 star because Instant Pot customer servicw was absolutley abyssmal and refused to even try to correct the situation. I would buy from a local appliance store vs. online because of this...getting what we ordered has been a lot of uneccesary drama. The pot itself can be reviewed now: The set in handles that keep the pot from spinning around while you sautee are fantastic. They fit firmly in place and make lifting the pot out easy. The liner pot is MUCH higher quality than the regular instant pots. The disc bottom is thicker than the original pots, and fully 3 ply clad, and it shows. There is no convex in the center of the bottom so you can keep food where you want it. The steam release is variable and no touch. The 3 setting options are great and require much less attention/timer setting. It is also MUCH quieter than previous models. The Keep Warm setting can now be used as a reheat setting, with a high, medium, low and custom temp. The Nutriboost setting is useful for gently shaking the pot while cooking to help blend better and keep food from sticking to the bottom initially. The buld seems very sturdy, very pleased over all with the additional features and functions of this pot. Would recommend, but suggest buying in person to avoid getting scammed.

reviews.title: Pleasantly Surprised after I decided to Ignore a negative review.
reviews.body: Instant Pot Pro Plus Exceeds Expectations: I was initially hesitant to upgrade my old pressure cooker to the new Instant Pot Pro Plus, especially after reading a concerning review about its Wi-Fi connectivity and the company's financial troubles. However, after some research and a prompt response from Instant Brands' customer care, I decided to take the plunge when the price dropped again. Upon receiving the Instant Pot Pro Plus, I was delighted to find that my worries were unfounded. The Wi-Fi connectivity worked flawlessly after a bit of patience during the setup process, and the automatic venting and improved inner pot are significant improvements. Despite concerns raised about the company's financial situation and app issues in the June 17, 2023 review, I have not encountered any problems. Prior to purchase, I sent an email concerning the app issues and their rapid reply satisfied me that Instant Brands has addressed previous issues, and I am confident in they will support this product moving forward. It's worth noting that Instant Brands was purchased by affiliates of Centre Lane Partners in November 2023, which has likely contributed to the company's stability and product improvements. In conclusion, the Instant Pot Pro Plus has greatly impressed me with its performance and features. Don't let past concerns deter you—this appliance is worth every penny. (I did notice the price went up again after I ordered mine.) I am completely satisfied with my purchase and would highly recommend it to anyone in the market for a versatile and reliable pressure cooker.

reviews.title: 10 Minutes to Perfectly Cooked Meals!
reviews.body: I am a huge fan of the Ninja brand. I absolutely love my Ninja glass air fryer, so when I was looking for a new electric pressure cooker, I was torn between buying this Ninja model with its ceramic-coated interior (which is not the cheapest option on the market) or choosing a stainless-steel interior cooker from another brand. In the end, I decided to trust Ninja again, and I can honestly say I do not regret my decision. After using it for several weeks, I feel ready to share my experience. The Pressure Cook function is amazing. It can cook meals in about 10 minutes, which honestly seemed unbelievable to me at first. I have made beans, meats, and different dishes, and I was impressed by how quickly everything was ready while still maintaining great flavor and texture. I also love the Sear/Sauté function because it allows you to brown and sauté your ingredients before pressure cooking. The process is faster and more convenient than other cookers I have used, and it adds so much flavor to the final dish. After that, you simply switch to pressure cooking, and the results are delicious. I absolutely love this cooker and truly believe it is worth every penny I spent on it. The quality, versatility, and ease of use have exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a reliable and high-quality multicooker.

reviews.title: Great Purchase. Worth every penny!
reviews.body: Honestly, I was a bit worried because of the analysis of price vs features vs brand. I was mostly satisfied with my previous one of a "big brand," but my wife was not happy because it did not come with a metal insert. And, of course, we all have our prejudices - and I have a wife with a crapload of those! Well, she went on a trip, and I had no cricket on my shoulder... so I took a chance! he-he-he-he!! (drumroll, please!) It honestly SEEMS a bit pricey, I will not deny that. YET, when comparing features, its HUGE capacity, the "stainless steel insert," it came very much cheaper than the main-brand ones. Now, I am honestly not sure if it is stainless steel. However, I have had this now for... let me do math here... the root square of... add the cosene... and dividied by Saturn's PI... IDK... 2 months? I am super impressed! I generally use it for rice. but not just boring white rice. I make rice with beans, rice with meat, sticky rice, basmati rice... and I recently used the pressure-cooking feature. It works just as, or better than, advertised! Only features that that are slightly annoying is that you have to press the one button a bunch of times until you get to the function you desire, and that I still have not figured out how to change the time once I engage the function. To be fair, for the latter, I have not opened the instructions manual (of course, I am a guy!), but I honestly have not needed it - it was mostly a curiosity. I will just let the wife figure it out in... 4 weeks, when the peace is over in the house! Sigh... Caution: DO NOT leave it unattended. IT WILL overcook your items! Because of the metal insert, it conducts heat very well! Its warming option is very, VERY effective. Honestly, just shut it down and leave the lid closed if you want to keep the food warm for another hour or so, then reheat it as necessary. You will also save on power. Lastly, something that never quite fit with the previous electric cooker we had. I had obtained a third-party silicone cover/lid for it, and it never quite fit. It FITS PERFECTLY for this! I wish I remembered where the heck I got it, but it is great now, whereas it was just meh back then. Something I wish it had was a way to easily lift the insert while it was still hot. I happen to have some hook-like thingys that easily attach to the insert sides, but I wish they came with it. But that is it. I love this! Anyway, GREAT purchase. Obviously, I have used it quite enough.

The only thing it does reasonably well is make soup. The biggest problem is the lid. It is very heavy and difficult to close correctly. We used this cooker for only a few months. I am very disappointed with this purchase and would never buy this product again. I hope my review helps others avoid making the same mistake.

reviews.title: Great Unit! Poor Instructions.
reviews.body: This is my first pressure cooker. I researched many models and I love the capacity of this one. I was looking for something that would meal prep my favorite chili recipe with minimal cooking odor in my home. I have only made one batch so far but it turned out wonderful- just as good as in the CrockPot for seven hours. This unit took about 45 minutes. Total GAME CHANGER in the cooking odor dept. No more leftover onion smell throughout my home and the clothing that was in my closet. I love it and I am keeping it because I can’t wait to try it with other foods and experiment more. I give this unit four stars because the user manual is lackluster for a first time pressure cooker. It is also very hard to understand, the English language in it is not properly written. There are many misspelled words. Some of it doesn’t make sense at all. I managed to do some research and testing on my own and I ended up loving this unit. If I hadn’t had a lot of patience, I probably would have returned this item considering the instruction manual. However, with all the other great reviews, I had to give it my best shot and I’m so glad I did.

This book truly makes everyday cooking a delightful and effortless experience. Highly recommended for anyone eager to transform their culinary skills!

reviews.title: Perfect for Quick and Easy Meals
reviews.body: For years I have been reluctant to purchase an Instant Pot. I am not quite sure why, other than being apprehensive that I would not be able to come up with enough ways to use it. When I was surprised with one as a gift, it made me realize it was time to come up with recipes my family would enjoy. When I saw the title of this book, The Ultimate Instant Pot Cookbook for Beginners, by Jodi Gutierrez, I took the plunge and purchased it. I am rarely as impressed by a cookbook as I am this one. It does not just provide tons of recipes, but also a great guide on the Instant Pot Duo Mini too! One of my favorite things about this cookbook is that it includes a 4-week meal plan. If I were to want a stress-free month of breakfasts, lunches, dinners, and desserts, this would be perfect to follow. Even if you do not plan to use the Instant Pot every day, it makes it easier to meal plan for one day, a few days or a week at a time. Another thing I love is the wide variety of recipe options. My family loves variety so I am certain this book is going to enable me to keep every meal interesting. They also have quite the sweet tooth, so I am looking forward to treating them now and then to many unique desserts. I had heard about doing cheesecakes in the Instant Pot, but now I know I can do filled apples, doughnuts, lemon curd, pudding, and so much more. Ending reliance on boxed desserts is exactly what I wanted to do. With pudding taking just 5 minutes prep time and 15 minutes cook time using wholesome ingredients such as heavy cream, egg yoks, and whole milk, I can feel good about treating my family. Speaking about the prep and cook time, the recipes provide this information which is something I love. There is nothing worse than planning a meal at the last minute and finding out it takes hours longer than you expected. I do not know about your family, but mine does not appreciate waiting for dinner! The nutritional information per serving is also provided so you can cook based on your family’s dietary plan. The Ultimate Instant Pot Cookbook for Beginners truly has something for everyone. Plenty of meat dishes, seafood, vegetable, breakfast, poultry, and more. Some of the first ones we will be trying are the healthy seafood gumbo, simple lemon octopus, teriyaki pork roast, simple Mongolian beef, Hawaiian pulled pork, and homemade chicken wings. I feel this book is going to be a game changer every day and especially during the holidays due to so many being perfect for pot lucks and family gatherings. You will not be disappointed if you get this cookbook.

reviews.title: Not a quality book but good basics
reviews.body: This is a good Instant Pot Cookbook designed for the Instant Pot Duo. If you don’t have the Duo, don’t worry—the recipes all work. My initial reaction was one of surprise because all the recipes are in black and white, which was a bit disappointing. I prefer color recipes because I like to see the finished dish, and I believe color photos give a better sense of that. The book offers a wide range of dishes, from stews and casseroles to all the main proteins. It also includes a decent vegetarian selection, and you can easily swap ingredients without affecting the dish. Additionally, it features some simple dessert recipes. It covers essential fundamentals, which is helpful for beginners like myself. It’s a good purchase, but pairing it with a quality companion recipe book would be beneficial. Some Instant Pots come with an app, which I find to be very helpful. I haven’t used this book extensively yet, but it provides a solid foundation. The publisher and author could improve by investing in better photos of the recipes and printing in color. As a photographer, I believe those simple changes would lead to more positive reviews and possibly more sales. The overall quality, however, disappointed me.

reviews.title: The Ultimate Instant Pot Cookbook for Beginners!!!
reviews.body: With two kids and a full-time job, I needed quick, healthy meals that didn’t involve takeout — and this cookbook delivered! The Ultimate Instant Pot Cookbook for Beginners made using my Instant Pot so much less intimidating. This book is super beginner-friendly, with clear instructions and helpful tips that actually made me feel confident using my Instant Pot from day one. The layout is clean and easy to follow, and the recipes are perfect for real life — simple ingredients, quick prep, and delicious results. So far, I’ve made the creamy chicken and rice, beef stew, and the banana oatmeal — all turned out amazing with hardly any effort. I even tried one of the dessert recipes (hello, chocolate lava cake!) and it was a hit with the whole family. The recipes are simple, family-friendly, and actually taste great. The chicken and rice is now a weekly go-to, and even my picky eater loved the mac and cheese. I also appreciated the tips for cooking in batches — total time-saver. If you’re a busy parent looking to make fast, wholesome meals without the stress, this book is a total game-changer. Also, if you're new to pressure cooking or just want a reliable set of go-to recipes, this cookbook is a must-have. It’s taken the stress out of mealtime and made cooking something I actually look forward to! Highly recommend!

title: 7MAGIC Sonic Electric Toothbrush, 180-Day Runtime, 42000VPM, 8 Heads, Black
bullet_points: 180-DAY LONG RUNTIME - Unlike a typical electric toothbrush that needs frequent charging, 7Magic’s 2000mAh battery lasts up to 180 days per charge (brushing twice daily). It also has a low-battery indicator and an auto shut-off when fully charged, so you won’t have to worry about charging for months. Great for daily use, travel, or business trips with no charger needed on the go
DENTIST-RECOMMENDED DESIGN – The 7MAGIC electric toothbrush is developed with input from a licensed U.S.-based dentist to support effective daily brushing habits. For general oral hygiene use only

7+1 replacement brush heads for 2 YEARS - 7Magic electric toothbrush comes with 8 premium replacement brush heads (7 standard plus 1 deep-cleaning). The W-shaped bristle layout is engineered to conform to tooth contours, thoroughly cleaning the gumline and hard-to-reach areas. With each head lasting about 3 months, you have up to 24 months of use before needing new brush heads

42,000 VPM POWERFUL SONIC CLEANING - 7Magic electric toothbrush features a next-generation sonic motor that generates 42,000 vibrations per minute to create micro-bubbles, penetrating deep between teeth and gums. It removes up to 10x more plaque than a manual toothbrush for a fresher, healthier smile

5 MODES & 3 INTENSITIES - 7Magic electric sonic toothbrush features 5 specialized modes and 3 intensity settings to meet various oral care needs, allowing you to customize your brushing experience from a gentle setting for sensitive gums to a powerful mode for deep cleaning. We recommend starting with the lower setting and gradually adjusting to higher settings based on your comfort level, ensuring a better experience tailored to your oral sensitivity and usage habits. Suitable for kids, teens, adults, and seniors, including those with sensitive gums or braces

IPX7 WATERPROOF & SMART TIMER - With an IPX7 waterproof design, 7Magic sonic toothbrush can be fully rinsed and safely used in the shower without risk of water damage. It also features a 2-minute timer with 30-second quadpacer intervals, following dentist recommendations to ensure every quadrant of your mouth gets a thorough cleaning

What’s in the Box - Includes 7MAGIC Sonic Electric Toothbrush (Black) ×1, Brush Heads ×8 (Standard Brush Heads x7 + Deep-Cleaning Brush Head x1), USB Charging Cable ×1, User Manual ×1, Toothbrush Hanger ×1, Brush Head Cover ×1

reviews.title: Viel Leistung für wenig Geld
reviews.body: Ich hatte schon so lange ich denken kann Probleme mit Zahnstein. Als ich dann Umgezogen bin wechselte ich den Zahnarzt aufgrund der weiten Anfahrt zum vorigen Doc. Der neue Zahnarzt gab mir den Rat eine Schallzahnbürste zu kaufen weil diese den Zahnstein merklich in Schach halten würde. Dann begab ich mich auf die Suche auf eine Ebensolche. Da bekannte Markenprodukte relativ bis sehr teuer sind wurde ich auf obiges Produkt aufmerksam. Gesehen; Gekauft. Was mich an dieser Schallzahnbürste sehr begeistert ist die Handhabung, die zahlreichen Putzstufen und die wirklich lange Akkuhalte-Zeit. Das ist wirklich beeindruckend. Einzig der Nachkauf der Bürstenköpfe erfordert etwas Geduld da diese nicht so einfach im Internet zu finden sind (was ich aber nicht in die Wertung miteinbezogen habe). Fazit: Wer nicht bereit ist für für namhaftere Marken einen beachtlichen Geldbetrag hinzublättern sollte hier zugreifen. Die elektronische Kauleistenreinigungsbürste macht ihren Job und das meiner Meinung nach richtig gut. Eine hohe Standzeit des Akkus spricht zudem auch für diesen Kauf Top Gerät
reviews.body_en: I've had problems with tartar for as long as I can remember. When I moved, I changed dentists to the previous doctor because of the long journey. The new dentist advised me to buy a sonic toothbrush because it would noticeably keep the tartar at bay. Then I went looking for something similar. Since well-known brand products are relatively to very expensive, I became aware of the above product. Seen; Bought. What I really like about this sonic toothbrush is the handling, the numerous cleaning levels and the really long battery life. That's really impressive. Only purchasing the brush heads requires a little patience as they are not that easy to find on the internet (but I didn't take that into account in the rating). Conclusion: If you are not prepared to shell out a considerable amount of money for well-known brands, you should go here. The electronic chewing bar cleaning brush does its job and, in my opinion, does it really well. A long battery life also speaks for this top device purchase

reviews.title: Ottimo spazzolino elettrico, pratico e potente
reviews.body: Acquistato per sostituire il mio vecchio spazzolino elettrico e devo dire che sono rimasto piacevolmente sorpreso. La pulizia è davvero efficace: le vibrazioni soniche sono potenti ma allo stesso tempo delicate sulle gengive, e già dopo pochi utilizzi si percepisce una sensazione di denti più lisci e puliti. Molto comode le diverse modalità di utilizzo e i livelli di intensità, che permettono di personalizzare l'esperienza in base alle proprie esigenze. Apprezzatissimo anche il timer integrato che aiuta a rispettare i tempi consigliati dal dentista. La vera chicca, però, è la ricarica tramite USB Type-C. Finalmente niente basi ingombranti o cavi proprietari: posso ricaricarlo con lo stesso caricatore dello smartphone, comodissimo soprattutto in viaggio. Anche l'autonomia sembra eccellente e permette di dimenticarsi della ricarica per parecchio tempo. Buona qualità costruttiva, design elegante e silenzioso durante l'utilizzo. Considerando il prezzo, è un acquisto che rifarei senza esitazioni. Consigliato!
reviews.body_en: Purchased to replace my old electric toothbrush and I must say I was pleasantly surprised. Cleaning is truly effective: the sonic vibrations are powerful but at the same time delicate on the gums, and after just a few uses you can perceive a sensation of smoother and cleaner teeth. The different modes of use and intensity levels are very convenient, allowing you to customize the experience according to your needs. The integrated timer which helps to respect the times recommended by the dentist is also highly appreciated. The real gem, however, is charging via USB Type-C. Considering the price, it is a purchase that I would make again without hesitation. Advised!

reviews.title: Rapport qualité/prix imbattable - Je découvre enfin l'hygiène dentaire optimale !
reviews.body: Mon coup de cœur à 20€ : J'ai acheté cette brosse à dents électrique sonique à 40000 VPM pour une vingtaine d'euros et je suis littéralement conquis. Pour ce prix, je ne m'attendais pas à une telle qualité. C'est de loin le meilleur investissement santé que j'ai fait cette année ! La sensation de propreté absolue : Ce qui m'a le plus bluffé, c'est l'impression d'avoir les dents ultra-propres après chaque brossage, comme si je sortais tout juste d'un détartrage chez le dentiste. Les 40000 vibrations par minute désintègrent vraiment la plaque dentaire de façon spectaculaire. Mes dents sont lisses et parfaitement nettoyées.​ Polyvalence et personnalisation : 5 modes de brossage : Blanchiment, nettoyage, sensible, polissage et massage des gencives - de quoi s'adapter à tous les besoins​ 3 intensités réglables : Parfait pour alterner selon la sensibilité de mes gencives​ Étanchéité IPX7 : Je peux l'utiliser sous la douche sans aucun problème​ Autonomie exceptionnelle : La batterie est vraiment impressionnante. Elle tient facilement un mois complet avec deux brossages quotidiens. Certaines brosses haut de gamme annoncent 3 mois, et même si je n'atteins pas tout à fait les 90 jours annoncés, un mois d'autonomie est déjà exceptionnel pour ce prix.​ Accessoires inclus : Le coffret vient avec plusieurs brossettes de rechange, ce qui représente une vraie économie sur le long terme. Plus besoin de racheter immédiatement des têtes de brosse.​ Pourquoi je recommande à 200% : Pour 20€, vous obtenez une technologie sonique comparable aux modèles à 100-200€. La différence de sensation de propreté avec une brosse manuelle est juste phénoménale. Mes gencives sont plus saines et mes dents nettement plus blanches.​ Mon verdict : Si vous hésitez encore à passer à l'électrique, foncez sur ce modèle. Le rapport qualité/prix est imbattable et votre dentiste vous remerciera lors de votre prochaine visite ! Si cet avis vous a été utile, n'hésitez pas à cliquer sur le bouton "Utile" ci-dessous, cela m'aide beaucoup !
reviews.body_en: My favorite for €20: I bought this 40,000 VPM sonic electric toothbrush for around twenty euros and I am literally won over. For this price, I didn't expect such quality. This is by far the best health investment I've made this year! The feeling of absolute cleanliness: What amazed me the most was the impression of having ultra-clean teeth after each brushing, as if I had just come from a scaling at the dentist. The 40,000 vibrations per minute really disintegrate dental plaque spectacularly. My teeth are smooth and perfectly cleaned.​ Versatility and customization: 5 brushing modes: Whitening, cleaning, sensitive, polishing and gum massage - enough to adapt to all needs​ 3 adjustable intensities: Perfect for alternating according to the sensitivity of my gums​ IPX7 waterproofing: I can use it in the shower without any problem​ Exceptional battery life: The battery is really impressive. It easily lasts a full month with two daily brushings. Some high-end brushes advertise 3 months, and even if I don't quite reach the 90 days announced, one month of autonomy is already exceptional for this price. Accessories included: The box comes with several replacement brush heads, which represents a real saving in the long term. No need to immediately buy brush heads again.​ Why I recommend 200%: For €20, you get sonic technology comparable to €100-200 models. The difference in feeling of cleanliness with a manual brush is just phenomenal. My gums are healthier and my teeth are significantly whiter. My verdict: If you are still hesitant about going electric, go for this model. The quality/price ratio is unbeatable and your dentist will thank you during your next visit! reviews.title: Excellent Brand

It also comes with multiple brushing modes, which is nice to have depending on whether you want a deeper clean or something more gentle for sensitive gums. The build feels lightweight but not cheap and it’s easy to hold even when wet. The included 6 brush heads are a good bonus and they seem easy enough to replace when needed. Overall, If you are looking for an affordable electric toothbrush that does the job well without unnecessary extras, this is a great pick. It’s an excellent balance of performance and value and with a two-year warranty, why not?

reviews.title: First impressions matter—and COSLUS (BLACK) delivers!
reviews.body: This sonic toothbrush arrived in a sleek, well-designed travel case that immediately stood out. The case holds two brush heads (one for current use and one individually wrapped spare), and what really impressed me is the built-in ventilation. If you’re someone who brushes in the shower (🙋🏽‍♀️), this detail is huge. Bonus: the toothbrush itself is fully waterproof, so no concerns there. The toothbrush is lightweight, slim, and comfortable to hold, making it feel more premium than bulkier electric brushes I’ve used. It features a 2-minute smart timer with 30-second quadrant pauses, which helps ensure even cleaning throughout the mouth. One feature I genuinely appreciate: if you stop mid-cycle—say, to sign for a delivery—the brush resumes exactly where you left off when you turn it back on. That level of thoughtful design doesn’t go unnoticed. There are 5 distinct cleaning modes, and with each mode change there is a noticeable change in brushing pattern, particularly through the blue bristles and angled top bristles. The toothbrush overall is well designed and aligns comfortably with both teeth and gums, providing a thorough yet gentle clean. The brush head shape feels intentional, not generic. COSLUS includes 6 brush heads, which equals approximately 18 months of use based on the recommended 3-month replacement schedule—an excellent value and a big plus for long-term ownership. I’ve only just started using this toothbrush, so I can’t yet speak to battery longevity or how the blue indicator bristles fade over time. That said, I’ll be more than happy to provide an update after extended use. Overall, this toothbrush checks all the boxes: smart design, strong performance, thoughtful features, and great value. I’m excited to continue using it and would absolutely recommend it to anyone looking to upgrade their oral care routine. Great value and works WELL!

reviews.title: A true Sonicare replacement but pulling the heads off takes serious grip strength
reviews.body: I finally refused to buy another $100 Philips Sonicare after my second one died exactly when the two-year warranty expired. I picked this COSLUS up at full price strictly because getting the handle a travel case and an 18-month supply of brush heads cost less than one pack of name-brand refills. I honestly expected a hollow rattling piece of cheap plastic. Instead the matte black handle has a solid weight to it and the motor delivers that intense high-pitched sonic hum that instantly foams up your toothpaste. After brushing twice a day for six weeks my teeth have that perfectly slick feeling you normally only get leaving the dentist chair. The battery performance is what really convinced me to keep it. I left the wireless charger in the box and haven't plugged this thing in once since day one. I even took it on two weekend work trips without the cord and the motor hasn't dropped a fraction of its power. It does the standard 30-second stutter to tell you to switch quadrants which is great for mindless early morning brushing. I am capping it at four stars for two very specific physical limitations. First the five cleaning modes change the rhythm of the brushing but you cannot adjust the actual intensity up or down. If the standard mode is too aggressive for your gums you just have to switch to the softer pulsating mode. Second the replacement heads lock onto the metal shaft so aggressively that taking them off requires an absurd amount of force. I actually had to wrap a hand towel around the brush head just to get enough grip to yank it off without snapping the plastic. If you have arthritis or hand mobility issues you should definitely skip this. But if you just want a reliable powerhouse of a toothbrush and don't mind wrestling with a piece of plastic every three months this is a massive steal.

reviews.title: I could be a new convert to sonic toothbrushing!
reviews.body: I've been a diehard round head electric toothbrush user for years, and I'm not very familiar with using a sonic one. But I wanted to give it a try and compare the "after brushing" feel between the two. My 1st impression, after admiring the high end look of the simple cardboard packaging, was that it appeared to be a no frills, easy to use electric toothbrush. Just one button does it all ~ on and off, as well as selecting which of the two speeds you want (gentle or deep clean). Simplicity rules, and I love that! None of that "3 long presses for this, or 5 short presses plus 1 long press for that." Just press ~ brush ~ go. Easy peasy! As directed, I charged it for a full 7 hrs before my first use. There's really no learning curve as it has many of the same features my round head electric toothbrush does, such as a short pulse to move on after 30 seconds. One thing that made me laugh ~ after 2 minutes, I wasn't expecting it to just completely shut down without warning. That's all, bye bye, time to go! lol I'm used to 4 short pulses saying you're finished, but it doesn't just shut down in mid-brush! The 28,000 vibrations per minute caused my nose to itch incessantly for the whole two minutes, but I hope that wouldn't be an issue once I got used to it. I like that this toothbrush is very lightweight, small-ish in size, has a nice wave-shaped brush head with medium-soft bristles, a 28 day battery life and an optional magnetic mount that I probably won't use. Also, and important to me, is that you can order brush head refills right from this site ~ no hunting around to find what you need. It's right here! Also , the whole plant-based description is very interesting to me. For example, the brush heads are made from cornstarch, and can be mailed back to the company after use for recycling. Kudos for that! There's info in the enclosed Quick Start Guide about where to send them. Bottom line: this little brush did what it's supposed to do, and I enjoyed how unique and different it was to use. My mouth felt totally refreshed, and I think it probably did a better job of plaque removal than my round head toothbrush does. For all these reasons, I could easily be converted to sonic toothbrushing!

reviews.body: When I received my SURI NEW Core Sonic Electric Toothbrush I was pleasantly surprised by the good build quality and attention to detail. The magnetic charging base is a step up from my last toothbrush that had problems with water getting into the USB connection. Before I used it the first time I charged it up as described in the instruction sheet. But, I found it odd the instructions specify use of a 5V 1A power adapter. All of my 1 Amp power adapters have a USB-A output. So I used a USB-A power adapter with a little A to C converter I happened to have. This worked great. I asked the vendor about the limitations specified in the instructions. They responded quickly and courteously with the following answer. "Yes, you can use any USB-C charger from a trusted brand that is certified to the relevant safety standards in your country. The only requirement is that it uses USB-C; the charger’s rated voltage and current do not need to be exactly 5V/1A." So, we can plug it into any USB-C power adapter we have. Cool! As far as using it goes, no problems. Bristles are a bit softer than I usually use but that is what my dentist recommends. I also note the brush motor flickers every minute or so. Then I realized it is telling me to move onto the next quarter on my mouth. And then it shuts off. Since I generally brush longer than the average bear, it was shutting off before I was done. But, no problem to just turn it back on. This brush is fairly compact and will fit nicely in my camping gear. The claimed 4-week run time is a bonus.

reviews.title: Significant Upgrades Over Prior Model
reviews.body: I'm a current Suri rusher coming from the prior generation of Suri toothbrush, and I was eager to try this new model. I would definitely say the company has been listening to critiques and has created a significant upgrade over the previous "core" model. I like how it is lighter than the old model, so my hand doesn't get tired after holding it up for a few minutes. The base is more stable than before, it stands up straight when I place it on the counter while my old one tended to topple over. The color is attractive, and looks the same as it did before. The brush heads are also the same, which is great, those didn't need to change at all. It is a soft brush head that cleans very well, according to my dentist! Charging is soooo much easier than before, thanks to doing away with the copper pins that tended to corroded and had trouble lining up. The brush's LED also lights up much brighter than the old model which makes it much easier to see when the brush has successfully started charging. My only downside is the pressure-activated button is a bit harder to press than the old touch-sensitive button. However, I'm getting used to it and wouldn't say it's a deal-breaker. Happily, the battery has already lasted a month without needing to recharge. Same good battery life as before.
