reviews.title: Very disappointed.
reviews.body: First, an introduction, this will take some going through, bear with me. First, I had refused for years to get a Keurig, as I did not feel the quality and richness of a good strong cup of coffee was possible. But I finally got tired of trying other methods of brewing, from using a regular single cup espresso maker, moka pot, pour over, French press... I finally opted for the ease of a Keurig mini-plus. Coffee was ...eh... I switched coffee brands, to what I feel has to be the best commercial brand. And the coffee was EXcellenT! About a year later, despite regular cleaning cycles, the thing just stopped working. I tried to take it apart, watched some youtube videos which just solidified the fact that the company made these non-serviceable. P.O.'d at this obvious tactic to sell more, I waited a few weeks, but went and got another one. Same deal a year later. Another one. This last one gave me signs before ending it's own life. I would have to run several cycles where nothing would come out... till finally something... drip... by drip... several hours later, the thing would start running again, only to stop again the next day or two. Finally, it just died. So I REFUSED to get another. These things are ridiculous, right? So I got a new French press. Coffee is great!! But... omg... what a pain cleaning that thing every.... single... time... I mean, really, it's no big deal. But, it CAn be. So I saw this thing on sale, I thought, well, it's HAlf the price of the other ones... and I def want something different this time. Cut to now.... This thing has SEVERAL issues that I don't like. First of all, it is a thinner cheaper plastic, and has a cheap looking shine to it. Ok, I'm over it. The plastic... I mean, can't they make these things with glass reservoirs.... the plastic reservoir has screws on the inside of it. I don't care if they say it is food safe... Plastic is also considered food safe... but that doesn't mean it is.. those are just bureaucratic rhetoric lies. But I digress,...So this coffee maker has an adjustment for high altitude... is THAT what ruined my previous Keurigs? High altitude? Hmmm. Ok, so maybe that's a plus. It also has different sizes that you can choose -8,10, & 12 oz. With the mini-plus, you choose the size by the amount of water you pour in. That means that this one measures what it sucks in. Hmmm. The mini-plus had the controls on the top. Easy peasy. This one has the controls on the side. It also doesn't have rubber feet on the bottom. So when you try to push the buttons, the thing slides away from you. Impossible to push any buttons with one hand, you have to use two. Even with rubber feet, you have to use two hands. I'm not a paraplegic, but it's rather stupid to have to hold the thing to press a button or two, or three. Which is what you have to do. It's just really awkward because you really have to hold it in the back to keep it from moving when you press the button in front. And you have to do that without touching the reservoir, which will pop out if you tried that. But let's get to the coffee. So with the mini-plus, the first liquid out of the machine, was dark coffee. As it was finishing, the coffee would be a little more clear, but not pure water. With this machine, for the first few seconds, it is spewing out crystal clear WATER. I don't even know how that is possible. But this, it does. It also claims to be faster than the mini-cup. I hestitate to say "brews faster", because it doesn't brew, Keurigs simply spew water into and through the k-cup, it's a pressurized system, not a true brewing system. And it definitely IS faster. And that's a problem, as evidenced by the watery coffee that it spews out. Sure enough, the "coffee" tastes like water. This is the 8 oz brew, mind you, with the machine set to "strong". I first tried the 12oz, and ended up pouring it down the sink. The 8 oz wasn't much better. My next step is to switch out cups while it's pouring out the water at the beginning of the cycle and see if I can get a stronger "brew". All in all, it's convenient enough. But it will sit on my counter, mostly unused, for when I have those really lazy, sleepy, or sick days, when all I want to do is pop in a capsule, and deal with the rest of it... Very disappointed. Perhaps if you live in a low altitude area, the mini-plus would work for you. I really do recommend that one above this.

reviews.title: Most excellent
reviews.body: I got this to replace my original Keurig. The old k50 or whatever it was. This thing takes up less space, looks more sleek, and works better than the original. It's faster, the coffee tastes better, it has the strong button. Also, I keep my coffee maker in my bedroom, and with the old one if you wanted it to be ready to make a quick cup of coffee it had to be turned on which meant that it had lights illuminated. I had to cover them with tape. This new one can go from being turned off to making a quick cup of coffee immediately. And after 5 minutes it automatically turns any illumination off. That means it doesn't make light in my bedroom at night. It's just a way way better version. It's quieter. I love it I'm so glad I got it. I will say that I got this brand new, and it was a really good deal, and I can see why because the manual includes an offer for discounted coffee that expired over two years ago. I'm guessing Keurig punched out a few too many of these models and they've been sitting in a warehouse for too many years. My advice is buy it now before it goes out of stock. It is an excellent coffee maker.

reviews.title: Great for 6 Months, Now Dead
reviews.body: If you’re looking for a short term coffee solution to get you through a few months of great coffee, this machine is for you. Easy to use, very convenient, makes a great cup of crema. It doesn’t have all the bells and whistles, just straight espresso and coffee which is exactly what I wanted. I’ve been diligent - religious even about replacing the filter on time, using official Jura tablets for descaling and cleaning. Over the last few weeks, coffee started to come out of the spouts slower and slower. Now it won’t make coffee at all. It’s clearly clogged somewhere. As a last ditch effort. I’ve run 2 back to back cleaning and descaling operations (yes using official Jura tablets). Nadda. She’s done for. Jura support has been useless. Placed multiple calls and no real results. I’m sure if I take the whole thing apart piece by piece I could fix it, but that’s not what I do or how I want to spend hours of my time. So I spent $200 a month for 7 months of great coffee. Funny to think I could have actually saved money going to the local coffee shop every single day.

reviews.title: Excellent Coffee Quality but Much Louder Than Expected for a Premium Machine
reviews.body: I’ve been using the Jura E4 Piano White Automatic Coffee Machine for a while now and overall the coffee quality is excellent. The espresso it makes is rich, creamy, and very consistent. The flavor extraction is impressive and definitely delivers a café-quality cup at home. However, for a machine at this price point, I expected it to be much quieter. The grinder is quite loud, and recently I’ve noticed the noise has increased even more when the machine turns on and off or when it starts grinding the beans. One thing to keep in mind if you have a baby at home, the machine is loud enough to wake mine up when we use it early in the morning. So if you’re hoping for a quiet espresso routine while the baby sleeps, that might be something to consider. Performance-wise, it’s great, and the coffee is fantastic, but the noise level is definitely something to keep in mind. Pros • Excellent coffee quality • Very rich and creamy espresso • Easy to use Cons • Much louder than expected for a premium machine

reviews.title: Awesome little coffee pot! And brews fast!
reviews.body: This coffee pot is so great! I wasn't expecting much, but it has impressed me. I bought this for one purpose. My husband was having a high risk, complicated surgery, and I was going to be living in the hospital with him during the time he was in there. I like MY coffee, and I want my own coffee even away from home. It dawned on me that I couldn't take my huge, double sided multi-use coffee pot with me. I started looking for something other than a keurig, and I found THIS! I read reviews. I figured for $22, it's worth a shot. This thing is awesome! It comes with a cup and lid, and a little coffee scoop (i still used my own. The one that came with it is smaller than mine.) It has one button. If you hit the button while it's not plugged in, it still sets it to start. As soon as you plug it in, it will start. It's important to read the instructions that come with it and follow them. It takes about 3 minutes to brew the cup. It takes a little practice to figure out how much water to use to leave room for sugar/ creamer, but it brews great coffee. I am not sorry I bought this, and I've even sent the link to friends who also love their coffee. I've only had it for about a month now, but I even use it at home in lieu of my $120 coffee pot. I even had a few nurses comment on it and say what a good idea to bring a small coffee pot to provide those small comforts of home. Job well done, Elite Gourmet!

reviews.title: It's GREAT... Till
reviews.body: I received this about a week ago and it has been PERFECT. When I first received it, I fell in love with the color (as it is my favorite) and size. It was nicely packaged and in perfect condition. I ran the first cycle through with just water and wiped it down like the manual said. I only made one cup each day using the tumbler included I used cold bottled water and poured it in the tumbler leaving space for creamer. Because I wanted to make sure I have the right amount after fully brewed. *Today I went to make a cup as usual since ive had it.. And noticed the water I was pouring in was coming out of the bottom fast but not all of it. It was about 2 inches or so less of water that I initially poured into the Tumbler that was leaked out. I wiped it up and continue to press the blue power button. And it brewed fine (minus the amount leaked in the beginning) without any more leakage. I will make another cup later on today and do a update. * Tumbler is very nice to have and keeps coffee hot/warm for a hour+ ...As long as you keep the lid locked after you sip. Easy to clean, I like the reusable filter it comes with. I just dump the used grounds in a plastic sack and toss it. Rinse filter quickly and dry fast. Long as you don't use super fine grounds then the filter is perfect!. **All in all I LOVE this and recommend for occasional coffee drinkers. Especially with limited space and no need for full size.... I'm just waiting to see if it leaks again later today when I update! ****Another update: I have had this for a while now. I usually only make one cup per day. I clean it right after I am done and I make sure it is unplugged. This is a great machine for someone who is maybe just a single coffee drinker in the home or if it's just two people. It has not leaked since that one first time. Which I do think now the only reason there was water was because it dripped from the cup and I didn't notice. So I think this actually didn't leak on me as I thought. I'm still using it everyday and it is wonderful. ***Well OVER 1 YEAR UPDATE*** So this little single coffee maker is the best!!! I use to almost everyday, once a day. And it is still working just as good as when I first got it. I love this thing and definitely definitely recommend!!! Just make sure to always unplug it when you're done and don't make a bunch of cups back to back. At least I wouldn't recommend that. But if you are on the fence of ordering this and you only have one coffee drinker in the house, this is the perfect one!!! ✨☕

reviews.title: Fantastic Personal Coffee Maker
reviews.body: This coffee maker has been a game changer for coffee at work. Gone are the days of relying on mediocre office coffee that was always somehow empty when I wanted a cup. This product is easy to use and brews a great 14oz cup of black coffee in less than 90 seconds. The reusable filter is easy to clean with a quick rinse. I opted for optional paper filters instead and all I have to do is simply dump the puck of used coffee. The LARATH brand basket coffee filters here on Amazon fit perfect. 14oz of water + ~4 tbsp of ground coffee is all you need. This is equivalent to one large cup of black coffee or 2 medium cups if you split it and add milk. Overall the machine is relatively quiet and will not disturb others around you. The insulated cup is poor at keeping heat but if you plan on finishing your coffee in less than an hour than it's a non-issue. I'd highly recommend this cheap little machine for (Large) single cup drinkers and those seeking a more convenient black coffee experience at your work desk. Hopefully it lasts me a long time, but for the price, I won't be upset if it's done in a couple years and that's okay.

reviews.title: It's worth it
reviews.body: I have a love/hate relationship with Ninja products - I really love them. But I strongly dislike the warranty. And I hate the lifespan. Once they are done - they're done. I have had a couple of Ninja blenders that surpass the crushing and blending power of my 30 year old beehive Oster - but their life expectancy is about five years. This was a very strong consideration in purchasing a $200 coffee maker. I am not a coffee connoisseur - I typically drink one cup daily - very strong with cream only. But it has to be a perfect cup. I want to enjoy every single sip. I found a Ninja coffee system, brand new, at a thrift store locally for $15. The coffee was amazing. Perfect every single time. When my son moved to his own place, I gifted it to him and started researching one for me. Since I am the only coffee drinker in the house now (no, I'm not crying because he's gone, don't be silly) I considered a Keurig. But I honestly do not like the quality of the coffee from those machines - have tried several but it is not at all to my liking. However, the amount of wasted coffee I was dealing with really started bothering me and decided I needed an option for one cup. This machine is really perfect. The one cup option that I thought I settled for because it is a K cup option turned out to produce an amazing cup of coffee. I THINK it is because the Ninja makes three holes into the K cup rather than the standard one hole other machines use? It may also be the water temperature gets super hot. I do not know, but I really appreciate the depth of flavor from the K cup option on this machine. Another nice option that I never thought I'd want is the frother. It seems silly to me, but one comment in the Ninja manual stated that a cold cup with cream steals the heat from the coffee and changes the flavor - so I toyed around with the frother, using the microwave for 30 seconds and then blending the coffee and cream - its fantastic. This week I had a fever and opted for tea over coffee - I remembered the hot water option on this machine - it gave me two options - hot water and boil - I selected boil and my tea was steeping in no time at the perfect temperature. I absolutely appreciate that the water runs through a separate dispenser so my tea did not have any coffee residue or discoloration or flavor. I plan now to retire my stand alone boiler. The reservoir on the Ninja is adequate for my one cup daily - it is very easy to remove and fill or even fill while in place - I prefer the side option, but like that it can be attached to the back to save space. I don't think that would make much difference because this machine is very big - it does not fit under my standard cabinets. I bought this as a birthday gift for myself and if that last son hadn't left at the same time, I likely wouldn't have spent that much money on myself - but I was pitiful. I am extremely happy I did because the cost is worth it. I am very hopeful this machine will last past my 5 year expectation. Since I do not purchase coffee daily, I cannot state that I have saved money - I mean, I have because I'm not making half pots just for myself and wasting most of that - but if I were a coffee shop customer, I would absolutely think I'd save money with the frother thing and the quality of the coffee - It is really a great machine and I very highly recommend you purchase it. I was debating between the Keurig Duo Pro and this machine and given the quality of the K cup coffee from this, I haven't once looked back - there is no way in my mind the Keurig would produce the same quality cup from the K cups. Enjoy

reviews.title: Versatile Coffee Maker
reviews.body: We tried every aspect of the Ninja DualBrew Pro except espresso. My husband drinks coffee; I drink tea. Thumbs up on the Keurig pod coffee. The machine brewed HOT coffee with outstanding flavor. The boiling water feature for my tea boiled at least 2 ounces away in steam. I’m at 5500 feet altitude and had already performed the calibration process. The tea was so flavorful; much better than my normal BUT it was lukewarm even after heating the froth. LOVE the froth attachment. My husband’s coffee, brewed with the silver permanent coffee filter, was lukewarm. I tasted it, it was brewed on Rich and it was very tasty. I will try the heated coffee cup option but I’ve never had to do this previously with our little thermal carafe coffeemaker. I had it on delay but it never started at the designated time. I am finding the stopper for the coffee pot is difficult to seat on the pot. I’m not sure you could ever make espresso because the water does not get hot enough. So we’ve got pros and cons. It’s a beautifully designed machine that is so versatile but we like HOT coffee and tea. UPDATE: Changed to 5 stars. We generally brew coffee and tea one cup at a time. So the lukewarm issue pertains to carafe made coffee. When brewed with ceramic mugs, the coffee and tea is HOT. I think the "heated mug" option discussed in the instructions would resolve the lukewarm coffee/tea brewed in the carafe. Also, I resolved the Delay problem. It has to be done every night. I just assumed if it was set up and in Delay, it would work like my other coffee maker. You have to actually turn it on. After using the Ninja for a while, we both really love it. It makes outstanding coffee and tea and it's sort of fun to use. Update #2. After 1 month use, First, the coffeemaker would not “read” the pod adapter so could no longer brew pod coffee. Then while on the phone with Shark/Ninja customer service, the coffee feature went out. So now, I can only boil water. The customer service was excellent. I should have a new coffeemaker in 3-5 days, no shipping fees because it broke within 90 days. This reminds me of the Cuisinart toaster/airfryer/oven I got which did not work but the second one broke too. After spending so much time on the phone, I just gave it away. We’ll see if this coffeemaker makes it to the 1-year warranty without breaking. Still love it though. Update 2: received a new coffeemaker unit without any of the accessories within 3 days. The pod unit works perfectly. All the issues mentioned about lukewarm coffee does not seem to be a problem anymore probably due to single use in a ceramic mug. I really love this coffeemaker!

reviews.title: Excellent dual coffee maker
reviews.body: Have had Keurig, Cuisinart and other brands including other dual coffee makers and this is the best I've used so far. I mainly use the speciality and rich settings for a cup. Sometimes both for 1 large cup. Depending on time of day, cup size and mood. I don't use the provided carafe since I'm the only one drinking coffee. Also not a fan of iced coffee so that options a pass. Haven't tried the frother yet but I'm sure it's awesome and I will eventually give it a shot. Bonus for me is using size 4 filter and ground coffee for a 16 ounce cup. The cups I use are 14 to 20 ounces (variety for me is a need) and usually settle on 10 to 16 ounces for a cup. Use 2 pods (specialty+rich setting) or grounds or both for 1 cup. Again variety. This makes such good coffee that I would definitely purchase again. This is an expensive machine even on sale but I have no regrets with the purchase. Also on the larger side so may not fit under all cabinets. Very disappointed with the lack of a filter. Have purchased one and installed it already but the lack of one being provided is surprising. I have other Ninja appliances in my kitchen and hopefully I will be as happy with this one as I am with those long-term.

reviews.title: Excellent Coffee Brewer
reviews.body: I've been using Keurigs for many years but when I ran across the CFP301 on sale, I was intrigued enough to give it a try. I really liked how you could set so many brew sizes and the ability to brew 1/4 carafe if I wanted a few cups without having to make two individual cups. I actually planned to use it mostly with reusable pods, like I've always done with my Keurigs, so I ordered a set that would work with this machine (most will not). The pods I bought look to be good quality, but I've never used them. I've been using pods for so long it never clicked that with a machine like this, using reusable pods makes no sense whatsoever. Just use a regular filter, add your coffee and set the brew size to the size cup you want. But there's more. Much more. With a Keurig or other pod-style machine, you are limited by the size of the pod. They can work a little magic by slow-walking the brew for a travel mug, but it was always weaker than a standard cup and there was little you could do to remedy it except for maybe brewing two pods into one cup. With the Ninja, I can simply adjust the amount of coffee and select the desired brew size. Done. Delicious. This machine, like all of the Ninja products I own, is well engineered. The moveable tank is a fantastic idea and is easy to use. The flip-down cup holder? Awesome! The foldable frother? Very cool, and the way you can just pop it off over the cup to take it to the sink is slick. Even the "smart" scoop is a very nice touch. Everything is so easy to use and convenient. The carafe is well designed and easy to clean. The insert for the carafe ensures the hottest coffee is circulated from the bottom up. Nice! I've had no issues with the temperature of my coffee. It has been nice and hot every time and the hot plate under the carafe makes sure it stays that way. When using a thermal travel mug, I'll either let it cool for a few minutes or plop a small piece of ice into it. It's hot. For filters, I am using Melitta #4 and folding the seams as recommended by Ninja. These are affordable, especially if you buy them in multi-packs. The result is delicious, ground-free coffee. I've read several reviews complaining about grounds in their coffee, but they don't mention their particular setup. Are they using a permanent filter? Pods? I don't know, but I'm not getting any and I'm not sure how I could using the paper filters. As for any negatives, which I feel compelled to include in any review, the only things I can think of are insignificant. The build quality is great, but it is a lot of plastic. For the price-point, it's definitely as good as I think one could reasonably expect. As long as it holds up to plenty of use, it looks good, works very well and I'm happy with it. I do wish there was a little capacitor to power the clock temporarily during brief power outages or if you unplug it for a few minutes. This is a tiny complaint, but I already have two other clocks on other appliances in my kitchen and it's a minor nuisance having to reset all these clocks every time the power blips. I haven't had the machine long enough to do a long-term review but if anything changes, I will update my review. So far, I am very happy with my purchase and highly recommend it. Edit (11/2023): I've been using this coffee maker for five months now, and I would now be lost without it. I absolutely love the versatility. My most recent development was to dig out my old 34 oz. French press, which fits nicely under the filter basket. For the best, boldest coffee, I measure the proper amount of coffee into the press and add 24 oz. of hot water from the Ninja for my normal 2 12 oz. cups. Easiest way ever to use the press. If I need a whole pot or just quick cup, I just brew like normal. If someone has a favorite K-cup, the insert works as expected. Selecting the brew size for coffee or water has been consistent and accurate. I really, really love this coffee maker.

reviews.title: Great Coffee, But Not Perfect
reviews.body: Let it be known: I love coffee, things that make my life easier, and multi-functional products. Unfortunately for Ninja, I also love to criticize, and I certainly have some issues with this coffee maker. But before that, what's good about it? It is incredibly easy to switch from K-Cups, grounds, or hot water needs. Since I moved to grinding my own beans, I no longer have much of a use for the K-Cup adapter, but it is incredibly easy to use and clean. Strangely, Ninja didn't put notches in the K-Cup holder, so if it seals just right it will take some prying with fingernails to get the pod out, but as someone who doesn't really use it, I don't find it terribly annoying. I also really appreciate that this brewer uses a shower/fountain head for the grounds, since that way the water doesn't just drill down the middle of your coffee, and has the best chance to evenly disperse throughout the basket. So I don't want to get too long-winded on what's great, because this machine just has so many little things that I'd end up writing a dissertation, and I think other people have already covered what's great. What I do want to talk about, is the little things that stick out as "odd or annoying." My biggest complaint comes from the dial used to select brew sizes; not in its physical function, but what sizes Ninja has selected. It seems that Ninja decided to base their sizes on things like "A big cup" or "1/4 of a carafe," instead of actual "number of cups." Because of this, you get measurement options like 15 or 28oz. This is hardly the end of the world, but if you grind your own beans you have to end up doing some weird mental math for "well that's 2 cups and 3 oz, so 2.5 cups, which means I need 25 grams of beans......" Like I said, not the end of the world, just weird. What is another weird inconvenience is the Keep Warm button; it only lights up/lets you click it once you get into sizes it deems worthy of the carafe. And the smallest size? 28 ounces. So if you want to make 2-3 cups of coffee, but leave it in the carafe since you only want 1 cup now, you have to choose your batch size, wait for it to brew, and then turn the nob to 28oz so it will let you press Keep Warm. I understand the minimalism-chic choice to have as few things lit up as possible, but this is truly the definition of Form Over Function. Ninja won't let me keep 18 ounces of coffee warm because they decided I should just put it all in a big travel mug. Now, none of these issues would stop me from recommending this coffee maker. Coffee is such an expensive hobby/interest that a 150$ coffee maker is still technically mid-tier, so I don't expect it to be flawless. It has a lot of functionality that I think a lot of people will find enjoyable, and makes a great cup/carafe of coffee quickly and easily. But because of weird choices by Ninja I can't say it is a 5/5. It is a solid 4/5, and worth your time, but definitely not perfect.

reviews.title: An awesome single serve brewer that is about as perfect as it gets.
reviews.body: You're looking for a coffee maker. Maybe a big multi-cup jobber isn't right for you, and you're trying to pick between the many options available. I too was in the same boat and after being disappointed with a recent Keurig purchase (dang chemical taste), I decided to find something that might work better for me. I will be honest that I dug out an old single serve coffee maker. Think of one of those little brewers you'd see in a cheap hotel. However, it worked, and was easy to clean with the stainless screen. I just found the flavor a bit lacking, and it didn't brew hot enough for me. I do own a couple other Ninja appliances that have worked well, so when I saw they offered a single serve coffee maker that would take normal grounds and pods, I decided to pull the trigger. The biggest plus was it has a water tank, so I can fill it with filtered water and make many cups of coffee using without having to fill it each time. I opted for the XL version to get the added water capacity. Getting into using the machine, it was easy to set up. Washed a few parts and I was off to the coffee making races. I normally brew around 12 OZ, and I use Gavina coffee. SInce it's not exactly like my other single serve brewer, I knew I'd have to tweak the amount of grounds being used. I landed on two slightly mounded tablespoons for a 12 oz brew. In terms of the build quality, I really like it. I also like that I can fit my big coffee mug without any issues. That is one big factor that can irk me, not being able to use my travel mugs. However, this machine has no problem in that area. Nothing feels cheap on this machine, and it looks nice as well. So how does it brew? Great! It gets plenty hot and brews the best cup of coffee I've had in a long time. I first tried the classic mode and it was good. However, when I switched to the rich mode, wow. It really enhances the flavor of the coffee and tastes excellent. Also, unlike the Keurig brewers I've bought over the years, this one has ZERO chemical/plastic taste. Good to go. I did run about 5 cycles through the machine before using it though. This thing is awesome and I'm glad I bought it. I didn't test the frother since I normally don't froth anything, but in terms of it making a great cup of coffee, it's a winner. I also love that it saves settings in between uses. So if I dial it in for the way I like my coffee, it has the same settings the next day. SImple but many brewers do NOT offer this. In terms of critiques, I only have one. It's cleaning out the filter assembly after brewing. It has a diffuser lid and it just makes smacking the filter assembly to knock the grounds out more difficult. I wish the lid was designed differently, but it's a very minor annoyance. Besides that, this thing is a home run in my book. I hope it lasts, but I can tell you sipping on a cup of coffee I brewed with this machine, it's the best I've been able to brew from this Gavina blend. Updates: 1. The removable basket which holds the grounds has a diffuser for the hot water to distribute over the grounds. This is not just a clip on, it's a twist lock, and is a bit cumbersome if it comes loose. It fell off in the garbage can a few times until I realized you really had to push and give it a hard twist to lock it on the lid. 2. I have moved on to using disposable filters which greatly reduces cleanup time and also puts less sediment into the brewed coffee. ASIN: B0FQV6H53G 3. The brewer continues to work great. Super happy with it!

I do own a couple other Ninja appliances that have worked well, so when I saw they offered a single serve coffee maker that would take normal grounds and pods, I decided to pull the trigger. The biggest plus was it has a water tank, so I can fill it with filtered water and make many cups of coffee using without having to fill it each time. I opted for the XL version to get the added water capacity. Getting into using the machine, it was easy to set up. Washed a few parts and I was off to the coffee making races. I normally brew around 12 OZ, and I use Gavina coffee. SInce it's not exactly like my other single serve brewer, I knew I'd have to tweak the amount of grounds being used. I landed on two slightly mounded tablespoons for a 12 oz brew. In terms of the build quality, I really like it. I also like that I can fit my big coffee mug without any issues. That is one big factor that can irk me, not being able to use my travel mugs. However, this machine has no problem in that area. Nothing feels cheap on this machine, and it looks nice as well. So how does it brew? Great! It gets plenty hot and brews the best cup of coffee I've had in a long time. I first tried the classic mode and it was good. However, when I switched to the rich mode, wow. It really enhances the flavor of the coffee and tastes excellent. Also, unlike the Keurig brewers I've bought over the years, this one has ZERO chemical/plastic taste. Good to go. I did run about 5 cycles through the machine before using it though. This thing is awesome and I'm glad I bought it. I didn't test the frother since I normally don't froth anything, but in terms of it making a great cup of coffee, it's a winner. I also love that it saves settings in between uses. So if I dial it in for the way I like my coffee, it has the same settings the next day. SImple but many brewers do NOT offer this. In terms of critiques, I only have one. It's cleaning out the filter assembly after brewing. It has a diffuser lid and it just makes smacking the filter assembly to knock the grounds out more difficult. I wish the lid was designed differently, but it's a very minor annoyance. Besides that, this thing is a home run in my book. I hope it lasts, but I can tell you sipping on a cup of coffee I brewed with this machine, it's the best I've been able to brew from this Gavina blend. Updates: 1. The removable basket which holds the grounds has a diffuser for the hot water to distribute over the grounds. This is not just a clip on, it's a twist lock, and is a bit cumbersome if it comes loose. It fell off in the garbage can a few times until I realized you really had to push and give it a hard twist to lock it on the lid. 2. I have moved on to using disposable filters which greatly reduces cleanup time and also puts less sediment into the brewed coffee. ASIN: B0FQV6H53G 3. The brewer continues to work great. Super happy with it!

reviews.title: Best all around coffee maker
reviews.body: Haven't had a drip coffee maker of any kind for the last 10 years. I have been using a french press for the last five years and before that my coffee was made in a percolator. A friend introduced us to the variety available in coffee pods, which my wife loves, so that kind of made up my mind. The Ninja CFP301 seemed to have it all and it meant I could do coffee from grounds as well as from pods. We buy beans from a local roaster and the quality of the finished coffee matters a great deal along with the versatility of using k pods. I can't begin to say enough good things about our Ninja coffee maker. We keep 4 or 5 different types of coffee beans on hand and this machine has made great coffee from them all. The fact that it dispenses hot water for tea, etc as well as makes coffee is a bonus in a small kitchen, so no more kettle on the counter. The footprint of this machine is not as big as I feared so it fits well on our counter top. The brew styles work a charm as does the milk frother. OK, so you have to heat the milk up first in the microwave instead of steaming it hot...no problem. The 'Specialty' brew style is worth having the machine for all by itself. While it doesn't produce the crema that true espresso machines do, it makes a cup of espresso from ground coffee that looks, smells and tastes close enough to genuine espresso that making lattes and cappuccinos is easy and a great complement to my kitchen. The conversion from grounds coffee to k pods is simple and I even bought reusable pod capsules that work very well. If there is a con of any kind it's that the warming plate keeps the coffee a bit hotter than I like so that a pot of coffee doesn't age well. I turn it off after a few minutes. I heartily recommend this coffee maker and have done so to all of my coffee fanatic friends.

reviews.title: Nice brewer, but.....
reviews.body: Looks nice, works well. However..... It advertises a removable water filter with measurements on it in the water reservoir for the K cup. This doesn't have that, it has a plastic measurement piece that is screwed into the reservoir, but that's not a deal breaker for me. Love that it does not take forever to brew a 12 cup pot, and that it shuts off after 2 hours rather than burning the coffee in the carafe/pot. I DON'T like that you can't just turn it back on to continue keeping the coffee that is in the pot hot longer. Simply turning the maker back on does not turn the hot plate back on. Also, I don't like that just touching the hour or minute button, even accidently, changes the time on the clock. So, if you're not paying attention, you could change the time without even knowing it! And lastly, the measurement on the pot does NOT match the measurement in the water reservoir. If you put water in the pot up to the 12 cup line, it is only up to the 11 cup line in the reservoir. And if you add water to the reservoir to take it to the 12 cup line, it overfills the pot up to the top of the pot so it is spilling out before you can remove the pot from the hot plate. UPDATE: I purchased this on April 27th 2026, it is now July 11th 2026, the brew later light quit working about a month or so ago, and we noticed last night that the hot plate has developed crack in it, still seems to keep the pot hot for the 2 hours though.

reviews.title: Prettiest coffee maker I have ever owned!
reviews.body: This company has engineered the heck out of this coffee maker! They thought of everything. The size, finish and elegant digital display are the first of many impressive features. It includes a fine mesh filter for the carafe side and on the K cup side they included a fine mesh filter as well. So the single serve side will brew a K cup or your own bulk purchased coffee grounds. The plate that the cup sits on is stainless not plastic and they curved the back side as well. It just shows how much thought was put into the design. I could go on but let me say that I have purchased two Keurig K Duos in two years at $200 each. I said never again but when the second one went I ordered this one and then went to Walmart and ended up getting a K Duo because I had to have one. Now that I have received this beauty I packed up the Keurig. It’s now in the garage. I’ll keep it in case this one goes on the fritz. I’m tempted to get another one of these just to have on hand because I just like it so much! For everyone but especially those who want a beautiful coffee maker for their cute coffee bar; don’t hesitate to grab this or at the least put it on your special occasion wish list. Lastly, I haven’t brewed a cup yet but given the attention to detail that they put into this machine, I have no worries. I’ll have a delicious cup of coffee in the morning. You will not be disappointed if you purchase this coffee maker. It functions differently from the Keurig but I’m so over them. Hope this honest review will help you make a decision. UPDATE: This coffee ot crapped out this morning. It won’t brew. We have softened water so I don’t understand why it only last just under 1 year. We loved this pot so very disappointed!

title: Hamilton Beach FlexBrew Trio 2-Way Drip & Single Serve Coffee Maker
bullet_points: 3 WAYS TO BREW: Brew a single cup with a pod or coffee grounds or brew up to 12 cups using your favorite ground coffee. To brew one serving, you have the option to brew up to a 10 oz. cup with a pod or brew up to 14 oz., 7" tall travel mug with coffee grounds.

FAST BREWING — BREW A SINGLE CUP IN ABOUT 90 SECONDS. In the morning, every second counts. Unlike 3 way coffee makers of the past, the FlexBrew Trio Coffee Maker prepares a single cup in in 90 seconds so you have more time to enjoy your coffee.

BREW 7 SINGLE SERVINGS WITHOUT REFILLING THE 56 OZ. WATER RESERVOIR. Brew a single cup of coffee without stopping to pour water. In addition to its fast 90-second brewing, the removable water reservoir saves you time because it needs fewer refills.

WAKE-UP READY COFFEE WITH EASY-TOUCH PROGRAMMING. When you brew coffee into the 12 cup carafe, you can wake up to hot coffee by setting up Easy-Touch programming the night before. The backlit display makes it easy to view the time and settings.

5 SINGLE-SERVE SIZES TO CHOOSE FROM: Customize the brewing size to your cup. Simply select 6, 8, 10, 12 or 14 oz. before you brew with ground coffee or choose 6, 8 or 10 oz. when brewing with a pod — you'll get the perfect amount in your cup.

reviews.title: Great replacement
reviews.body: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ I recently purchased the Trio 2-Way Coffee Maker, and it has quickly become an indispensable part of my morning routine. Here's why I'm giving this versatile coffee machine a glowing five-star review: **Versatility and Convenience:** The Trio 2-Way Coffee Maker lives up to its name by offering an incredible level of versatility. Whether I'm in the mood for a single cup or need a full carafe for the morning rush, this machine has me covered. The ability to switch between brewing methods with ease is a game-changer for a household with diverse coffee preferences. **Quality of Coffee:** One of my initial concerns was whether the convenience of a 2-way brew system would compromise the quality of the coffee. I was pleasantly surprised to find that this was not the case. Both the single-serve and carafe options produce rich, flavorful coffee that satisfies my coffee shop-quality expectations. **Ease of Use:** The Trio 2-Way Coffee Maker is remarkably user-friendly. The intuitive interface allows me to select my brewing preference without fuss, and the clear markings for water levels eliminate any guesswork. The simplicity of switching between brewing modes means I can enjoy my preferred coffee style with minimal effort. **Sleek Design:** Not only is this coffee maker highly functional, but it also boasts a sleek and modern design that looks great on my countertop. The compact footprint is a significant plus, considering its dual functionality. It's a stylish addition to my kitchen without taking up unnecessary space. **Durability and Cleaning:** After several weeks of use, the Trio 2-Way Coffee Maker has proven to be durable and easy to maintain. The components are sturdy and well-made. Cleaning is a breeze, especially with the removable parts being dishwasher safe. This ease of maintenance ensures that the machine continues to perform at its best. **Eco-Friendly Options:** I appreciate the eco-friendly aspect of being able to use a reusable filter for the single-serve option. It's a great way to reduce waste and save money on disposable pods. The inclusion of this feature reflects a thoughtful consideration for both the user and the environment. **Value for Money:** Given its dual functionality, ease of use, and the quality of coffee it produces, the Trio 2-Way Coffee Maker offers excellent value for money. It's a versatile appliance that caters to all my coffee needs without requiring multiple devices. In conclusion, the Trio 2-Way Coffee Maker has exceeded my expectations in every way. It combines versatility, convenience, and quality into one sleek machine. I really hope his one lasts longer than the last one. If it doesn't, I will probably look for an upgraded pot with the same carafe. Good luck!

reviews.title: Great Value and Great Customer Service
reviews.body: We initially purchased the coffee maker in March 2024 and rated it 2 stars because it worked well and then it completely failed within about three months. We're updating the rating and giving it 5 stars because Black & Decker was really great about replacing it for us and the new one has been working exactly as it should for at least a year since then. In the past, we've purchased much pricier coffeemakers, but now that we're retired and far more budget conscious, this coffee maker is perfectly fine -- even for total bougie coffee snobs. Our coffee tastes pretty great! It's a standard 12-cup model, reasonably quiet, the brewing time is reasonable, the coffee stays hot in the pot and we've had no leakage problems or any other issues. This coffeemaker really is a pretty great value for the money.

title: PHILIPS 5500 Series Fully Automatic Espresso Machine, LatteGo Milk System
bullet_points: 20 PRESETS, ENDLESS COMBINATIONS: Hot drinks like espresso, coffee, lattes, and cappuccinos, to iced coffee, or simply hot water, take your pick. Top your coffee with silky smooth milk with our proprietary milk system.

YOUR COFFEE IN ONE TOUCH, TAILORED TO YOU: Automatically grinds, tamps and brews at the push of a buttonon the intuitive color display. Adjust strength, volume and milk preferences and save up to 4 profiles to return to your favorites each time.

LATTEGO PROPRIETARY MILK SYSTEM: Frothed. Foamed. Your milk, your way, automatically. LatteGo is the fastest to clean milk system ever: 3 parts, no internal tubes or hidden compartments. Dishwasher safe or can be rinsed clean in 10 seconds.

reviews.title: Pricey up front, but saves money for us in the long run, and the coffee is great!
reviews.body: Wow, I'm really happy with the Philips 5500 for our home. The taste of the coffee drinks are far above the pods we were using. I recommend watching some videos to see how to adjust the machine so that the coffee is to your taste and not too bitter or too watery, etc. I love the customization options because all of us have different preferences. Everything is really easy to clean and take care of. This has replaced four separate machines for my coffee drinking family - a Nespresso, a Keurig, a plain coffee machine, and a separate milk frother. It takes up a lot less space, and it's quiet. It's easy to use, even for older people. It's not a cheap machine, but we were spending a small fortune on individual coffee pods for our family of coffee drinkers. The cost of the beans is a lot less than buying pods. The machine itself is also really quick compared to our old suite of machines. I hope that it ends up reliable in the long run.

reviews.title: Con descuentos, GENIAL por donde lo veas.
reviews.body: No pensé que una cafetera pudiera cambiar tanto mi rutina, pero la Philips S5500 LatteGo lo logró. Preparar café con grano fresco es tan sencillo como apretar un botón. En segundos tienes un espresso con crema perfecta y lo disfrutas sin preocuparte por limpiar nada de inmediato. Esa comodidad es lo que más me enganchó. -Café con grano fresco y sabor consistente -Preparación rápida y sin complicaciones -Sistema LatteGo fácil de limpiar -Diseño elegante que luce en la cocina -Gran ahorro al comprarla en promoción El único detalle que me parece mejorable es el depósito de agua: se queda corto si tomas varias tazas al día. No es un problema grave, pero sí algo que notas en el uso cotidiano. Entre el sabor, la comodidad y el precio que conseguí con descuentos, puedo decir sin duda que fue una compra redonda. El depósito pequeño es un detalle, pero no opaca la experiencia general.
reviews.body_en: I didn't think a coffee maker could change my routine so much, but the Philips S5500 LatteGo did it. Preparing coffee with fresh beans is as simple as pressing a button. In seconds you have a perfect espresso with crema and you enjoy it without worrying about cleaning anything right away. That comfort is what hooked me the most. -Coffee with fresh grain and consistent flavor -Quick and uncomplicated preparation -Easy to clean LatteGo system -Elegant design that looks great in the kitchen -Great savings when buying it on sale The only detail that I think could be improved is the water tank: it falls short if you drink several cups a day. It's not a serious problem, but it is something you notice in everyday use. Between the taste, the convenience and the price I got with discounts, I can say without a doubt that it was a great purchase. The small tank is a detail, but it doesn't overshadow the overall experience.

reviews.title: Ni por error
reviews.body: La linea tiene bastantes problemas con la calidad de extracción. Por supuesto, esta máquina no dará la misma calidad que una máquina de espresso, pero por su precio esperas un producto de calidad que funcione a la primera. Si quisiera dedicarle hora y media para afinar el molino, hubiera comprado una semi automática. En fin. Mi máquina en particular se presentó sin hacer buen sello en la extracción y por lo tanto el resultado era más como agua de calcetín que un café. Me llevo tan mala experiencia que rechacé el intercambio. No compren ni por error.
reviews.body_en: The line has quite a few problems with extraction quality. Of course, this machine will not give the same quality as an espresso machine, but for its price you expect a quality product that works first time. If I wanted to spend an hour and a half fine-tuning the grinder, I would have bought a semi-automatic. In the end. My particular machine came without a good seal during extraction and therefore the result was more like sock water than coffee. I had such a bad experience that I rejected the exchange. Don't buy even by mistake.

reviews.title: toller Sitzkomfort& hochwertige Verarbeitung
reviews.body: Kurz in eigener Sache: Der DPD Fahrer behauptete einfach das ich nicht da war und lieferte das Paket an einen Shop. Ärgerlich, schlimmer noch ich bin Schlaganfallpatient! So musste ich dann das sperrige Paket zu Fuß abholen, da der DPD Fahrer zu faul war bis an die Tür (1. Etage) zu liefern. Der Verkäufer hat wirklich sehr nett reagiert und mir von sich aus Rabatt für meine Unannehmlichkeiten gewährt. Ein sehr freundlicher Kontakt und auch der Service ist herausragend! Nun zum Gaming Stuhl: Der Aufbau und die Montage des Stuhls waren wirklich einfach, auch benötigt man nur das einzige mitgelieferte Werkzeug. Es gibt einen QR-CODE das ein Aufbau Video zur Verfügung stellt, praktisch, aber es geht auch ohne sehr gut. Nach etwa einer halben Stunde war der Gaming Stuhl aufgebaut und konnte benutzt werden. Der Stuhl ist wirklich komfortabel, für meinen Rücken der sehr empfindlich ist optimal. Gerade das Lendenwirbel-Kissen unterstützt den Rücken optimal bei längeren Gaming Sessions, bei mir sind es LKW Fahrten im Simulatorbereich. Ich nutze ein Lenkrad mit Pedalen, daher habe ich hohe Anforderungen, die ich an einem Gaming Stuhl stelle. Auch das Nackenkissen lässt sich variabel verschieben, so wird der Nacken gut gestützt! Dieser Stuhl bietet wahnsinnig viele Anpassungsmöglichkeiten und Einstellungen, genau das habe ich gesucht! Ich bin 1.74cm groß und die Maße des Stuhls sind optimal für mich. Auch die Beinauflage kommt mir sehr entgegen, bei größeren Menschen könnte diese nicht mehr gut passen. Das sollte man vielleicht vor dem Kauf beachten! Der Gaming Stuhl hat einen mittleren Härtegrad, man versinkt nicht darin, aber es ist jederzeit bequem auch nach längerer Nutzung. Der Clou ist natürlich die abnehmbare Rückseite, so das man im Sommer nicht festklebt! Dann ist der Rückenbereich luftig und die Wärme kann zirkulieren. Dafür verzichte ich gerne auf eine Massage Funktion, denn der Designer hat hier eine wesentliche Verbesserung des Komforts erreicht. Mein Gaming Computer erzeugt eine Menge Hitze, die heißen Sommer tun das übrige und schon klebt man in handelsüblichen Gaming Stühlen förmlich fest. Durch das Netzgewebe in der Rückenlehne kann nun der Ventilator die Luft verteilen, eine super Sache wie ich finde. So behält man stets einen kühlen Kopf beim zocken und ein Massage Kissen kann man für 10€ nachrüsten falls erforderlich. Der Stuhl eignet sich auch gut als TV Sessel, dieser lässt sich wunderbar nach hinten klappen. Äußerst bequem mit der Beinauflage! Auch ein kleines Nickerchen ist möglich, ohne danach gleich einen Chiropraktiker zu benötigen. Die Rollen sind leichtgängig, unangenehme Geräusche des Stuhls im Allgemeinen sind mir noch nicht aufgefallen. Die Nähte sind sehr sauber verarbeitet und der Gaming Stuhl wirkt ästhetisch hochwertig, wie ein Sportsitz im Auto. Ähnlich ist auch der Seitenhalt, die Armlehnen sind breit und angenehm gepolstert! Fazit: Für mich persönlich ein rundum gelungenes Produkt von hoher Qualität und zu einem vernünftigen Preis dazu. Der abnehmbare Rückenbezug ist eine super Idee und äußerst praktisch für die heißen Sommer! Der Komfort des Gaming Stuhls ist meiner Meinung nach sehr hoch, die Ästhetik kommt auch nicht zu kurz, tolles Design gepaart mit sauberer Verarbeitung! Schwachpunkte konnte ich bisher nicht ausmachen, Haltbarkeit kann ich noch nicht bewerten. Der Service stimmt, sollte ich wieder ähnliches Gaming Zubehör benötigen, ist der Verkäufer sicher mein erster Ansprechpartner! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ absolut verdient und ich empfehle dieses Produkt gerne weiter.
reviews.body_en: Briefly on my own behalf: The DPD driver simply claimed that I wasn't there and delivered the package to a shop. Annoying, worse than that, I'm a stroke patient! So I had to pick up the bulky package on foot because the DPD driver was too lazy to deliver it to the door (1st floor). The seller responded really nicely and gave me a discount for my inconvenience. A very friendly contact and the service is also outstanding! Now about the gaming chair: Setting up and assembling the chair was really easy, and you only need the only tool provided. There is a QR CODE that provides a setup video, practical, but it works very well without it. After about half an hour the gaming chair was set up and could be used. The chair is really comfortable, ideal for my back, which is very sensitive. The lumbar pillow in particular supports the back optimally during longer gaming sessions, for me it's truck rides in the simulator area. I use a steering wheel with pedals, so I have high demands on a gaming chair. The neck pillow can also be moved variably, so the neck is well supported! This chair offers an incredible amount of customization options and settings, which is exactly what I was looking for! I am 1.74cm tall and the dimensions of the chair are optimal for me. The leg rest also suits me very well; it might not fit well for taller people. You might want to consider this before purchasing! The gaming chair has a medium level of hardness, you don't sink into it, but it is always comfortable even after long periods of use. The highlight is of course the removable back, so you don't get stuck in the summer! Then the back area is airy and the heat can circulate. I'm happy to forego a massage function because the designer has achieved a significant improvement in comfort here. My gaming computer generates a lot of heat, the hot summers do the rest and you're literally stuck in standard gaming chairs. Thanks to the mesh fabric in the backrest, the fan can now distribute the air, a great thing in my opinion. This way you can always keep a cool head while gaming and you can add a massage pillow for €10 if necessary. The chair is also suitable as a TV armchair; it can be folded back wonderfully. Extremely comfortable with the leg rest! It is also possible to take a short nap without needing to see a chiropractor straight away. The wheels move smoothly and I haven't noticed any unpleasant noises from the chair in general. The seams are very neatly processed and the gaming chair looks aesthetically high-quality, like a sports seat in a car. The side support is similar, the armrests are wide and comfortably padded! Conclusion: For me personally, an all-round successful product of high quality and at a reasonable price. The removable back cover is a great idea and extremely practical for the hot summers! In my opinion, the comfort of the gaming chair is very high, the aesthetics are not neglected either, great design paired with clean workmanship! I haven't been able to identify any weak points yet and I can't rate durability yet. The service is good, if I need similar gaming accessories again, the seller will definitely be my first point of contact! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ absolutely deserved and I am happy to recommend this product.

Bottom line: worth the buy and seems good quality for the price but I’ll see how it hold up when I bring it to the office for actual use.

title: Gaming Chair for Adults Gamer Game Ergonomic PC Chair, 7-Point Support
bullet_points: 【7-Point Precision Support – Total Body Relief】Extended sitting takes a toll on more than just your back. JECQCUPG engineered a complete 7-point support system that addresses seven critical zones: head, neck, shoulders, back, lumbar, hips, and legs. Each zone receives targeted pressure distribution to encourage proper spinal alignment and steady blood flow. The headrest and lumbar cushion adjust independently to fit heights from 120cm to 190cm. Whether you're locked into a gaming session or grinding through work hours, this system keeps fatigue at bay so you stay sharp and comfortable.

【51cm Wingless Seat – Sit Any Way You Like】Narrow seats with bulky side bolsters force your legs into unnatural positions. JECQCUPG removes those barriers with a flat, wingless cushion that spans a full 51cm – a full 13cm wider than the typical 38cm effective seat width found on standard chairs. The generous surface invites you to sit cross-legged, sideways, or however feels natural. High-density, high-rebound foam filling resists flattening, so your hips and thighs enjoy consistent cushioning without annoying pressure points. Comfort that adapts to you, not the other way around.

【Sofa-Grade Cushioning – Foam Meets Pocket Springs】Most gaming chairs rely on a single layer of foam that breaks down within months. JECQCUPG takes a smarter approach: dual-layer high-density foam paired with durable pocket springs – a construction borrowed from premium sofas. This combination delivers a plush yet supportive feel that cradles your body while preventing bottoming-out. The breathable PU leather cover resists scratches, wipes clean in seconds, and holds its shape through years of daily use. It's the kind of comfort that makes you forget you're sitting in an office chair.

【Synchronized Armrests + 3 Recline Angles】Three optimized angles – 90° for focused work, 110° for casual browsing, and 135° for full relaxation – give you the flexibility to switch postures throughout the day. But JECQCUPG goes further: the armrests are synchronized to tilt automatically with the backrest. Your arms stay supported at every recline angle, preventing shoulder strain and awkward positioning. The seat height adjusts up to 10cm, accommodating everyone from teenagers to tall adults. One chair, three modes, endless comfort.

【Steel-Reinforced Build – 150kg Capacity, Easy Assembly】Flimsy frames lead to squeaks, wobbles, and premature failure. JECQCUPG is built around a one-piece steel frame and a reinforced 5-star base – with steel thickness 3mm greater than most competing models. Tested to support 150kg, it offers a stable, secure sit for users ranging from 120cm to 185cm. Smooth-gliding, floor-friendly casters roll silently across any surface. Assembly is quick and frustration-free thanks to clear illustrated instructions and a complete tool set. Backed by responsive customer support – we've got you covered from unboxing to everyday use.

title: Gaming Chair for Adults with Footrest, Ergonomic Computer Chair, 330 lb
bullet_points: [52cm Wide Seat with 4-Layer Pocket Spring Cushion] Tired of chairs that sink easily after long use? This gaming chair has a 52cm wide seat, wider than common 45-48cm gaming chairs. You can sit cross-legged or stretch your legs freely and comfortably.The 12cm thick cushion has a 4-layer structure: bottom support foam, independent pocket springs, high-bounce sponge and soft top surface. It stays firm and supportive even after hours of sitting. It supports up to 150 kilograms under normal use.

[Full-Body Ergonomic Support for Neck & Waist] Long hours of gaming or office work often make your neck stiff and your waist tired. The high backrest follows the natural S-curve of your back. It comes with two removable pillows for your head and waist, and you can adjust their position up and down freely to reduce pressure.Your shoulders, back and waist all get steady support, so you can stay comfortable even when sitting for a long time.

[Linkage Armrests That Move with the Backrest] The armrests of common chairs stay still when you recline the back, which makes your arms feel stiff. Our chair’s armrests are linked with the backrest. They will adjust their angle automatically when you lean back.Whether you sit at 90° for focused work, 115° for casual relaxation or 135° for resting, your arms always rest in a natural position. You do not need to adjust the armrests by hand again and again.

[90°-135° Adjustable Backrest with Pull-Out Footrest] You can lock the backrest at 90°, 115° or 135°. It fits different daily scenes including work, gaming and rest. When you want to relax, just pull out the built-in footrest to stretch your body and lie down comfortably.The chair comes with a tested gas lift rod, and the seat height can be adjusted from 48cm to 58cm. Quiet universal wheels slide smoothly on wooden floors, carpets and tiles, and they will not easily scratch the floor.

[Wear-Resistant Tech Fabric & Easy 30-Minute Assembly] The chair is covered with soft and breathable tech fabric. It is scratch-resistant and wear-resistant, and you can wipe off dirt directly. It will not fade easily or crack on the surface with long daily use.We provide all installation parts and a multi-language illustrated manual. Most people can finish the assembly within 30 minutes. Our customer service team is available 24 hours a day to help you with any questions.

reviews.title: Those legs are ANNOYING to assemble, but otherwise decent chair
reviews.body: The hardest part about putting this thing together is the legs. It says "slap on floor" or something to get the screw holes to line up. THEY WON'T! What you really need to do is get it as close as possible to lining up, then put the bolt in at an angle but DO NOT SCREW IT IN! Put the tool into the bolt and then use the two to press inwards and kinda pry back the leg piece until the bolt stands upright like it should. THEN screw it in! A screwdriver won't work because it tends to slide right back out if you aren't holding it in place when you start to screw in the bolt. So when you remove the screwdriver to put the bolt in, you'll lose the alignment anyway. And you need the tool (included with it) in the bolt to be able to apply enough pressure while at an angle to "catch" the screw hole before pulling it into line. HEAD. ACHE. Aside from that, here's my assessment of the chair's use compared to about 4 or 5 others that I've used in my lifetime: The assembly is easy and straightforward after you get those leg screw holes lined up. The arms seem to be shorter in length and height than some other chairs I've had. But that's a good thing for me because when the seat is at the correct height, the arms of other chairs were rubbing against the underside of my *GLASS* top desk. Occasionally that little bit of give in the chair when I get up or descent when I sit down would snap the arms against the glass of my desk, and it always sounded like I would break it. Thankfully, I didn't. Also, I love the fabric covering! I ordered this specifically for that one reason. The one I'm about to throw out now has the typical vinyl covering and as it aged, it cracked, especially on the arm rests, and my arms were getting torn up by it! While this cloth will also wear over time (especially being microfiber), it shouldn't create sharp vinyl pieces to scratch up my arms, so that's a plus! The back of the chair has a really thick dense foam that isn't quite conforming to my spine just yet. It's going to take some wearing in to really feel comfy. My worry is that once it breaks down enough to wear in, the foam may deteriorate very quickly afterwards. That's something to watch for in the future though. The arms may have a lighter foam, or maybe the foam just conforms better to sharper points, like elbows. But they seem to have more give to them, for which ever reason. The back also doesn't lean back as far as some gaming chairs I have had. That could be bad for me as I sometimes get *very random* vertigo and need to lie flat for a few minutes until it goes away. With this chair, I'll probably have to stumble to a couch or bed to lie down if it happens. The seat itself is not too long or short either. I've had some that were short enough I felt like I would fall off the front of the chair. And others that were so long that when I saw back, my knees were ON the seat of the chair. This one is, thankfully, right in between. The foot rest isn't anything special nor bad, but it "attaches" in the slides with a bolt on the back of one side. That will make it easy to remove when it's time to buy another chair. With the exception of the gas lift, most of this will be easy to take apart to fit inside of a large trash collection container when it's time for that. (Yes, I've gone through enough chairs for that to be a concern now!) I never use the lumbar supports, so I can't give any information on that.

reviews.title: Great chair, amazing customer service after sale
reviews.body: This chair is a great quality but what's even better is the customer service. The chair lives in my teenagers Game Room AKA bedroom. It has withstood 7 months of hard use. He has been known to sleep in it and to have his 60 lb dogs sitting in his lap. Seriously this chair has taking some abuse. Approximately 8 months after we got it one of the arms broke off.. probably because my son was leaning to heavily on it. I contacted the manufacturer, sent them pictures and they immediately sent us a new arm rest and back of the chair because the armrest had ripped the leather of the back when it broke. From the pictures they also noticed that the lumbar support was misshapen (because of abuse) and offered to send a new one of those as well. When the items shipped, free of charge, they sent us a tracking number and even followed up after we received it to make sure everything was okay. I will definitely be a repeat customer of this company!

reviews.title: For less than $90 this chair is a steal. Takes around 30 minutes by yourself to assemble.
reviews.body: (Note - I was going to buy another one for daughter, it went up to $159.99 in 2-3 days! Might still get it but this chair is awesome especially for sale price from few days ago) For less than $100 this chair is awesome. I’ve seen reviews stating it took an hour or even longer to assemble…no. I am not a handyman whatsoever and it took me about 30 minutes to completely assemble. Maybe 45 minutes unboxing and separating pieces to make sure I had everything. Easiest chair I have ever put together. Instructions are clear and very simple. As for the chair overall; it is not a $500 gaming chair with top of the line materials. If you pay >$90 for a gaming chair (this chair) do not expect it to withstand years of abuse. If you are careful around it, it should last plenty of time. If you game 10 hours a day and constantly adjust the seat roughly, it will probably last a couple years. For my 11 year old it is perfect. He isn’t allowed to game 10 hours a day so it should last longer than 2 years. If it lasts 2 years I will have gotten more than enough value for what I paid. I’m 6ft tall and overweight and it is comfortable for me. My son sat in it and he loves it. My 17 year old daughter sat in it and now she wants one. Why not! Reclining ability is good. It does not lay down completely flat but more than enough. Foot rest is simple and not bad if you are not 6.5ft or taller. The chair has a very comfortable firmness and isn’t too firm either. It fits my 5ft and change 11 year old and my 5.5ft 17 year old. And my heavy 6ft never mind how old. For the price, this chair is a great buy.

reviews.title: Looks Great, But Comfort and Build Quality Are Just Average
reviews.body: I’ve been using this chair for a little while now, and I have mixed feelings about it. First, the design is definitely one of its strongest points. It looks great, especially if you’re going for a gaming or modern office setup. It has a clean, sporty look, and from a distance it honestly looks more expensive than it is. That said, once you get up close, the overall build quality isn’t quite as impressive. The finishes could definitely be better. There are a few small details that make it feel a bit cheaper than I expected, and the materials don’t really give off a premium feel. It’s not terrible by any means, but you can tell where some corners were cut. As for comfort, I’d give it about a 7/10. It’s perfectly usable for everyday work or gaming sessions, but it’s not one of those chairs you immediately sink into and never want to leave. After a few hours, I definitely notice that it’s more of a budget chair than an ergonomic one. Overall, I think it’s a fair value for the money. If you’re expecting premium quality or all-day comfort, you may be a little disappointed. But if you’re shopping in this price range and mainly want something that looks good and gets the job done, it’s a reasonable choice. Just keep your expectations realistic.

reviews.title: Cute and durable Vanity Chair that my teenager loves!
reviews.body: This chair is absolutely stunning to look at and looks beautiful in my daughter’s room, and I believe this vanity chair would work in any type of room. The color of this chair is neutral, and that is why I think that this chair will look cute with any color scheme. The chair itself is a beautiful creamy white color, and the base around the wheels is white with black wheels. The instructions included were very easy to follow, and I was able to put this chair together in less than 30 minutes all by myself. Each part of the chair was packaged separately and easy to assemble. You can easily locate each piece and follow along with the instructions. The instructions included have pictures of each section, and that made putting this chair together very simple. This product included all of the tools needed to complete the chair and also includes spare parts if you need them later. The chair also comes with a plush pillow that looks very cute when not in use. The included pillow is full and plush and very firm. When my daughter or I are using the chair, we remove the pillow because it’s not as comfortable with a firm pillow behind our back. The chair feels soft to the touch, and the fabric seems to be high quality and strong enough to withstand use for extended periods of time. The chair moves up and down and can be adjusted in height according to your needs. You can sit on the chair and grab the handle underneath, and it moves up and down smoothly without any issues. The chair can spin around all the way, and it’s not loose. It stays in place when I sit in the chair, and it doesn’t wobble or move without me moving my feet to have the seat of the chair in the position I like. The seat of the chair is firm and comfortable for sitting comfortably while putting on my makeup. I love that this vanity chair has a wide back to it because it makes me feel safe when I lean back, and I don’t have to worry about falling out of the chair. It also is nice to have a wide back on the chair to lean back on and relax. The value of this vanity chair is worth the investment right now because of the quality of the materials and how well made this product is. I do think that this chair will last a long time and retain its shape and firmness because it is meant to be used occasionally each week for short periods of time. I do believe that each part of the chair was made with high-quality materials and exceptional craftsmanship.

reviews.title: I think I have too much badonka in my donk for this chair
reviews.body: Too much junk in my trunk? Too much loot in my boot? Too much dump in my truck? I think you get the point by now. Anyway, that's not the fault of the chair. I love the scalloped look to this thing, but even with the throw pillow out of the way it rather feels like I'm sliding forward out of the chair. I wanted this to replace the chair I've been using at my vanity because the metal backing keeps coming loose and it's not on wheels. I had hoped this petal vanity chair would fill the bill. I've been losing weight, so perhaps it will become a non-issue. The one thing I will address that IS an issue with the chair is you play merry hell trying to reach for the lift level. Somehow, with how it's attached, it is both too close in to the center of the chair, and somehow too far back when you're actually sitting in the chair. We have another chair from FIDOM that is a shop/garage chair without such a problem, and we really like that chair. So it was a little disappointing to realize they'd left the lift handle too short and out of reach. That said, much like the shop/garage chair, it was super easy to put together and rolls quite readily across the floor, whether flat floor or carpeting. If you aren't suffering from big bootyitis I would say this chair is worth the asking price. Just try to limit how often you need to adjust the height, since it'll be a bit of a pain to do so.

reviews.title: Ridiculous dangling pump
reviews.body: This is a nice chair and is priced decently. I'll start off with my biggest gripe- that awkward, dangling pump. It literally looks like the manual aneroid sphygmomanometer (blood pressure cuff) that dangled on a doctor's office wall, except it is dangling off of your office chair. It's an eye sore, it looks misplaced, and my toddler won't stop squeezing it. You can definitely feel the lumbar support puff up when you pump it which is nice and all, but it's just a silly design and they could have at least made the pump more discreet or figured out a way to store it without it literally just dangling around. I have half a mind to just cut mine off and forego the lumbar pump because it looks just that ridiculous. Our office space is in a visible area of our home and the pump is just so silly looking. The rest of the chair is very nice- very clean looking aesthetic, comfortable and adjustable. This doesn't have all the bells and whistles that some other pricier office chairs have, but it looks clean and gives enough support for working and sitting. I just honestly thought the pump would be able to be hidden instead of dangling like a child and cat toy.

These are inconvenient design details, but they do not take away from the chair’s overall comfort. The heavy-duty base and substantial construction seem durable enough for regular use. At $259.99, this is an investment, but the size, comfort, adjustability, and supportive design help justify the price. Overall, it is a comfortable, well-built chair with only a couple of minor issues.

reviews.title: Don't throw out the box, you'll need it
reviews.body: I ordered the Nouhaus Strato ergonomic office chair to replace the one I've had for 6 years. The seat was beginning to feel uncomfortable and it was getting squeaky when I got up from it. To start with the cons- although the directions seemed to be clear to follow, it's only images and no words. I've got bad eyesight and couldn't make heads or tails of what direction things went. I assembled and disassembled the chair about 3 times before I got it correct. I also destroyed all the packaging before I began which was a HUGE mistake. The instructions recommend using the box to help with assembly and it would have made it much, much easier had I known ahead of time. So if you're reading this take note! My last cons are with the chair itself. First, I am prone to sciatic pain and after one 8 hour work day in the chair, I could feel a flare up coming on. Fortunately, it's the weekend so I am not sitting anymore. I'm going to add some cushioning to it to see if that helps. The arm rests tilt in and out for comfort which I like but they move so easily if you bear any weight on them and push in or out. I do this alot so I'm going to have to adjust how I sit and reposition to limit this happening. OK for the pro's... the chair glides easily across the floor. The base has adjustable height like most but it feels very sturdy like it won't start to slowly lower as you sit. You all know what I'm referring to. The back also allows for reclining. When locked upright it helps with posture and didn't hurt my upper back. On reclining, you can lock in how far back it goes and it's very, very comfortable. So much so I could take a nap in it during breaks. The mesh seat feels supportive and well made. I'm hoping it holds up as long as my last one. The size of the seat is adequate too. As a larger person, I don't feel like I'm stuck in the chair but have room to breathe. Overall, office chairs are a necessity for many. If you're looking for comfort and something that should last a while, this is a good option albeit a little pricey. I think it's well made and compatible to the prices you pay for other chairs.

reviews.title: Exceptional Ergonomic Chair for Work, Gaming, and Every Day Use
reviews.body: I purchased the Nouhaus Strato Ergonomic Office Chair after spending countless hours at my desk each day, and it has been one of the best office chair investments I've made. From the moment I assembled it, I could tell it was designed with comfort, adjustability, and long-term support in mind. The ergonomic features are outstanding. The adjustable headrest, height-adjustable backrest, and dynamic lumbar support work together to provide excellent posture support throughout the day. I especially appreciate how easy it is to customize the chair to fit my body. The 3D armrests allow adjustments in multiple directions, making it easy to find a comfortable position whether I'm typing, attending meetings, gaming, or simply relaxing between tasks. The breathable mesh design is another major advantage. Unlike traditional padded chairs that can become warm after several hours, the mesh back promotes airflow and keeps me comfortable even during long work sessions. The high-back design provides full upper-body support, helping reduce neck, shoulder, and back fatigue. I was also impressed by the chair's build quality. It feels sturdy, durable, and well-engineered. The rolling casters glide smoothly, and the reclining mechanism operates effortlessly while still feeling secure and stable. Whether I'm sitting upright for focused work or leaning back during breaks, the chair remains comfortable and supportive. Assembly was straightforward, with clear instructions and well-packaged components. Once assembled, the chair had a premium look and feel that immediately elevated the appearance of my workspace. The sleek black design fits perfectly in both professional office environments and home gaming setups. One small drawback is that all of the adjustable features may require a little time to fine-tune initially. However, once everything is adjusted properly, the level of comfort is well worth the effort. Additionally, the premium design may come at a higher price point than basic office chairs, but the ergonomic benefits and build quality justify the investment. Overall, the Nouhaus Strato Ergonomic Office Chair delivers exceptional comfort, support, and customization. The breathable mesh construction, adjustable headrest and backrest, 3D armrests, and dynamic ergonomic support make it an excellent choice for professionals, students, gamers, and anyone who spends significant time at a desk. I highly recommend this chair to anyone looking for a premium seating experience that promotes comfort and productivity throughout the day.
