The locking chug cap comes preinstalled, and there’s also a straw cap with two straws. You get a straw brush, bottle brush, shoulder strap and neoprene bottle sleeve as well. The sleeve is a particularly nice addition because it cushions the bottom so you don’t get the loud metal clang when setting the bottle down, eliminating the need for a separate silicone boot. It also adds two storage pockets: a mesh pocket in front and a surprisingly roomy zippered pocket in back. The adjustable shoulder strap gives you several carrying options. For reference, I’m 5’6”. At its shortest setting, the top of the bottle sits about two inches below my armpit. Fully extended and worn crossbody, the top sits around my hip. Worn over one shoulder at the longer setting, it hangs a few inches below my hip bone. Between the two lids, paracord handle, shoulder strap, protective storage sleeve, cleaning tools, whistle, compass and carabiner, there’s a lot packed into this kit. If you’re looking for a versatile 40 oz bottle that feels durable and gives you plenty of ways to carry and customize it, this is an excellent option.

reviews.title: A Super Over the Top Metal Water Bottle That Is Rugged & Robust & Built for Any Adventure!
reviews.body: This is probably the most comprehensive water bottle kit I've ever used! It comes with 2 different lids with 2 straws, multiple brush cleaner tools, a sleeve with a zippable phone pouch, and a heavy-duty paracord handle to top it all off. The robust feeling of the total package is incredible, as the metal on the bottle is thick but also very heavy, especially when filled with water, so bear that in mind. Talking about the weight, it comes with a drinking lid with 2 straws, one being connected to the lid and the other as a replacement, which is great for drinking from the bottle without having to lift it off the table or surface its on, and this is my preferred choice of using the bottle, as the other lid forces you to have to lift the whole bottle upside down to drink from it, which is a bit cumbersome because of the weight. However, that particular lid comes with a lock, which will keep the bottle from opening. Still, even though that lid has a lock and the other one technically doesn't, they both don't leak, which is awesome, so the lock is kinda pointless. As long as the lids are tightened appropriately, you won't have any problems. The paracord handle is super tough and will give you confidence when you're holding it, as I don't think it will break prematurely. It even comes with a little compass attached to it, which is a nice feature. The only downside I can think of when it comes to the product is the price itself. I'm not saying it's not worth the asking price, but you have to ask yourself if you need such a heavy-duty water bottle to begin with, because it's probably unnecessary in most situations unless you are going hiking or camping, and even then, do you really want to lug around a 64 ounce of container of water? It would probably be better to carry around a much lighter bottle of water for most situations, or at least you could carry 4 plastic bottles of 16 ounces of water, but then you might also be trying to stay away from plastics, which is understandable. All in all, if you think a 64 oz metal water bottle is overkill, it might be worth considering something else, but if you want something that might last a lifetime, this might be it!

reviews.title: I just wanted to drink water, but now I look like I’m about to summit Mount Everest to get groceries
reviews.body: Look, all I wanted was a standard, reliable water bottle to keep me hydrated so I could stop drinking three cups of coffee before noon. What arrived on my doorstep from WONSYGO is not just a bottle—it is a full-blown, survivalist tactical hydration ecosystem that makes me look like I’m preparing for a 40-mile trek through the wilderness every time I walk into the kitchen. Let’s talk about the Survival Paracord Handle. This thing is braided like military-grade climbing rope and features a built-in safety ring. It looks so intense that I half-expect it to deploy a miniature life raft if I pull on it too hard. Carrying this bottle by the paracord gives you an immediate, unwarranted surge of rugged confidence. I was walking out to grab the morning mail, holding my bottle by the strap, and I genuinely felt like I was leading a search-and-rescue team through uncharted terrain. If an emergency ever strikes, I’m fairly certain I could unravel the handle, tie down a tent, build a shelter, and still have ice-cold water left over. The Insulated Carry Bag with Shoulder Strap takes the tactical aesthetic to a whole new level. When you slide the bottle into the sleeve, clip on the strap, and throw it over your shoulder, you are no longer just a person with a drink; you are carrying high-tech field artillery. It protects the matte black finish from dings when you inevitably drop it on a gravel path or the gym floor, and the strap leaves your hands totally free. The Leak-Proof Seal is an absolute champion. I threw this 32-ounce cylinder into the passenger seat of my car, hit a speed bump, and watched it roll into the footwell upside down. Zero leaks. Not a single drop. It’s tight as a submarine hatch. They even include a Bottle Brush and Straw Brush, which is a massive relief because trying to clean a deep 32 oz container with a standard kitchen sponge is like trying to wash a vase with a tennis ball. If you want a heavy-duty, zero-leak water bottle that treats daily hydration like a high-stakes outdoor expedition, this complete kit is an absolute powerhouse.

reviews.title: Perfect to get my daily water intake!
reviews.body: This is so much more than just a 64-ounce water bottle. It comes with one of the most comprehensive accessory sets I’ve seen included with a bottle. You get multiple options for carrying it, including a woven handle/strap, a protective sleeve, plus cleaning accessories including a full-size bottle brush and a smaller brush for getting into narrow areas. I really appreciate being able to thoroughly clean everything without having to purchase additional accessories. I tested the temperature retention before reviewing it, and it genuinely kept my water cold for 24 hours. I have even had ice remain beyond that. Since I only enjoy drinking water when it’s really cold, this is a huge plus for me. There is also no strange or metallic taste from the food-grade stainless steel. I’m planning to use this as part of my health journey because the 64-ounce capacity makes keeping track of my water incredibly simple. My goal is one full bottle each day, so rather than constantly measuring or tracking individual glasses, I know exactly where I stand based on what’s left in the bottle. The black finish looks great and goes with everything. The carrying strap is especially useful when I’m taking it somewhere like a concert, festival, camping trip, or other outdoor activity. Obviously, 64 ounces of water has some weight to it when completely full, but that’s something I expect with a bottle this large. Durability has also impressed me. I’ve already dropped it, and it didn’t dent or noticeably scratch. Everything feels sturdy and well made, and this seems like something I’ll be using for a long time rather than replacing after a few months. The price may initially seem a little high for a water bottle, but considering the large capacity, excellent insulation, durable construction, and extensive set of included accessories, I think the value is there. It’s exceptionally good at keeping my water ice cold, feels built to last, and includes pretty much everything I could want with a large insulated bottle.

reviews.title: I’d give this 10 stars if I could - an amazing water bottle!
reviews.body: We’ve all got lots of water bottles, but until you have one like this, you are NOT ready for the beach/picnic/camping trip. It’s got huge volume, so does 2 people a good long day out and about, and it really does keep things cool thanks to the insulation AND the neoprene case. That case also has a zippered pocket on the side which can hold a regular iPhone and some ID - super useful! Lids? Two. Two!!! One pop top (lockable via a click-lock to avoid accidental opening) and one flip-up straw sort, with a spare straw and all of the cleaning tools to keep it pristine. They really thought this one all the way through. Handles and straps? Plenty! The shoulder strap is great for heavily loaded outings, while the paracord and plastic handles are perfect for passing around or just moving the bottle. For the sorts who appreciate such things, it has a small compass on the paracord handle, which does really work. It also has a whistle built into the fastener for that handle, so if you were ever to be stuck in a ravine and need Lassie, or a Mountie etc to come and help, you’re in luck. It’s the sort of thing you can imagine Bear Grylls has clipped to his backpack. I’ll be buying another - for camping trips, beach days, or just long road trips, this is the ultimate water canteen. You could also use it for soup, coffee (a LOT of coffee) or anything else you might want to keep in large quantities and hot or cold. I can even see using it for premixed cocktails for big picnics! You want one, believe me - it’s already replaced two of our smaller water bottles, and is going to be getting plenty of use in this household.

reviews.title: Reliable 64 oz Water Bottle with Great Insulation and Handy Accessories
reviews.body: I’ve been using this 64 oz water bottle for a few weeks now during hiking, camping, and daily activities, and I’m very pleased with its performance. The multi-layer vacuum insulation technology is impressive — it keeps my drinks icy cold for a full 24 hours and hot beverages warm for up to 12 hours. Whether it’s a cold summer hike or a chilly morning coffee, the bottle maintains the temperature perfectly throughout my adventures. The bottle is made from food-grade 304 stainless steel, which feels sturdy and durable without any metallic aftertaste, a problem I’ve encountered with other bottles. The wide-mouth lid with a thick silicone seal ensures it’s completely leak-proof; I’ve tossed it upside down in my backpack multiple times with no spills or drips at all. This leak-proof feature gives me peace of mind when carrying it in bags alongside my electronics and other gear. Another standout aspect is the all-in-one accessory kit that comes with the bottle. The durable paracord handle is not only stylish but also practical for easy carrying and hanging on backpacks or trekking poles. The neoprene sleeve provides excellent grip and protection, preventing scratches and helping to keep my hands comfortable with hot drinks. Cleaning is a breeze thanks to the included long-handled bottle brush for deep cleaning the interior and a slim straw brush for any narrow gaps. The wide-mouth opening makes it simple to add ice cubes or fruit slices, and cleaning is straightforward. The bottle’s size is perfect for staying hydrated throughout long outdoor activities or even busy workdays. It’s a versatile water bottle that suits gym workouts, road trips, office commutes, and more. Overall, this water bottle offers excellent insulation, reliable leak-proof design, and thoughtful accessories that add real value. It’s well-built and designed with outdoor enthusiasts in mind. I’m very satisfied with my purchase and would highly recommend it to anyone looking for a dependable and convenient hydration solution.

That said, this bottle is very large and I personally cannot hold it in one hand, and I have medium large hands for a woman, it does not fit in the cupholder in the car, which is pretty much expected, the spouts are not very comfortable, neither the straw nor the flip lid, it is pretty heavy for hiking. I would recommend making a little skinnier and modify the spouts to be more comfortable and bigger flow.

reviews.title: Great insulated bottle — and I love using it for warm water too! 💧🔥
reviews.body: I really like this insulated water bottle! Of course, it does a great job of keeping drinks cold or hot, but I've actually been using mine for something a little different: warm water beside my bed overnight. I love having warm water first thing in the morning, so I've been filling the bottle with boiled water at night and taking it upstairs with me. By the time I wake up in the morning, the water is still pleasantly warm rather than having completely cooled down overnight. It's not so hot that I can't drink it, which is exactly what I wanted. The insulation is therefore working really well for my particular use, and I can see this being equally useful for keeping cold drinks chilled during the day, especially when hiking, camping, travelling or spending time outdoors. 🏕️🥾 I also like all the practical accessories that come with it. The paracord handle makes it easy to carry, and having both a bottle brush and straw brush included is a thoughtful touch because cleaning reusable bottles properly is so much easier when you have the right tools. The neoprene sleeve is another nice addition for handling and protection, while the leak-proof design gives me peace of mind when carrying it around. Overall, this is a very versatile insulated bottle that has become part of my nighttime routine in a way I didn't initially expect. I love that it keeps my water at a comfortable temperature for hours, and the included accessories make it feel like a complete set rather than just a bottle. 💧😊

reviews.title: Excellent Bottle Set — The Carrying Sleeve Makes It Even Better
reviews.body: This is a really impressive 32 oz water bottle set, especially considering how many useful accessories are included. The bottle itself feels substantial and well made, and the matte black finish gives it a clean, sleek look. One of the best features for me is the neoprene carrying sleeve. A 32 oz bottle can get cumbersome to carry around by hand, so being able to put it in the sleeve and use the adjustable shoulder strap makes a huge difference. The front zippered pocket is large enough to hold small essentials like a phone, cards, or keys, while the mesh pocket provides additional quick-access storage. It makes this especially convenient for walks, hiking, sightseeing, kids' activities, or travel when I don't necessarily want to carry a separate bag. The bottle also comes with a paracord handle and carabiner, giving you several different ways to carry it. I like that the paracord handle isn't just decorative—it provides a substantial grip and adds to the outdoorsy design. Another thing I appreciate is how complete the accessory package is. It includes extra straws along with a bottle brush and straw-cleaning brush, so you don't immediately have to purchase separate cleaning accessories. There also appears to be an additional lid, which gives you another drinking option depending on your preference. The 32 oz capacity is a good size for staying hydrated without having to refill constantly. It is definitely larger than a typical everyday bottle, but the carrying sleeve helps compensate for that. Overall, this feels like much more than just a basic water bottle. It's a thoughtfully put-together kit with accessories that I would actually use rather than extras that will immediately end up in a drawer.

reviews.body: I received the WONSYGO 24 oz Water Bottle with Paracord Handle through the Amazon Vine review program. I think this is the most impressive water bottle I've owned—and that's saying something, considering how many my family of four has gone through over the years. There's a lot about this bottle that gives it a premium feel from the moment you take it out of the box. The cover is impressive, and it comes with useful accessories, including different straps. The paracord handle is particularly well done. It looks great and is easy to grip. There's even a small analog compass attached, which is a neat extra that adds to the bottle's outdoorsy appeal. It makes this feel like the perfect water bottle to take along when you're hiking on the trails. The pouch is actually useful. It has a zippered compartment and a mesh pocket where you could keep cash, coins, or an earbud case. Another really nice touch is the included shoulder strap. That's especially useful with a larger water bottle like this that when filled has some weight to it, particularly when you're carrying it for hours. A second lid style is also included, along with cleaning tools and extra straws. I love this water bottle, although I already know that the second my younger son sees it, he's going to claim it for himself. He's a water bottle connoisseur and very picky about what he likes, but this one checks all the boxes I know are important to him.

reviews.title: The best water bottle I've had in years
reviews.body: Overview: The 40oz Insulated Water Bottle has quickly become an essential companion on my daily adventures. Whether I’m out hiking, hitting the gym, or just working at my desk, this bottle ensures that my drink remains icy cold throughout the day. Like all products, it does have its strengths and a few areas for improvement, but overall, it’s a fantastic investment for anyone who values hydration in their day-to-day. Pros: Durable Finish: One of my primary concerns with water bottles is how well they hold up to daily wear and tear. I’ve had my fair share of bottles that chip or scratch easily, but this one has proven its mettle. Its finish is robust and has successfully resisted the occasional bump or drop. So, for the clumsy folks out there (like me), this bottle might be your new best friend. Efficient Insulation: The insulation game on this bottle is top-notch. Even in the blazing summer heat, after leaving this bottle in my car for hours, I return to find my water as cold as when I first poured it in. That's a game-changer, especially for those of us living in warmer climates or who simply love their beverages ice-cold. Rugged Straw: For those who prefer sipping through a straw, this feature is a standout. The straw is durable, ensuring that it doesn't get squashed or dented easily. Plus, it allows for easy drinking, especially during activities where you don't want to pause or tilt your head back. Versatile Top Design: Flexibility in design is always a win in my book. The interchangeable top, allowing for either open drinking or through a straw, gives users the option to switch according to their preference or activity. A casual day at the beach? Go for open drinking. On a run? The straw might be your best bet. Cons: Slippery When Wet: My only real gripe with this bottle is its tendency to become somewhat slippery when wet. Given the durable finish, it's a bit ironic that it can become a challenge to grip if there’s condensation or if you spill a bit while refilling. It’s not a deal-breaker, but something to be wary of, especially if you’re out and about and your hands are sweaty or it’s raining. Final Thoughts: Despite its minor shortcomings, the 40oz Insulated Water Bottle is an exceptional product. Its insulation capabilities alone make it worth the investment. However, coupled with its rugged design and versatile drinking options, it's hard to resist. If the manufacturer were to address the grip issue in future designs, it would undoubtedly earn a full 5-star rating from me. Would I recommend it? Absolutely. Just be cautious when handling it with wet hands!

reviews.title: The right size at the right price
reviews.body: We purchased these when my son was starting high school, because it was time to get rid of all of the battered 16 ounce water bottles and moved to something that was a little bit bigger and better suited for a teenager. These are a great size – not too big to carry in a backpack, but not too small, either. The color is as represented, a nice deep red. We appreciate that they come with both a straw cap and the screw cap depending on your preference (although I can't be alone in saying that the water bottle cabinet is the new Tupperware drawer – a disaster area of lids and straws!). We got a sheet of school stickers so that my son Could personalize the bottles. The one drawback that we found was that the stickers did not stay on through a dishwasher cycle. It is not clear to me whether that is a sticker issue or a water bottle issue, but it was easily solved by hand washing the bottles. All in all, the price and size were right for these. They come in a ton of colors too! I'm considering buying another set in blue. Highly recommend!

reviews.title: THE BEST WATERBOTTLE
reviews.body: I bought this waterbottle as a gift for my dad who works all day and comes home late. I wanted a bottle that was big (64oz), could withstand falls, and had different cap options to switch out when they get dirty. This bottle checks all the boxes and is super inexpensive ($19) compared to name brands. It came neatly packaged in a box with bubble wrap. I received the waterbottle assembled with the straw cap and the handle, two additional caps ( a screw on and one with a spout), two plastic straws with a cleaning brush, and a carabiner. It did come with the tiniest paint scuff at the top but nothing that would be a deal breaker. Since my dad prefers the spout cap, I tested to see if it would leak and not a single drop spilled. It retains cold temperatures perfectly well. Though I have not tested an entire day (24 hours) as the lable describes, if you add cold water from the fridge with a couple of ice cubes, you will have no problem staying fresh in a hot summer day. The bottle overall feels very durable and I really appreciate the rope handle that it comes with since it makes carrying the bottle a lot easier and is more secure than the plastic handle from the cap. I included a video of how to attach the rope handle in case yours does not come pre-assembled or if you'd like to remove it for washing. The only downside is the difficulty with having to remove the seals from the caps. I spent several minutes trying to remove the deeply wedged plastic seals inside the caps and finally succeeded using a fork and a butter knife, but this issue is common with mostly all insulated water bottles so its no different from name brands. If you are looking for the perfect water bottle, you have found it.

reviews.title: ME ENCANTA ESTE TERMO
reviews.body: Por el precio, sinceramente este termo está genial. -Sí le caben 2 litros de agua. -Resiste caídas, ya se me ha caído varias veces y solo se abolló muy muy ligeramente. reviews.body_en: For the price, this thermos is honestly great. -Yes, it holds 2 liters of water. -It resists falls, I have already dropped it several times and it only dented very, very slightly. It is super resistant. -The material feels high quality, it is very resistant, I have the black one and it does not peel off. -Yes it keeps the water cold. If you put a lot of ice in your water, the water lasts a day and a half, not ice cold, but cold. If you are looking for a very resistant, beautiful, long-lasting bottle that fulfills its purpose and with useful accessories, this thermos is for you. If you are looking for a thermos that can hold hot or cold water for more than a day, perhaps you should look for another option. Personally, I give it a 10, I've had my thermos for a year now and it's very good, I love it.

reviews.title: Keeps ice overnight!
reviews.body: I’ve been really happy with how well this keeps drinks cold. I put ice water in it at night and by the next morning the water is still freezing cold, usually with some small pieces of ice still floating around. It also fits in my car cup holder without any issue, which is always something I check with bigger bottles. The lid took me a minute to understand, but I actually like the way it works. The carry loop folds over the top and kind of acts as an extra layer of security over the button that opens the lid. Once you flip the loop up to carry it, that button is exposed, but there’s enough resistance that I haven’t had it accidentally pop open on me. Cleaning it is pretty straightforward too. The inside straw comes out and is easy enough to clean with one of those little narrow straw-cleaning brushes, although one is not included. I also like that the drinking spout is hard plastic instead of a soft rubbery material. Those softer mouthpieces always seem harder to keep clean over time. I would clarify the “leakproof” part a little. When everything is closed and locked, I haven’t had an issue. If the lid is open and the bottle tips sideways, though, liquid can come through the mouthpiece if the water line is below the small vent hole above the drinking spout. So I wouldn’t consider it spillproof while you’re actively drinking from it (like you’d expect from a kids sippy cup). My only real design complaint is the outside of the bottle is completely hard and smooth. There is a narrow softer band near the top that gives you something to grip, but I would have loved to see that same material farther down the bottle. Especially with a larger bottle, a little extra grip around the middle would make it easier to grab one-handed. Other than that, it’s been easy to use, keeps drinks extremely cold, and the lid design is pretty thoughtful.

reviews.title: Better travel cup for life on the road
reviews.body: I spend a lot of time on the road, so an insulated cup is something I can actually put to use rather than another drink container that ends up sitting in a cabinet. I wanted something I could take with me in the truck and use for coffee or another drink without dealing with an open cup while traveling. The Swift-Sip style caught my attention because convenience matters when you're taking a drink with you instead of sitting at a kitchen table. I want a travel cup that is straightforward to open, drink from, and close without turning the lid into a project every time. I also like the taller, relatively narrow design. Space around a driver's seat can fill up quickly with everything you need during a workday, so I generally prefer drinkware that doesn't take up unnecessary room. The dark blue exterior looks clean and understated, which I prefer for something that's going to get used regularly rather than saved for special occasions. It also feels appropriate for the truck, office, commuting, or just carrying around the house. I don't make claims about how many hours a cup will maintain a particular temperature unless I've actually timed it under controlled conditions. What matters more to me is whether it is convenient enough that I'll continue reaching for it. For commuters, drivers, or anyone who routinely carries a drink from place to place, this is the type of insulated cup that fits naturally into a daily routine.

reviews.title: Hands Down My Favorite Water Bottle
reviews.body: Hands down, this is my favorite water bottle I have ever owned. It arrived in the exact Deep Ocean color shown in the listing, and the overall design is sleek and very comfortable to hold. I especially like the shape because it is slightly tapered toward the bottom, which allows it to fit smaller cup holders. The indented sides also make it much easier for me to grip with smaller hands. It came with a straw, which I personally don’t like using, so I removed it and use the bottle as a traditional tilt and sip instead. It works perfectly that way. The seal on this bottle is excellent. I have tested it in all kinds of situations where I would normally expect a water bottle to leak, and I haven’t had a single leak. The locking mechanism really seems to do its job and keeps the lid securely closed. Between the comfortable design, cup holder friendly shape, and completely leakproof seal, I absolutely love this water bottle.

reviews.title: Keeps drinks cold all day, opens one-handed with no leaks, and you get both a spout and a straw
reviews.body: This bottle comes with me everywhere, around the house, in the car, out running errands, and on walks or to the gym, and it holds up across all of it. Cold retention is the headline. Drinks stay cold all day, not a few hours, so what I fill it with in the morning is still cold in the afternoon without me thinking about it. The one-hand open lid is more convenient than I expected. I can flip it open while I'm carrying something else or driving, without setting anything down or unscrewing a cap. There's been no leaking at all, which matters since it rides in a bag on walks and gets knocked around in the car. Nothing seeps out around the lid or the spout. The sip spout flows well, giving a good stream without gulping or dribbling. It also includes a straw, so you can go either way depending on what you prefer that day. Having both options rather than being locked into one is a nice touch. The shape of the bottle feels nice in hand, with a contour that sits comfortably rather than feeling like gripping a straight tube. The carry handle makes it easy to grab and haul around too, especially when it's full and 26 ounces has some weight to it. The colors are super cute as well. The soft lavender is a pretty muted shade rather than anything harsh. One thing to know: it doesn't fit in the cup holder in my Mini Cooper. Smaller cars with tighter holders may have the same issue, so measure yours if that's how you plan to carry it. In my case it rides in the passenger seat or a bag instead, which works fine for me. Cold all day, no leaks, and versatile in how you drink from it. Really happy with this one, five stars!

reviews.title: Perfect as a school water bottle! Easy to open!
reviews.body: I really like this cup for my daughter to take to school. The pink, purple and mint colors are cute without feeling too babyish, and the 26 ounce size gives her plenty of water for the day! We haven’t had any issues with leaking either when the cap is on right and sealed properly. The lid is also really easy for her to use and I like that it has a lock so the spout isn’t just popping open in her backpack. You lift the purple top to unlock it and then press the blue/mint part of the cap to open the drinking spout. It’s simple enough for her to do on her own, which is an important factor in considering it for a school water bottle. My favorite thing about this bottle, though, is that the whole cup is dishwasher safe. I can just toss it in the dishwasher every evening instead of having another water bottle with a bunch of pieces I have to hand wash. It’s stainless steel and vacuum insulated, too, so it feels like a nice sturdy cup that should hold up well to being taken back and forth to school every day. This is definitely a good school cup for us, and my daughter loves the colors of it!

reviews.title: I recommend and absolutely love the free sip SWAY
reviews.body: I am obsessed with w/ the sway, I bought Daybreak/ Fig, they are gorgeous, the bottle design is sleek as well highly functional. It is matte vs shiny the bottle isn’t slippery in hand, & there are different sizes to choose from. It fits into my cupholders, it also fits into my couch cupholders, & have the 30 oz. I will be buying more for me as well for gifts as EVERYONE deserves to fall in love w/ this water bottle! Oh, I have not talked about the lid functionality and I left the best for last because I never thought I would love love love the sip straw part as much as I do the chug part is very good as well. They’re right kind of like right next to each other, but you can definitely tell the straw area versus the chug area. I don’t usually use a chug type mouthpiece , but I did try it out because well it’s there and it’s very nice as well. With other brands, you either have a straw straight up you have a straw you have to flip up and this is more practice. The sealing is awesome, I tested ice in the bottle and I put it in @ noon 8/21/26 & it’s 653am 8/22/26 and my water is cold with a lot of ice. I wanted to test it out because I know there’s some mixed reviews. I myself do not use ice in my drinks. I just use cold water so the ice retention for me is really not huge on whether I buy a bottle or not.. and let’s face it if you put water and ice into any water bottle you’re gonna have some weight, but I don’t think it’s that heavy and I have arthritis and some other issues. reviews.title: You’ll Love It!
reviews.body: I love this water bottle for many reasons. It checks off all of my requirements! My list was particular and I didn’t think I’d find exactly what I wanted. reviews.title: Worth every penny
reviews.body: I didn't get into the Stanley craze-I've had too many accidental spills with the whole cup & straw set up. So when my kids started insisting I get an Owala, I was skeptical. But then I saw the TikTok of that one guy using his Owala as a weapon to fight off the men who attempted to break into his house, and not only did he stop them, his Owala survived with just a dent (and a broken handle, if memory serves me right)! Then Owala does the of the best PR stunt/customer appreciation ever, and not only sends that man a safe, but filled that safe with several Owala bottles! I admire a company that can back their products up; but I will support a business who listens and recognizes their customers too! So I started looking for one; I got to thinking as a woman who often does her errands alone, "you know, I can always use it for defense and I can't be accused of carrying a weapon, because technically it's a water bottle." When Owala came out with this Amazon exclusive color, I knew it was kismet! I put it on my cart, but before I checked out, my kid saw what I was doing and she stopped me. She said, "lady, I already bought that for you. It's coming next week." LOL I guess she got tired of telling me to get one, and just grabbed it for me, knowing that burgundy is one of my favorite colors! I've had it for 5 months now. It's a little dinged up on the bottom-nothing too bad. I just dropped it one or two times (maybe more). I love that the mouthpiece is covered up and can be locked so 1)it will always be clean; and 2)it won't accidentally spill if it tips over, or you know, you accidentally drop it. It keeps me accountable-I fill that 40 oz 2-3 times a day to make sure I stay hydrated. I love that it's insulated so I can keep my drink cold or hot-depending on what I fill it with. I love that it's easy to clean-there are no nook & crannies that can't be cleaned or reached! I just love it. Period.

reviews.title: Convenient Without Being Bulky
reviews.body: I've been really happy with this bottle. The 30 oz size feels like the perfect middle ground—big enough that I'm not constantly refilling it, but not so big that it becomes a pain to carry around. It also fits in a standard cup holder, which was a must for me. It's surprisingly lightweight, and the bucket handle makes it really easy to grab and go. The only downside I've noticed is that ice doesn't last quite as long as some other insulated bottles because the lid isn't fully insulated. That said, it's not a dealbreaker for my use. It still keeps my water plenty cold throughout the day, and the convenience and design more than make up for it. I got the Dreamy Fields color and it looks even better in person. Overall, definitely recommend.

reviews.title: Best water bottle ever
reviews.body: I purchased this bottle just to try out in the summer of 2023. It is now the summer of 2026 and I still use it multiple times a week (only because I now have multiple Owalas and I have just ordered my third Owala FreeSip). I have used so many cups—Stanleys, Yetis, Hydrojugs, Hydroflask, etc—and the Owala is still my favorite. Here’s my favorite things about it: LEAKPROOF! This is the biggest one. I can throw it my bag and trust that everything will stay dry. THE SPOUT! Hands down the best spout I’ve ever used. I love that I can sip through the straw but then close the lid and keep my straw clean and not have any spills if it tips over. And then it also gives me the option to absolutely inhale water if I’m about to shrivel up from dehydration. I think this alone is why I now own three in different sizes. STAYS COLD! The 32 ounce holds ice for quite a while. It varies depending on how often I refill it but if I’m not constantly refilling it, it will hold ice for about 24 hours. THE SIZES! I love the size options. My original one was a 32 ounce and is a great middle ground for me. It holds enough water that I’m not refilling it every hour but it’s not huge. It’s great for work and this bottle will be going to live at my job. I just ordered the 40 ounce for home because I want a little more volume when I’m outside gardening but I can’t say much about the 40 ounce size yet. I also have a 16 ounce (kids size) that I use when I leave the house. It fits in a lot of my bags and it’s leakproof so I always have cold water with me. It’s perfect especially since I’m on medication that causes dehydration if I’m not careful. DISHWASHER SAFE! This one is self explanatory. It’s amazing and I love it. There are a few cons though. The first one is that the 32 ounce doesn’t fit in my cup holder. Not a huge deal since it’s leakproof—I just keep it on the passenger seat. But Owala does have cup holder friendly options now if that’s something you want. The bottle also does dent and scratch fairly easily. I dropped it getting out my car one day and it’s a little beat up now. Kind ugly, but it’s still my fave. It’s kinda disappointing because I have Yetis and Stanleys that have been through far worse and still look new. Just be mindful of that and baby it a little. Still 100% worth it though. Long story short, it’s a great bottle that will keep your water cold and everything else dry. As someone who has used this bottle regularly for years, I highly recommend!

reviews.title: Hiding that lipstick in style!
reviews.body: I freaking love this thing. I'm not a trend person, I go for function. And when my STB SIL got my fiancé a shiney new Stanley I decided it was time to replace my beat up Rtic with the mismatch lid and straw. I may not follow trends, but I didn't want my fiancé's cup to put mine to absolute shame! First off, can we all agree that the marshmallow is gorgeous? THIS cup is spectacular. Strange to say that about a water bottle, I know. But since I never jumped on that train, I didn't know what I had been missing out on. Let me tell you what! The most important things to me is taking care of my service dog. She keeps me safe so her care is paramount to me. This enables me to pour my water into her bowl on the fly, without having to open my bottle past what I would do to drink from it. Quick and easy. That right there was the selling point for me. But as it turns out, there was even more benefit than that. I don't chug my water but if I did, the chug hole does works fine. The straw portion is ready to sip from, and it doesn't stick up tall like other water bottle straws. It's JUST tall enough to get the job done. No worry of toppling over because the straw got knocked over by the cat. (Because that happens.) The "handle", which is generally the locking feature unless you're using it as a handle, is well placed and comfortable for my sized hands. Not to small and not clunky and large. STB SIL likes to talk about how great the Stanley handle is, which I don't really get. I like that this doesn't have a handle. I have one to carry it if I need it, and not if I don't. The seal is completely water tight. I occasionally put a drink mix in it and shake vigorously. No leaks whatsoever. In fact... It fits in a car cup holder upside down. That's how I transport it in the car. It doesn't fit butt down, so I put it top down. I've been known to do this with various bottles, so I tried it with this one and it fits ok. It's not ideal but it's better than nothing. Try it in yours! Since it's completely leak proof there's are no worries about spilling. (Just be careful when you remove it that it doesn't unlatch.) Another bonus of the covered straw is that germs don't get in the straw. Perfect because people in public often don't cover their sneezes. Ugh. And the coolest part? Lipstick messes are concealed with a flip of the lid! Easy peasy! I have noticed that the inside of the straw stains a little, which was disappointing. I don't like that I look at it and it looks dirty when it isn't. But I guess I shouldn't have used drink enhancers then. Also, my top color is very light. Other colors might not show that. Another thing that want fun was that when it fell, it dented! Oh no! So beware of that. It keeps my water super cold and I don't go anywhere without it. I love it so much that I'm thinking of getting another so I don't have to limit myself by style! Definitely worth the price since I use it constantly, every day. This one is so chill and Zen... The next one shall be colorful and crazy! One for every mood! I simply can't say enough about this darn water bottle... Does that mean I'm on trend now? Who knows! I just love my Owalla! I'm definitely a fan!

reviews.title: Our favorite water bottles
reviews.body: Owala water bottles for the win! These are hands-down our favorite water bottles. We have tried just about every popular brand out there—Yeti, Stanley, Hydro Flask, and others—and the Owala is the one that everyone in our family consistently reaches for. I absolutely love the versatility of the lid. You can use the built-in straw when you want to sip, or easily flip it open and drink straight from the opening. Having both options in one bottle is incredibly convenient, especially when you're on the go. The color combinations are also so fun! reviews.title: Produto perfeito, mas a entrega deixa muito a desejar.
reviews.body: Vamos lá, primeiramente que eu AMEI a garrafa, estava super ansiosa pela chegada dela e não me arrependo em absolutamente NADA de ter comprado. Ela mantém a água gelada por MUITO tempo(se você for como eu q é curioso em saber quando tempo exatamente, um ótimo exemplo foi que eu coloquei água nela SEM GELO ás 16 da tarde e no dia seguinte ás 8 horas quando acordei ainda estava gelada como se tivesse acabado de sair do filtro d'água, lembrando que meu filtro tem agua gelada). O canudo dela é sensacional e super prático, mas também recomendo comprar uma daquelas escovinhas pra limpar. Além disso, ela é muito linda e grande. Eu comprei a de 945ml e tá perfeita pra mim, já que tem uma alça e o material externo da garrafa não é escorregadio ao toque. Agora falando dos pontos negativos, o único ponto negativo que eu tenho a mencionar aqui sobre essa garrafa é a entrega. Vi muitas pessoas reclamando sobre a demora da entrega e realmente aconteceu comigo também, o prazo pra envio é ENORME, acredito que seja por causa da quantidade de pessoas que compram essa garrafa, então demorou MUITO pra enviarem, aprox um mês. A entrega em si depois do envio foi de uma semana +/-, então acredito que seja mesmo uma coisa de estoque. O problema é que a garrafa deveria vir numa caixa de papelão, forrada por dentro e tudo mais. Mas na verdade ela veio dentro de um saquinho sem nada, só a garrafa, envelopado por um pacotinho com uma camada DUVIDOSA de papel bolha. Acredito inclusive que esse tenha sido o motivo do arranhão da foto(é pequeno, bem pequeno, e fica na parte de baixo, praticamente nem dá pra notar, principalmente depois que eu comprar aquele molde de silicone pra botar na garrafa). Enfim, o produto é perfeito, mas pecam bastante na forma como enviaram, e nem é pela demora, mas sim pelos danos causados aos produtos, visto que mais gente aqui teve o mesmo problema.
reviews.body_en: Let's go, firstly, I LOVED the bottle, I was super excited for it to arrive and I don't regret buying it at all. It keeps the water cold for a LONG time (if you're like me and are curious to know exactly when, a great example was that I put water in it WITHOUT ICE at 4 pm and the next day at 8 am when I woke up it was still cold as if it had just come out of the water filter, remembering that my filter has ice water). Her straw is amazing and super practical, but I also recommend buying one of those little brushes to clean. Furthermore, she is very beautiful and big. I bought the 945ml one and it's perfect for me, as it has a handle and the outer material of the bottle is not slippery to the touch. Now talking about the negative points, the only negative point I have to mention here about this bottle is the delivery. I saw a lot of people complaining about the delay in delivery and it actually happened to me too, the shipping time is HUGE, I believe it's because of the number of people who buy this bottle, so it took a LONG time for them to ship, approximately a month. The delivery itself after shipping took a week +/-, so I believe it is really a stock thing. The problem is that the bottle should come in a cardboard box, lined inside and everything. But in fact it came in a bag with nothing on it, just the bottle, wrapped in a small package with a DUBIOUS layer of bubble wrap. I even believe that this was the reason for the scratch in the photo (it's small, very small, and it's on the bottom, it's practically not even noticeable, especially after I buy that silicone mold to put on the bottle). Anyway, the product is perfect, but they made a big mistake in the way they sent it, and it's not even because of the delay, but because of the damage caused to the products, since more people here had the same problem.

reviews.title: Nalgene, hard to beat!
reviews.body: Nalgene bottles just work. The Nalgene bottle is perfect for those who enjoy outdoors activities. As funny as it is to say it "just works" when it's as simple as a bottle, it absolutely does. For starters the material. Not only is it BPA-free, the Tritan material is perfect for a drinking bottle. It's extremely rugged, in fact Nalgene has gained a reputation for how long their bottles last. It also doesn't leave much of a taste! A lot of my experience with plastic bottles is that you can taste the plastic, the problem persists with metal as well. Nalgene bottles have a fairly neutral taste. It's also very resistant to trapping odors and tastes. My problem with alternatives is that if you hold coffee in them for a long time, then your water tastes like coffee even after a clean. 1L is a perfect amount of water to hold in my opinion. It's enough to be usable, but not overkill to where it's not a functional bottle. It's great for day to day use as well, I find myself finishing a Nalgene just fine. The size is great in this aspect, it doesn't waste space with insulation. I find a lot of metal bottles and other plastic bottles can only ever hold 500ml and some change because of their shape. The leak proof seal just works. A lot of bottles are finicky, if you screw the cap from an angle it still leaks. I've tried to do it from an angle but it always screws on properly, I've never had a problem with it spilling. Overall the Nalgene is the perfect bottle. It's a good middle ground of everything while having its strengths in durability, build quality, and price.

reviews.title: Remove rubber pieces when drying...
reviews.body: I got this 16oz bottle for myself because I've stated using the celsius packets rather than drinking the cans. I wanted something reusable because I have a water dispenser at home and didn't want to have to keep buying cases of water when I have perfectly fine water already. Anywho, this works out perfectly for my packets! The bottle keeps my drink cold for the length of time needed. It has a nifty tab on it that locks the lid, though I don't really use that, but would be useful for the kiddos. It also has a sturdy handle on it, which is amazing! It does have a bumper around the bottom, protecting the bottom corners of the bottle from scratches, etc. The bottle is insanely easy to clean! I've noticed several people complain about mold growing in the rubber pieces on the lid and around the rubber ring. These are insanely easy to remove and place back in. Yes, water will get trapped under these pieces, but simply remove them while it's drying and pop them back in when you're ready and it will totally avoid the mold issue. Oh, and it's also a plus that this bottle doesn't leak, also perfect for the kiddos for school, etc. All in all, I'm pleased with the bottle!

reviews.title: Great water bottle for kids to bring to school. Love the no straw feature!
reviews.body: I purchased two of these for 8 and 10 year olds and they've been going to school with them daily for about a month now. We've been using Thermos Funtainers for most of their lives so are very familiar with the version including a straw... I am so glad to be done with those as these open spout water bottles are not only much easier to clean, but my kids are drinking more water (yay!) because it flows a little faster. Not so fast that we've even come close to any accidents though. I'm sure it won't stay perfect forever, but the kiddos aren't exactly careful and these cups are still free of dings and scratches, so they still look brand new for now. This wasn't the case a month into last school year when the kids had different, (not Thermos brand), water bottles that did not have the plastic piece protecting the bottom. Those bottles did the job but to be frank, they just started looking crap because they were (too easily) all beat up in no time. No leaking! These cups get tossed around with the kiddos' bookbags and are brought out to the field for P.E. and tossed on the ground and still.. no leaking. There was one day that a tiny bit seeped out but that seems to be a user error since it hasn't happened again. Anyhow, these big kid Funtainers are just about perfect for us... Dad, teen, and I have been using Yeti for several years but I will admit, I'm not perfectly happy with mine. Thermos has been doing it longer so I think I'll make the switch myself.

reviews.title: Premium Build, Outstanding Insulation, and Truly Leakproof
reviews.body: This insulated water bottle excels where it matters most. Insulation: The double-wall vacuum insulation is outstanding. Water stays cold for hours, and ice is often still present at the end of the day. If cold retention is a priority for you, this bottle delivers. Leakproof Design: I have to call this out specifically because I love it. The secure-sealing lid and cap system is truly leakproof — toss it in a bag, clip it to a backpack, lay it on its side — no leaks. Period. For anyone who's dealt with water bottles that claim to be leakproof but aren't, this one actually means it. Build Quality: The stainless steel construction feels premium and durable — built for rugged outdoor use without feeling cheap or flimsy. The powder-coated exterior provides good grip and durability, while the silicone base adds stability, impact protection, and prevents slipping on surfaces. The rubberized lid and silicone components improve overall grip and usability. No metallic or plastic taste. Design and Functionality: The versatile lid design allows either a full opening for filling or a smaller opening for drinking — a practical touch for daily use. The comfortable carry loop and strap make transportation easy, whether you're on a long hike or walking between meetings. It clips easily to a backpack or gear for outdoor use and fits well in backpack pockets. Easy to clean, easy to fill, and the gift-worthy packaging makes it a great option for gifting as well. A few things to keep in mind: Size and Weight: At 32oz, this is a large bottle designed for all-day hydration, camping, travel, and outdoor activities. It's slightly heavier than some comparable bottles and can feel cumbersome for casual everyday carry. If you're looking for a compact, lightweight daily bottle, this may be more than you need. Cup Holders: The 32oz size may not fit standard vehicle cup holders. I've used an enlarged cup holder adapter for years to accommodate larger bottles, so this wasn't an issue for me — but it's worth considering. Interior Threading: The threading around the drinking opening can be prone to collecting debris and developing odor over time, especially if you're mixing in additives like electrolyte powders. Regular thorough cleaning of the threads is recommended to keep things fresh. This is a premium, rugged, well-designed insulated bottle that prioritizes durability, insulation, and capacity. It's an excellent value compared to more expensive competing brands, and it delivers on every claim. Highly recommend for anyone who takes their hydration seriously.

reviews.title: Big, well made bottle that's great for camping
reviews.body: The Nordikra insulated stainless steel water bottle deserves 5 stars because of its high quality construction. But be aware that this is a big, heavy duty bottle. I personally find it too large and heavy to comfortably carry on a walk or hike. It doesn't fit in my car cupholders, and it wouldn't be practical on a bike due to its weight. This bottle is more like an old school thermos bottle that has been upgraded and strengthened, minus the fragile glass liner. The bottle holds a generous 32 ounces of liquid. It keeps a drink cold for hours. However, it did not, for me, live up to its claim of keeping liquid hot for 24+ hours. In my test, it was closer to 12 hours. Still, that's pretty good. Here is what I like best about the bottle-- This is a very good looking water bottle. It comes in an attractive box that would be perfect for gift-giving. The powder coated exterior is impressive, looks great, and feels very durable. The silicone base and cap are very practical and I like the colorful contrast against the black body. The lid is easy to twist off. You can easily drink from the bottle or pour from it. The bottle is also easy to clean. Although I don't care to carry this bottle around, it was perfect to keep drinking water fresh and cold at our campsite. The 32 ounce size is convenient, and the bottle takes up less space than the plastic thermal jugs we had been using. Plus, we had no trouble with drips or leaks. The bottle also comes with a 5 year limited warranty. The Nordikra bottle is a welcome addition to our camping gear.

reviews.title: Rugged and attractive water bottle.
reviews.body: This beautifully designed, solidly built water bottle features two separate openings—one for drinking and a larger one for filling or adding ice. Both caps are wrapped in textured silicone, providing a secure, non-slip grip even with wet hands. It also includes a sturdy, flexible carry loop that is comfortable to hold and makes the bottle easy to transport. The base is protected by a silicone cover that provides a stable, non-slip surface while helping guard against minor bumps and scratches. This is not a lightweight bottle. Filled with its full 32-ounce capacity, it weighs approximately 3.25 pounds, making it better suited for those who prioritize durability over minimal weight. I found its cold retention to be more impressive than its heat retention. In my testing, I filled the bottle with 58°F water, and after 12 hours the temperature had risen to only 68°F. I then repeated the test using 190°F water, which cooled to 140°F after 12 hours. While it does not retain heat as effectively as it retains cold, the performance is more than adequate for my needs since I primarily use it for cold beverages. Overall, this is an excellent water bottle for everything from gym workouts to long hikes. I highly recommend it for anyone looking for a durable, well-built insulated water bottle.

My son initially wanted to use it as his school water bottle, but I found it a little too large for that purpose, especially if you’re relying on a standard backpack pocket. It’s also fairly wide, so I don’t expect it to fit most standard vehicle cup holders. The protective features are a nice touch, particularly the reinforced base and the easy-grip handles, which make the bottle more comfortable to carry. I also like the open-spout design because it’s easy to drink from directly or pour water into another container. Most importantly, it does a good job of keeping water cold for an extended period. Overall, I’m impressed with the quality and construction. The price is in line with what I’d expect for a quality insulated stainless steel bottle, and while these bottles can be an investment, this one feels well made enough to justify the cost.

reviews.title: Real review of a not-free product
reviews.body: This is NOT a “Vine Customer Review of Free Product”. This is a real review by a guy who paid $45 of my hard earned dollars for a water bottle. I’m not a Ridge fanboy - this is the first Ridge product I’ve owned. PROS: **It fits in the water bottle pocket of every bag I own, every bag my wife owns, and our kids backpacks. reviews.title: Solid
reviews.body: I really like this water bottle, although I will be the first to admit that I've typically liked most Ridge products I've tried. I've put it at 4 stars, however, as it's not all perfect and there are definitely a couple pieces you will want to be aware of before purchasing. On the plus side - it's well built. I wouldn't say any more so than any other major brand name water bottle I've used in the past, but also no less so. It very much holds it's own and feels like it fits in well with the overall quality of the wider "premium" water bottle market. I also really, REALLY love the inclusion of the integrated strainer - if you use this for water with ice cubes like I do then it's an absolutely genius addition! On the "things to be aware of" note - while it is undoubtedly well built, it may or may not be worth the full ~$45 asking price to you. That is to say that there are definitely water bottles out there that feel every single bit as premium for not much more than ~half the price. It's also relatively small. This doesn't bother me, as my desk job keeps me close to the water cooler and it's never a bad thing to have an excuse to get up and move around...but it would drive my wife absolutely crazy. So definitely don't buy this if a smaller water bottle isn't your cup of tea. As long as neither of those "cons" scares you off, then you will likely enjoy this water bottle just as much as I have been and it's worth checking out!

reviews.title: Almost on the Ridge
reviews.body: This is a well-styled insulated double wall bottle weighing in just under 15 oz that fits great in car cup holders with a locking push button lid. It’s well-designed, comfortable to hold, and easy to drink from but lacking in capacity at 24 oz compared with the similarly cup holder friendly Owala Sway which is 30-40 oz. Like many insulated bottles it might be top rack dishwasher safe if it fits but handwashing is recommended. The lid has the stand out feature of the ice catcher which good for preventing splashing or ice falling out, but hard to remove plus another thing to clean. It doesn’t have any other notable features like a silicone bottom for grip/silence or ceramic interior to keep it from negatively flavoring your beverage in my RTIC. If value was notably better with a coupon or on sale then I would rate this 4 stars. I also don’t see any replacement accessories third party or otherwise for sale on Amazon which is another strike against this bottle. If you really like the style, give it a try.

reviews.title: Expensive, but a great water bottle
reviews.body: Our family is on the constant search for a great water bottle; we use them all the time in the car, at sporting activities, in the gym, etc. I don’t think our requirements are significantly different from others, mostly in this order: no leaks, easy to drink from without the water running down your shirt, easy to clean, good cold retention, fits in cup holder, a handle. This ‘Ridge Water Bottle 24 ounce Double-Walled” meets all those requirements very well. It doesn’t leak in any position, even if you shake it. The top opening is just the right size, with the opening not set so far back (toward the middle of the cup) that you get dripping. It’s easy to clean with no nooks and crannies (since we just use it for water, we generally use a kitchen brush for all of it, and now and then put the top in the dishwasher). It holds water cold even in a hot car (and it fits in all our cup holders). It has a sturdy handle. It’s the first bottle we’ve had with an ‘ice catcher,’ and while I can honestly say I’ve never considered this to be an issue, it certainly does help keep the water flow steady if you put a lot of ice in. I don’t quite see how it works as a ‘mixer for powder and supplements’ as described, although I guess if you dumped in some lumpy powder it might help. The only downside is the price, at double what you pay for other good quality water bottles. If you’ve been disappointed in others it might be worth it even at this price. I’m rating it based on the product quality and not the price.

It might be- but definitely a better value if it happens to go on sale. The main drawback is if people like to use straws integrated with a mouthpiece to drink, this bottle does not have that option, you will need to look elsewhere.

reviews.title: Pretty. Stiff button. Glue dot packaging sucks.
reviews.body: I wanted these for the lid to make refills easier for my fourth grader, so was pleased to find them in clear plastic which is all of a sudden required by the school. These fit in the side pocket of her book bag perfectly. We love that the straw and lid come in colors- which are all neutral and pretty, and the mouth piece is a comfortable silicone. The lid itself feels stiff and hurts the thumbs to open a bit. We found using two thumbs and pushing closer to the top of the button (instead of the middle) makes it a little easier to release the top cover to drink from the spout. I was worried about a review that said the plastic was thin- but when you squeeze the bottle the material does not budge like a cheaper plastic would, so it’s durable enough for us. What I feel really frustrated about is the packaging. They put a few stickers on it which were easy to take off. It was the glue dot they used for the label that ruined it. What should have been a 2 second removal has turned into 10-20+minutes per bottle of soaking in Goo Be Gone and gently scrubbing in hopes of not scratching up the plastic. Even then I can’t seem to get it all off, so on a brand new bottle we haven’t even used yet we are left with that frosted/sticky spot where the glue dot was. Maybe there is a fancy hack for this? But it should not be this hard. Will update when she uses it for school next week.

I was worried about a review that said the plastic was thin- but when you squeeze the bottle the material does not budge like a cheaper plastic would, so it’s durable enough for us. What I feel really frustrated about is the packaging. They put a few stickers on it which were easy to take off. It was the glue dot they used for the label that ruined it. What should have been a 2 second removal has turned into 10-20+minutes per bottle of soaking in Goo Be Gone and gently scrubbing in hopes of not scratching up the plastic. Even then I can’t seem to get it all off, so on a brand new bottle we haven’t even used yet we are left with that frosted/sticky spot where the glue dot was. Maybe there is a fancy hack for this? But it should not be this hard. Will update when she uses it for school next week.

reviews.title: Good for Price!
reviews.body: Great product. Well insulated. Price is good. Strap and carrying case are great and surprisingly comfortable when adjusted. I bought this in the summer of 2024. That being said, I am still using this every day partially filled for work until I get another small bottle. My only suggestion to the manufacturer would be to offer a model with a higher quality strap (fake leather or something of the sort) that will do better in harsh environments.

reviews.title: Exactly What I Was Looking For
reviews.body: This Iron Flask 40oz insulated water bottle was exactly what I was looking for. I work in public safety and am not always near the station to refill my water bottle and wanted something that would allow me a couple refills but keep the water cold until I needed it. This does exactly that. I used a 20oz shaker bottle as a water bottle, so this gives Iron Flask bottle gives me two refills until I need to fill it up again. It is the perfect size to keep on my passenger seat without taking up much room at all. I have not had any issues with the bottle leaking and it is very good quality. the bottle came with three different lids. One is just a standard lid that stays attached to the bottle when unscrewed and is stainless steel. There is a straw lid, with a silicone straw that goes into the bottle and a plastic straw on the plastic lid for drinking. The third is a plastic lid like a standard coffee thermal drinking lid. I have only used the stainless steel lid as I only use this to hold extra water to refill my other water bottle since I add a water flavor to it. All three lids have a handle source for easy carrying of the water bottle. I drop this thing all the time and it still holds up really well. Of course it is going to scratch or dent when you drop it, it isn't a magic water bottle. But it has not affected the lids or seals in any way. I like to put stickers on my metal water bottles anyways, so nothing a fun sticker cant cover up! I do not put hot liquids in this water bottle, so I cannot speak to how well it keeps liquids hot, but it keeps my water nice and cold so I wouldn't have any doubt in its ability to keep liquids warm for as long as it says. I would purchase more of this product in the future if I needed.

reviews.title: Still useable after being run over by a tractor.
reviews.body: I rarely write reviews for any product I purchase. However, I felt obliged to write this review based upon the quality of this bottle. Today, while cutting one of my fields for a new cattle pasture, I noticed that this bottle had fallen off my tractor and had been run over. I assumed the bottle had been destroyed, but after picking it up from the field, I saw that it was only slightly dented. Other than the small dent, the bottle is still completely useable. Again, I ran over this bottle with a mid-sized tractor used for farming. Not many things remain functionable after that, so I am very impressed! I should also note that the bottle keeps ice and liquids cold for a long time, even when outside in the summer heat all day. I will absolutely be purchasing again.

reviews.body: Kanne. Halt sehr lange heiß bis warm. Und ist zudem auch noch robust und lässt sich leicht reinigen. Es sind drei verschiedene Verschlüsse bei, der eine ist einfach nur ein Drehverschluss mit einem Ring den man an der Kanne befestigen kann damit der Deckel nicht runterfällt oder verloren geht. Der andere ist so ein breiter fester einklappbarer trink saug halm, sieht ausgeklappt etwas aus wie bei den Schnabeltassen von damals, auf der Unterseite ist ein Kunststoff Strohhalm den man auswechseln kann, was ganz einfach geht, ein Ersatz Halm ist dabei. Eingeklappt ist es auch dicht, es läuft nichts aus, schon paarmal benutzt. Der andere Verschluss ist so ähnlich wie bei diesen Coffee to Go plastik Bechern deckeln. Und auch ein Klappverschluss dabei der dicht hält. Hab ich bisher nur einmal probiert weil mir diese Art des Trinkens nicht gefällt. Alles in allem bin ich sehr zufrieden mit der Kanne und bereue den Kauf nicht.

There are three different closures, one is simply a screw cap with a ring that you can attach to the jug so that the lid doesn't fall down or get lost. The other one is a wide, fixed, foldable drinking suction straw, when unfolded it looks a bit like the sippy cups from back then, there is a plastic straw on the bottom that you can replace, which is very easy, a replacement straw is included. It's also tight when folded, nothing leaks, it's been used a few times. The other closure is similar to the lids on these Coffee to Go plastic cups. And also a flap closure that keeps it tight. I've only tried it once so far because I don't like this type of drinking. All in all, I am very happy with the pot and don't regret the purchase.

reviews.title: Very Nice Bottle
reviews.body: First of all, the color is beautiful - perhaps not quite as brilliant as in the photos, but it is delightful. This second one I received was a replacement for the first one that was sent, which seemed to have some damage to the interior lining (presumably a manufacturing flaw). This replacement bottle has a seamless and flawless interior lining, for which I am grateful; however, the outside has a slight dent in it. I'm not sure if that is because of packaging/shipping issues or if it was sent out that way. I do know the bottle was sent in a bag, not a box, so it is very possible there was damage done during shipping. I'm a bit disappointed, but not to the point of returning this one. Still, I think from now on, I will order any YETI item directly from YETI since it will hopefully be packaged better for shipping. As for the product itself, it is a nice size, the handle makes it easy to carry, and I like the chug cap very much. It also does a great job in keeping my water cold even when I left it in a hot car for a few hours. Overall, a great product but sad that I received it already dented.

reviews.title: The ultimate leakproof companion for active hydration and commutes
reviews.body: Performance & Insulation:The Stanley IceFlow 2.0 Flip Straw Tumbler is a standout for anyone who needs their water to stay cold during long shifts or outdoor activities. Thanks to the double-wall vacuum insulation, it keeps drinks chilled for up to 12 hours and iced for a staggering 2 days. Unlike the popular Quencher, this model is designed specifically for cold liquids, making it incredibly efficient at maintaining temperature without the bulk of a multi-purpose lid.Design & Portability:One of the best features of the 20 oz size is its tapered base, which fits perfectly in standard car cup holders. The integrated folding handle makes it much easier to carry while walking or commuting compared to side-handle models. It’s also built with sustainability in mind, using recycled stainless steel and materials sourced from discarded fishing nets, so it feels as good to use as it looks.The Flip Straw Advantage:The leakproof flip straw is the highlight of the design. When snapped shut, you can toss this tumbler into a backpack or gym bag without worrying about a single drop escaping. The built-in straw allows for quick, upright sipping, which is much safer and more convenient while driving or exercising than tilting a traditional bottle. It’s also fully dishwasher safe, and the newer 2.0 version features a removable spout for even deeper cleaning.Verdict:If you want the durability and style of a Stanley but need something that is truly portable and leakproof, the IceFlow Flip Straw is the superior choice. It’s rugged, easy to carry, and fits into a busy, on-the-go lifestyle perfectly. A 5-star essential for anyone from students to outdoor enthusiasts.

reviews.title: Not super cold, but decent.
reviews.body: I purchased two for my kiddos (6 & 8) to use for sports. Right out of the box, first time using, one of them leaked a good bit. I’m not sure what changed but the next day we had a full day out in the sun and they didn’t leak anymore. I’m hoping it was a fluke and we’re in the clear moving forward. They definitely didn’t hold ice for very long. Maybe two hours? Probably shorter because it was fully melted when I took a drink about two hours after filling them. Water was still cold though, and after spending 8 hours in 100 degree weather, the water was still on the cooler side. When full, they are a bit heavy, but they hold quite a bit of water so some weight is expected. They aren’t very heavy at all otherwise. My kids were able to lug them around all day without any issues. We also used the fence-hanging feature. It was pretty cool. I do wish the handle would move though. So it’s a little awkward with the fence hooks just sticking out. Ultimately they worked for what we needed. They kept my kids hydrated all day without needing to refill a hundred times and they kept the water decently cool. We had no issues with taste or odor, as mentioned in other reviews. If you’re looking for something that’s going to maintain ice for long periods of time, this is not the bottle.

reviews.title: Hydration Champion
reviews.body: Staying hydrated during workouts and throughout the day is vital, and finding the perfect water jug to accompany me on my fitness journey was a priority. The UNDER ARMOUR 64oz Playmaker Jug has proven to be an exceptional choice that exceeds all expectations. With its impressive capacity, durable construction, and thoughtful design, this jug has become an indispensable hydration companion. Allow me to share my experience and why I believe it is a hydration champion. First and foremost, the 64oz capacity of the Playmaker Jug is impressive. It provides ample hydration for even the most intense workouts or extended periods of physical activity. The large volume means I can go longer without refilling, allowing me to stay focused on my training and not worry about constantly seeking water sources. Whether I'm hitting the gym, going for a hike, or spending a day outdoors, the Playmaker Jug ensures that I have an abundant supply of water to keep me hydrated throughout. The build quality of the Playmaker Jug is outstanding. Made from high-grade materials, it is durable and built to withstand the demands of an active lifestyle. The jug's rugged construction means I can confidently toss it into my gym bag or backpack without fear of leakage or damage. The sturdy handle provides a comfortable grip, making it easy to carry, and the wide mouth opening allows for effortless refills and cleaning. I have been impressed with how well the jug has held up, showing no signs of wear and tear despite my daily use. One of the standout features of the Playmaker Jug is its insulation capability. The double-wall foam insulation helps to maintain the temperature of the liquid inside, keeping it cold for extended periods. This feature is particularly refreshing during hot summer workouts or outdoor activities. The chilled water stays cool, motivating me to stay hydrated and providing a refreshing burst of hydration when I need it the most. The thoughtful design of the Playmaker Jug is evident in its additional features. The leak-resistant locking lid ensures that there are no accidental spills, providing peace of mind, especially when carrying the jug while in transit. Furthermore, the Playmaker Jug's sleek and sporty design embodies the UNDER ARMOUR brand's commitment to style and performance. It comes in a variety of vibrant colors and features the iconic UNDER ARMOUR logo, adding a touch of flair to my hydration routine. In conclusion, the UNDER ARMOUR 64oz Playmaker Jug is a hydration champion that has become an essential part of my fitness regimen. Its impressive capacity, durable construction, insulation capabilities, and user-friendly design make it the perfect hydration companion for athletes and active individuals. If you're looking for a reliable and stylish water jug that can keep up with your active lifestyle, I highly recommend investing in the Playmaker Jug. Stay hydrated and stay at the top of your game with this exceptional hydration solution.

reviews.title: 26 oz. Encool bottle: Keeps ice water very cold; very well designed. Very happy!
reviews.body: I purchased this bottle hoping it would keep my water cold throughout each day as we traveled in hot environments in our car. So when I received this bottle, I did a "cold test" in my home. I totally filled the bottle with ice, then finished it off by filling the remaining spaces with water. The ice was still there that night. The next day (Day 2), I checked it in the morning: still a lot of ice. I checked it again that night (still a very large "clump" of ice). The following day (Day 3), I again checked in the morning to find there were still a few little ice cubes still floating in the bottle. WOW! When I will be traveling in a hot environment in our car for an upcoming trip, I expect the bottle to at least keep the ice and water cold throughout each day of travel. I will do the same thing every day of our trip to ensure I have something cold to sip. Good job, Encool! I am very pleased! So pleased that I immediately purchased a 2nd bottle for my husband! It feels like it is made of great quality. The handle is wide enough for my four fingers to grasp. Something I hadn't noticed is that the handle area closest to the bottle lid isn't just a 90-degree angle; it is made with a 45-degree angle at each side so your fingers rest more comfortably when holding the bottle. The lid has both the straw-sip and the chug options, and work great. I turned the full bottle on its side all night and there were no leaks. This may just be the perfect water bottle for us! Update after 1.5 weeks of hot environment travel: These water bottles were the only ones among our group of travelers that kept the water cold, They worked so well, we didn't even have to fill the entire bottle with ice and then fill the remaining spaces with water. Instead, we were able to put about 1/3 of the space as ice, and the rest as water. Still, by the end of the day, ice remained--even after drinking all the water. I ended up leaving the chug and straw features open through the day to try to melt the ice on the first few days before I began changing the ice to water ratio. We love these bottles. They are perfect for us! Also, the "boots" we purchased from Amazon fit perfectly and worked perfectly: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D7D4MYYK?ref=ppx_yo2ov_dt_b_fed_asin_title&th=1

reviews.title: Great overall! Just inspect the quality before use
reviews.body: Awesome little bottle; just finished a vacation and it was the perfect size for staying hydrated throughout the day while not being too big to carry around. Amazing insulation, too! If I put ice water in this overnight, usually there will still be unmelted ice in it by morning. Cleans very easily and I really like the lid options; I use the twist-off cap for pouring electrolyte mix or flavor packets, while I use the small spout for drinking. After one month of use, it has one dent (shown in photo) but that’s from the bottle accidentally being dropped on a concrete floor. Thankfully it doesn’t affect how it sits or anything. This thing is still very durable without being heavy. The only issue I’d bring up (shown in photo) is that the plastic of the drinking spout is kind of rough on the edges of the hole. It almost cut my lip the first time I used this (I wasn’t very careful inspecting it the first time I used it), and I have to pull off tiny flecks of plastic from it once in a while to make sure I’m not drinking any of the flecks. Really not ideal, but I prefer a plastic spout to a rubber one that could break. Even so, I figured it was worth mentioning, especially since a water bottle this size is often purchased for kids to use. (Also! Be sure the drinking spout is empty before you close it; if you don’t, the spout will leak a tiny bit of water when moved.) Having said all this, I still really like this water bottle. I wanted something small but durable for travel that kept cold water cold, in a bottle without a lot of loud branding on it. This one is super sturdy, with amazing insulation, in a convenient size, and in a really lovely neutral color! Recommended, if you can look past the rough plastic bit. Be sure to inspect it before using it!
