reviews.title: Falls short to Yeti but still nice!
reviews.body: I wanted this Stanley to be my reason to turn away from Yeti. I love the modern design, the all black, the non-fixed handle that can be tightened to be more fixed/harder to move, and the 50 oz capacity. It was nice to see that the bottle had 4 extra oz of capacity at the same price as Yeti’s 46 oz bottle. I need to drink lots of water throughout the day and the large capacity is awesome. The lightness was originally a selling point for me; while it can hold an astonishingly large 50 oz, since the bottle is relatively light in weight, it doesn’t feel too heavy to carry a full bottle around. However, where it excels in lightness it falls short in quality. It is glaringly lower quality than Yeti’s 46 oz bottle. This Stanley has thinner metal leading to poorer insulation. What frustrated me the most was realizing how much thinner the coating was compared to Yeti; I accidentally dinged it with a fork while heating up my lunch and chipped it! I’ve dropped my Yetis dozens of times and hit them with everything from forks and knives to granite countertops and haven’t had an issue with them chipping under light use. I even noticed it will take on light scratches from the plastic buckles on my lunch box if I let them touch while in my bag. Seriously poor coating. However, getting back to the pros, the leak resistance is great and when properly closed you can rest assured you won’t have spillage or leakage. Also the straw on this bottle is much nicer than the straws on Yeti bottles; less resistance and simply easier to sip. In the end, it’s a great water bottle that has a cool modern look and a huge capacity. Overall this comes in at 4/5 stars with only one star being lost to the thinner metal and thinner coating. I would still suggest getting the Yeti 46 oz instead for the thicker metal and coating as it will likely last longer and endure more.

reviews.title: Lives up to the hype — with one real caveat about the straw
reviews.body: I'll be honest: I was skeptical about paying this much for a water bottle. A few months in, it's earned it. Insulation is genuinely impressive. I fill it with ice water in the morning and there's still ice in there at the end of a full workday. No other tumbler I've owned has done that consistently. The outside stays completely dry too — no condensation rings on your desk or car seat. The Flowstate lid is the feature I didn't know I needed. Three positions (straw, sip, closed) and it rotates smoothly. I use the straw position all day and the closed setting when I toss it in my bag. Cup holder fit: yes, it actually fits. The H2.0 redesigned the base specifically for this and it works — fits my car's cup holder without forcing it. The one real issue: if the tumbler tips over with the straw in, liquid leaks out through the straw opening. It's not fully spill-proof. I've had it knock over on my desk and it made a mess. Worth knowing before you put it near a laptop or in a bag without the straw removed. It's a lid designed for drinking, not for carrying around at an angle. The Rose Quartz color is accurate to photos — a soft, muted dusty pink. Not hot pink, not beige. Genuinely pretty. Worth the money if you actually use a tumbler daily. If you're on the fence about the price, you'll stop questioning it within a week.

reviews.title: Great Bottle with Minor Design Flaws - 4/5 Stars
reviews.body: I've been using the WATERSY 1 gallon insulated bottle for about six months, and it's held up remarkably well. Build Quality & Durability: This bottle is built like a tank. I've dropped it multiple times, including on the cap, and nothing has broken or cracked. The handle is solid and shows no signs of wear even with daily use. The insulation works excellently - it keeps water cold for the advertised 48 hours, which is perfect for long hikes or all-day events. Ease of Use: The wide mouth opening makes filling, emptying, and cleaning incredibly easy. You can fit your entire hand inside for thorough cleaning, and ice cubes go in without any hassle. No concerns about mold or buildup in hard-to-reach areas. The Drinking Challenge: Here's where it gets tricky - tilting a full gallon of liquid to drink from the mouth can feel heavy and awkward. The air displacement while drinking creates a loud gurgling sound that can be disruptive in quiet settings like offices or meetings. A metal straw option would solve both issues and make this bottle perfect. The Bottom Plate Problem: The rubber on the bottom sits slightly higher than the metal rim, which creates two annoying issues. When you set it down on hard surfaces, it makes a bell-like ringing sound. Worse, the exposed metal rim will scratch tables, desks, and countertops because the bottle is so heavy. I've had to start using a placemat to protect my furniture. Bottom Line: Despite the drinking awkwardness and bottom plate design flaw, this is still an excellent water bottle for anyone who needs serious hydration capacity and temperature retention. Just be prepared to use a coaster and maybe invest in a separate metal straw. The durability and insulation quality make it worth the minor inconveniences.

reviews.title: AMAZING bottle at an AMAZING Price!!
reviews.body: This water bottle is a dream - everything I wanted in a bottle AND for a price better than anything I've seen anywhere else: -Non-straw lids: I personally don't often like to be bothered to clean straws. So to have not one, but two alternative lids to that? Amazing. And if I decide I do want to mess with the straws, there's more than one so they can be rotated, and a brush to clean them as well. -Dishwasher safe: I want as few dishes in my life to be hand-wash as possible. The fact that I can just throw this in the dishwasher is absolutely amazing. -Great insulating capabilities: I filled this bottle up with ice to the top the first morning, and there was a good amount of the original ice more than 48 hours later (keeping in mind this was all in an indoor setting). I will say I'm not as much of a hot beverage person, so I can't verify about the heating capabilities. Stability: The silicone base does it's job great. I will say I am clumsy, so it's not impossible for me to still knock the water bottle over, but that's fine because... Seal: The seals on the handle lid and the spout lid both work great. I haven't tried the straw lid, full disclosure, but the other two I have knocked over and had no leaks. I actually turned the bottle completely upside down after I filled it and put the spout lid on for the first time and there were no issues. Now of course it doesn't fit in cup holders, but it's a 40 ounce bottle, so that's not surprising, and honestly no big deal for me.

reviews.title: Sturdy, Versatile Bottle That Grows on You
reviews.body: I’ve been using the Konokyo Insulated Water Bottle and overall it’s a solid, well-thought-out bottle with a lot going for it. The biggest plus is how versatile it is. I use it for both hot and cold liquids, and it handles both extremely well. The insulation does its job, keeping drinks at temperature for hours. I also really appreciate that it’s dishwasher safe, which makes cleaning simple and hassle-free. Another standout feature is that it comes with three different lids, which gives you flexibility depending on how you’re using it—work, travel, workouts, or just daily hydration. The bottle itself feels very sturdy and durable, like it can handle being tossed into a bag without worry. The only downside for me is that it’s a bit tall for my liking, and it does take a little time to get used to handling it. That said, once you adjust, it becomes second nature—and honestly, once you do, you’ll probably end up loving it. Overall, this is a reliable, durable, and versatile insulated bottle. A great choice if you want something that works well for both hot and cold drinks and offers flexibility right out of the box.

reviews.title: Almost PERFECT - Spout Orientation not ideal
reviews.body: Here's my updated review: Meoky customer service reached out to me and went to extraordinary measures to address my concerns. While they can't fix the orientation of the spout, they absolutely made things right! So here's what I would say - if you're considering buying one of these bottles, understand that it is very likely that the spout orientation will not be as shown in the pictures. That being said, the bottle is still functional and it keeps ice COLD. I filled it with ice on a Sunday and there was still ice in the jug on Thursday! And you can have absolute confidence that the customer service is top notch! I'm not sure I can give this a full 5-stars because of the spout orientation difference compared to the product photos, but if I could, I would definitely give a 4.5 stars! __________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Original Review: I love everything about this EXCEPT that the lid is not oriented how the pictures and videos show. I’m not sure of this is a one-off mistake on the item we received or if they’re all like that. Here’s why it’s important - the spout should be opposite the handles so that you can grip the handles in one hand and pour into a cup or bottle that you’re holding with the other. Also, that is the orientation needed to actually use the really cool feature of having flat molded spots to position the jug on a flat surface and pour without it rolling. With the inner lid being oriented 90 degrees in the wrong direction, the only options for screwing the lid on result in the pour spout being on the wrong position to use this, which means you have to use both hands to pour and it will not out if laid down on a picnic table or other flat surface. Other than that it kept ice frozen for 96+ hrs but the spout location is a deal breaker. Trying to decide if we should order another one to see if it’s a single mistake or just order a different brand.

reviews.title: Starts off excellent, then deteriorates, loses insulation, and NO support from MEOKY company
reviews.body: I really like this! I pored over so many listings to find a product that had everything I wanted: steel construction, a top handle, a pair of folding side grip handles, a combination stray and spout opening, no-drip, and insulated. This has it all. It's honestly a beast of a jug, which is perfect for the gym. My only critique would be the insulation: it's adequate but not spectacular. If I fill the jug with cold water and a handful of ice today, then by tomorrow when I wake up the ice will be melted and the water more tepid than cold. But for same-day use, it'll keep your drinks cold without problem! Edit: All of the above is accurate...UNTIL you wash it. I ran it through a dishwasher on low heat with no heat dry, but even that seems to have destroyed its internal insulation. Less than a year old, and not only does it fail to keep anything cold anymore, it seems to actually accelerate warming! If I fill this with one-third ice before adding water, it now remains cold until early afternoon, by which time the ice has melted and the water is tepid, if not room temperature. That's when you discover that the company, MEOKY, offers no support whatsoever. Their website claims 24/7 support, but they do not respond to repeated emails. They promote a Facebook support page, which has many customer inquiries for years, with not one single response from the company to ANY of them. They have an Instagram, where they did reply to me to reaffirm that they have product support, and then not one single response since then, contradicting that pledge. This is exactly the design I want in a water bottle, but I won't buy from this company again because they haven't earned my loyalty. There are identical clones of this bottle, and I'll buy those instead as a replacement.

reviews.title: Sturdy, durable, holds temperature well, and easy to drink from
reviews.body: I have a larger Camelbak insulated stainless steel water bottle, but wanted a smaller one for my daily walks. It's perfect. The handle on the lid makes it easy to carry when I'm out walking, and the smaller size means I'm carrying less weight. I chose the stainless steel bottle over plastic to cut down on consumption of microplastics and PFAs. (The lid is still plastic, but overall, there's less plastic.) The stainless steel has the added benefit of not picking up odors or emitting that plastic-y smell that some water bottles have. And the double-wall construction keeps my drink cool for a surprisingly long time, even in a hot car. The lid design is great for drinking on the go; the spout is wide enough to get a good gulp of water without spilling the whole thing when you're on the move. The magnet holds the spout's lid in place when you want to leave it open -- while you're driving, for instance. And I have never had any problem with leakage when the lid and the spout cover are both screwed on properly. Judging by my larger bottle, which I have had for a year, the stainless Camelbaks are quite durable. Even the enamel(?) finish is pretty durable. I have dropped my bigger one several times, and it still shows only minor scratches and a barely-visible, tiny dent. Cleaning is easy -- much easier than the Camelbaks with a straw. The bottle has a wide mouth, so it's easy to get a bottle brush inside. The lid requires a smaller brush to get into the crevices, but it's not difficult. (Not like cleaning the straw and bite spout on the straw models!) I've had Camelbaks for years, beginning with the straw-and-bite-spout, plastic bottle models. These stainless ones are my favorites. I rarely go out without it.

reviews.title: Great hydration companion
reviews.body: CamelBak Chute Mag 40oz Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle in Black has truly impressed me as an outdoor enthusiast and as someone who places a premium on being hydrated while on the run. This water bottle has effortlessly become my constant companion, guaranteeing that no matter where my travels take me, I will always have access to a refreshing drink. The CamelBak Chute Mag's sophisticated simplicity immediately drew my attention. The sleek, black stainless steel exterior makes a bold statement in any environment. The matte finish gives it a subtle sophistication and provides a secure grip, both of which are essential for use in the great outdoors. The bottle's shape is ideal; I can carry it with one hand and store it in a discrete location in my backpack. Whether I'm out on a mountain trail or running errands in town, my CamelBak Chute Mag is never far from my side. This water bottle's magnetic grip is one of its most distinctive features. The powerful magnet built into the cap keeps it firmly in place so you never have to use one hand to hold the cap while using the other to sip. This seemingly trivial but brilliant design feature has revolutionized the ease with which I can keep myself hydrated on the go. Not only is it easy to fill and clean thanks to the large mouth of the cap, but the rounded sides also make it comfortable to drink from. The leak-proof construction of the cap has saved me from a number of potential mishaps in my bag and vehicle. The CamelBak Chute Mag's superior insulating properties set it apart from the rest of the pack. The stainless steel body of this water bottle is vacuum insulated, so even in the hottest weather, your drink will stay ice cold for hours. Recently, I went on a hike in the heat and was blown away by how cool my water stayed for about twenty-four hours. I did the same thing on a frigid morning with some hot beverages, and they kept nice and toasty all day. This revolutionary ability to maintain temperature means that I can always enjoy my chosen beverage at the perfect degree. The CamelBak Chute Mag meets the high standards of durability expected of outdoor equipment. This water bottle is made from durable 18/8 stainless steel, so it can survive the abuse of camping trips. It has been accidentally dropped onto rough ground and brushed up against rough surfaces without suffering any damage. The powder coating not only adds to the bottle's aesthetically pleasing design but also serves as an additional barrier against wear and tear. The CamelBak Chute Mag is notable for being environmentally friendly. This water bottle is made of stainless steel, making it a more eco-friendly option than disposable plastic bottles. By choosing a reusable bottle instead of a disposable one, I've helped curb wasteful single-use plastic bottle use. The high quality of the bottle's construction ensures that it will meet my hydration demands and my ethical obligations to the planet for many years to come. Last but not least, the CamelBak Chute Mag 40oz Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle in Black has become an indispensible accessory for my vigorous daily routine. I was not expecting it to be as stylish or as well insulated or as long lasting or as committed to sustainability as this product is. This water bottle has never failed to provide me with the promised refreshment, convenience, and style, whether I'm climbing summits, riding through trails, or simply navigating the demands of daily life. The CamelBak Chute Mag is, without a shadow of a doubt, one of the best accessories I've ever purchased.

The powerful magnet built into the cap keeps it firmly in place so you never have to use one hand to hold the cap while using the other to sip. This seemingly trivial but brilliant design feature has revolutionized the ease with which I can keep myself hydrated on the go. Not only is it easy to fill and clean thanks to the large mouth of the cap, but the rounded sides also make it comfortable to drink from. The leak-proof construction of the cap has saved me from a number of potential mishaps in my bag and vehicle. The CamelBak Chute Mag's superior insulating properties set it apart from the rest of the pack. The stainless steel body of this water bottle is vacuum insulated, so even in the hottest weather, your drink will stay ice cold for hours. Recently, I went on a hike in the heat and was blown away by how cool my water stayed for about twenty-four hours. I did the same thing on a frigid morning with some hot beverages, and they kept nice and toasty all day. This revolutionary ability to maintain temperature means that I can always enjoy my chosen beverage at the perfect degree. The CamelBak Chute Mag meets the high standards of durability expected of outdoor equipment. This water bottle is made from durable 18/8 stainless steel, so it can survive the abuse of camping trips. It has been accidentally dropped onto rough ground and brushed up against rough surfaces without suffering any damage. The powder coating not only adds to the bottle's aesthetically pleasing design but also serves as an additional barrier against wear and tear. The CamelBak Chute Mag is notable for being environmentally friendly. This water bottle is made of stainless steel, making it a more eco-friendly option than disposable plastic bottles. By choosing a reusable bottle instead of a disposable one, I've helped curb wasteful single-use plastic bottle use. The high quality of the bottle's construction ensures that it will meet my hydration demands and my ethical obligations to the planet for many years to come. Last but not least, the CamelBak Chute Mag 40oz Vacuum Insulated Stainless Steel Water Bottle in Black has become an indispensible accessory for my vigorous daily routine. I was not expecting it to be as stylish or as well insulated or as long lasting or as committed to sustainability as this product is. This water bottle has never failed to provide me with the promised refreshment, convenience, and style, whether I'm climbing summits, riding through trails, or simply navigating the demands of daily life. The CamelBak Chute Mag is, without a shadow of a doubt, one of the best accessories I've ever purchased.

reviews.title: Very small, keeps things cold/hot for a long time, not the best lid/cap.
reviews.body: This is a nice bottle. I bought it to see if it would work as a replacement for my much bigger 64 Oz water bottle. It did not. I drink way too much water for this size to do anything for me, so I stopped using it 90% of the time. That said, it does function rather well and did keep my water ice cold longer than needed, so it is a good water bottle with a good seal and I didn't notice any metallic taste, but as I said I am used to my 64 Oz insulated bottle so I never minded any taste if there were one. The lid for this is not the best. If you're just doing water then it's not a huge deal, but if you're doing anything else, like coffee or hot chocolate, then you're going to need to scrub the whole thing out thoroughly after use which is mildly annoying. Cleaning aside I just don't like the cap for this bottle. It feels cheap and like it could break any any time. The odd hinge design is not satisfying to use because you can't absentmindedly flip it open. You have to consciously pull it up and out at the right angle in line with the strange sideways angled accordion mechanism. Overall, not terrible and it works well as a liquid storage device. But once you're used to a 64 Oz bottle these tiny bottles get emptied after one and a half sips. Also, I would definitely change the lid/cap for anything else because the stock one is bad.

reviews.title: Brilliant bottle that keeps water ice cold for hours, outperforms most others!

I’ve taken this on holiday and left it out in the sun to the point that the outside was too hot to touch, but the water inside was still ice cold. The wide mouth makes it easy to clean or put ice in when needed, and there's no odd taste from the plastic lid either. Unfortunately, CamelBak seem to have changed the design recently and the newer version doesn’t perform quite as well. Real shame, as the original was spot on. If you can still find this older version, it’s an easy recommendation.

reviews.title: Spitze in allen Bereichen
reviews.body: Ich habe viele Trink- und/oder Isoflaschen probiert - irgendwas war immer: undicht, schlechtes Isolierverhalten, klobig, schwer, metallischer Nachgeschmack, umständliche Reinigung, optisch kein Highlight, Deckel beim trinken im Weg oder ohne Deckelsicherung (Herunterfallen / Verlust), usw. Nicht so die Camelbak Chute Mag 600 ml Vacuum in schwarz. Sie ist absolut dicht. In allen Lagen. Auch mit Kohlensäure (kein explodieren). Der kleine Deckel kann, wenn man z.B. am Platz sitzt, nur lose aufgesteckt werden. Zum Transport wird der kleine Deckel dann zugedreht - und ist komplett dicht. Durch die magnetische Funktion bleibt der geöffnete Deckel aus dem Gesicht und angelegt an der Gegenseite. Der Deckel kann nicht verloren gehen, da er verbunden ist. Die Weithalsöffnung, also oben am Flaschenhals wo die Deckelkonstruktion angeschraubt wird, erlaubt komfortables Auffüllen oder auch das Einbringen von Eiswürfeln - und natürlich eine leichte Reinigung. Geschmacksneutraler Deckel, Dichtungen und Flaschenkörper. Kein Nachgeschmack. Nichts. Null. Passt mit den Maßen in alle zuhause vorgefundenen Seiten-, Rucksack- und Zubehörtaschen. Lediglich der Tragegriff kann je nach Konstruktion der Tasche und wenn die Tasche komplett die Flasche umschließt, Zicken machen. Die schwarze, durchgehende (anders als beim Vorgängermodell) Pulverbeschichtung verleiht eine formschöne Optik. Ein echter Hingucker, da auch der Deckel elegant aussieht und haptisch wertig ist. Keine Lackierfehler, bei meiner Flasche auch keine hellen Punkte von zu wenig verwendeter Farbe. Laut Aufdruck auf dem Flaschenboden sind Cap und Vessel, also Deckel und Gefäß, spülmaschinensicher (siehe Foto). Meine Trinkflaschen werden alle von Hand gereinigt. Ich kann daher diesen Punkt nicht beurteilen. Aber die Konstruktion erlaubt einfachen Aus- und Zusammenbau in die zwei Teile Deckel und Behälter und eine einfache Reinigung. Meine Trinkflasche wird nur mit kaltem Wasser - mit und ohne Kohlensäure - befüllt. Die Isolierleistung soll bei kalten Getränken länger als bei heißen Getränken sein. Ich kann nur für den Punkt Kaltgetränke sprechen und auch hier glänzt die Flasche mit Bestleistungen. Und das ohne Temperaturaustausch mit der äußeren Flaschenhülle. Kein schwitzen außen, kein Wärmetransport nach innen (im Zeitraum eines "normalen" Leertrinkens). Die Suche hat ein Ende. Ich hoffe, die Flasche hält weiterhin ihr Niveau, denn günstig ist sie nicht, auch wenn sie leider, wie so vieles, Made in China ist. Aber sie ist den Preis wert. Zumindest bis dato - und falls nicht, wird die Bewertung angepasst. 5 Sterne, weil mehr nicht geht. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟
reviews.body_en: I tried a lot of drinking and/or insulated bottles - there was always something: leaking, poor insulating properties, bulky, heavy, metallic aftertaste, difficult to clean, not a visual highlight, lid in the way when drinking or no lid lock (dropping/losing), etc. Not so with the Camelbak Chute Mag 600 ml Vacuum in black. It is absolutely sealed. In all situations. Also carbonated (no explosion). The small lid can only be attached loosely, for example when you are sitting at your place. The small lid is then closed for transport - and is completely sealed. The magnetic function keeps the opened lid out of your face and on the opposite side. The lid cannot be lost because it is connected. The wide neck opening, i.e. at the top of the bottle neck where the lid construction is screwed on, allows for convenient filling or the insertion of ice cubes - and of course easy cleaning. Tasteless lid, seals and bottle body. No aftertaste. Nothing. Zero. The dimensions fit into all side pockets, backpack pockets and accessory pockets found at home. Only the carrying handle can cause problems, depending on the construction of the bag and if the bag completely encloses the bottle. The black, continuous powder coating (unlike the previous model) gives it an elegant look. A real eye-catcher, as the lid also looks elegant and has a good feel. No painting errors, and on my bottle no bright spots from underused paint. According to the print on the bottom of the bottle, the cap and vessel are dishwasher safe (see photo). All of my drinking bottles are cleaned by hand. I therefore cannot comment on this point. But the design allows for easy disassembly and assembly into the two parts lid and container and easy cleaning. My drinking bottle is only filled with cold water - carbonated and non-carbonated. The insulation performance should be longer for cold drinks than for hot drinks. I can only speak for cold drinks and the bottle shines here too. And all this without exchanging temperature with the outer bottle shell. No sweating on the outside, no heat transport inside (during the period of a “normal” empty drink). The search is over. I hope the bottle continues to maintain its standard, because it is not cheap, even if, like so many things, it is unfortunately made in China. But it's worth the price. At least so far - and if not, the rating will be adjusted. 5 stars because nothing more is possible. 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

reviews.title: This is *IT*
reviews.body: Let me start off by saying that I'm not an influencer, nor have I received anything in return for this honest review. I also gave this tumbler a solid month of daily use before I put in my 2 cents. Also, the pictures were taken in broad daylight. The picture of me holding it upside down is the only time it leaked, but, ya know, I'm holding it full of water, upside down, and even then, only a tiny bit escaped. Through the straw, not the lid, mind you. When the straw was removed and I held it upside down, droplets escaped, one by one. I didn't purchase this for any other reason than to reduce my beverage goblin tendencies, and to support my laziness in regards to washing excess dishes. I bought this because I was tired of having a car cup and a house cup. My house cup is my favorite, it also holds 40 oz, but doesn't fit any cup holder because it's essentially a tank (I copped it on clearance at Walmart 2 years ago for like, $6, and it's the tits). HOWEVER, it really sucks to not be able to take it everywhere, and it's definitely not spill proof. So I had that tank for the house, and my 8 year old 30 oz Yeti for the vehicle, since it fits. I've never used a Stanley so I cannot compare, though I do own the Simple Modern 64oz summit, had it for years, and it's stood the test of time and regular use, both outdoor and indoor. But it's not practical because, although it's very well made, it's massive, heavy, handle-less, and rolls out of the passenger seat onto the floor and out of reach, leaving me parched and annoyed. This tumbler is well-made, from the unit itself to the lid and straw, and the price point is beyond reasonable. I'd have paid $40 for it because of how well it's preformed. The handle is sturdy and comfortable, and it supports the full weight of 40 oz of ice water easily. I've dropped it several times and the powder coating hasn't chipped, nor has the metal dinged. Although most wouldn't think if it, it is SO nice to decide where I want the straw to be in regards to where and how I'm sitting and what hand I'm reaching for it with. It washes up easily. It's not obnoxiously large and it's overall appearance is low-key. It keeps my tea cold and fresh for 2 days indoors. I've left it filled with ice water in my vehicle for 2 days (in early June in the south, mind you). I got super thirsty after a grocery run and took a sip. It was room temperature, if not a skosh cool, but in no way was it warm, even though the cup itself was. It's fallen out of a backseat cup holder and laid on the floor for well over an hour without my knowledge, and although a few drops escaped from the straw, the carpet of my vehicle was dry, and the tumbler was still full of ice water. And, ya know, it keeps you hydrated because you can always keep that thang on you. I ordered the almond color. It's really more of a very light beige. Or coffee that's mostly creamer. A lot lighter than you'd think. It's definitely that boring popular aesthetic hue that everyone's so into, so if that's what you're going for, it's spot on. All in all, I really really REALLY like this tumbler and I'd definitely recommend it. Then again, Simple Modern products haven't ever really let me down, so it's not a huge shocker.

reviews.title: Stainless Steel Water Bottle 40oz, Black, Secure Leak Resistant Lid. Holds Ice for Many Hours. Nice!
reviews.body: CamelBak Thrive Chug Stainless Steel Water Bottle 40oz, Black - CamelBak I purchased this forty-ounce insulated stainless steel water bottle to keep cold water handy during long days out without needing constant refills. Pulling it out of the thin paper shipping bag, the matte black powder-coat finish gives it a sleek look, and the integrated rubber bumper on the bottom keeps it firmly grounded. Filling it up with cold tap water and a few ice cubes is easy thanks to the wide neck opening. The double-wall vacuum insulation does a fantastic job holding temperature. I filled it up in the morning, and the water stayed ice-cold all day long without sweating on the outside or leaving wet rings on my wooden desk. Even the next day, both the ice and water were still in the bottle. The chug-style spout cap unscrews smoothly and tethered out of the way, making it easy to take quick, large gulps without fighting a narrow straw or a clunky latch. Carrying forty ounces of liquid has some weight, but the soft-grip handle built into the lid makes it comfortable to haul around. The screw-on lid seals down tight against the mouth rim, so I can toss it onto the passenger seat of my car without worrying about slow leaks dripping onto the upholstery. The silicone boot on the base is a great touch—it dampens noise whenever I set it down on a hard countertop and protects the steel bottom from getting dented if it takes a hard knock. Paying around thirty-eight dollars for a solid daily water bottle feels reasonable given the heavy stainless steel construction and reliable thermal performance. Running the whole assembly through the dishwasher after a long day makes cleanup completely effortless without ruining the outer finish. The forty-ounce body is definitely on the bulkier side, so it won't fit into standard automotive cup holders, but the extra capacity is worth the trade-off. It holds plenty of water to get through an entire afternoon without stopping for top-offs. Pros: ✅ Double-wall vacuum insulation keeps drinks cold all day without sweating ✅ Rubber bumper base prevents clanking and protects against bottom dents ✅ High-flow chug spout makes drinking fast and mess-free ✅ Built-in carry handle feels sturdy and comfortable in hand ✅ A reasonable value Cons: ❌ Large 40-ounce diameter is too wide to fit standard car cup holders ❌ Metal exterior can dent if roughly handled ❌ Tall thin profile reduces stability and can lead to tips/spills -- keep it closed and away from electronics

reviews.body: Edit: a few months later and I have to say I’m still quite impressed. The water was actually cold like it had been sitting in the fridge. That Friday I filled it about 3 quarters of the way with ice cubes. B. The metal feels of high quality. The outside of the bottle has a mostly smooth slightly bumpy - really very slightly - feel to it. It’s been in my bag when I dropped it on hard floor out of carelessness or anger and it has not even a slight dent. It’s rolled on cement floor, been kicked down, and has not a scratch. The only thing that concerns me is the cover. The cover is made of plastic and it does feel a bit thin. I have played with cover a lot (I fidget with anything I can get my hands on) and it’s still perfect. I’ve had this water bottle for a few months now. C. In A and B I’ve included everything I have to say about how well this masterpiece of a water bottle has been holding up, but here’s a summery: I’ve had this for a few months now and it’s been dropped, kicked over, knocked over, rolled around, played with, and more I’m sure, and it’s perfect. Not a dent or a scratch. Works as well as when I got it. COLOR: I got the bottle with the blue base and pink and orange cover and it looks exactly the same in person as it did in the picture. With all the different patterns to choose from, you’re sure to find one that you love. I’ve got so many compliments on the pastel color and overall aesthetic look of the bottle. WHAT SETS THIS BOTTLE APART FROM OTHERS: I’ll get straight to the point: it’s the cover. The cover has a unique design that cannot be compared to any other water bottle. Firstly, it has a spout, giving you the option of drinking from a straw. But you also have a chugging option because of the way the whole cover can flip up easily. Second (and this is a big one), is that because the cover can flip up easily without you having to unscrew it, it lets you fill up your water bottle with as many ice cubes as you please without having to spend 5 minutes every morning trying to screw it closed. And that’s what really sets it apart from other water bottles; the genius design of the cover.

reviews.title: Wonderful water bottle but a bit finicky
reviews.body: I have had this bottle for a year now and really love it, Ello just needs to work on a few things. I had the bottle for like 6 months ish until, like other reviewers, the plastic latch on the lid broke. I used the water bottle every day so there was definitely a ton of wear on the latch but that should be expected in a water bottle and so the latch needs to be made more durable. I reached out to customer service who kindly sent me another lid. Since getting that lid, in the last 4 months, I'v started getting leaks! The rubber gasket that keeps the pop up lid sealed jumps out of its position whenever the bottle is opened so if you don't remember to triple check that it's positioned properly you will spill the entire contents of the bottle (also an issue noted with other reviewers). Weird bc I didn't have this issue w the first bottle. Customer service is again sending me another lid (note they do have a limited lifetime warranty). I am still pretty committed to this bottle regardless of the above issues if that tells you how much I like it anyway! The color is cute, the metal is high quality, the insulation keeps water cold for several days. I love the pop lid/straw design of the top and it's so unique I don't want to get any other bottle. Even if the above issues are irritating I'd still probably just buy another one and hope it doesn't have issues bc I do like it so much!

reviews.title: I've purchased 7 of them! I know what I'm talking about!
reviews.body: Do not buy any other water bottle. This is the best out there! I have purchased seven of them. I lost two black ones awhile back. They never appear in Lost and Founds because they are too good. People keep them when found!!! The next three I purchased were green and a blue one. The blue one was for a gift! Yes, I lost one green one but still holding out hopes to find it. One green stopped working correctly. The plastic top that covers the mouthpiece stopped latching closed. Then I dropped it and the lid cracked. I went online to find a replacement lid. But the one I received was not the same, so I returned it and ordered TWO more water bottles light green. PRO: The lid is important. Its Flip to Fill means you just pop open the top and you can add ice and water without having to twist the whole lid off. As you know, if you have ice, the straw is hard to twist the lid and stay connected. This is the best feature of the water bottle. CON: It is too wide to fit in my water bottle holder on my bike. It would be great to have a slim choice. Additionally--(if that's a word)-I purchased a water bottle holder with straps that can go over the shoulder or around the waist. I really don't want to lose another one! I usually wait until I can find one that goes on sale for 18.00 and buy that color. Do not buy the replacement lids on Amazon. Even though they say Flip to fill, they are not. Go on the products website. They have the exact lid. It costs the same once you add in the tax and shipping fee. The water bottles cost more on the the products site so better pricing on Amazon.

reviews.title: My Favorite Water Bottle—The Pop & Fill Lid Is a Game Changer
reviews.body: I’ve tried a lot of insulated water bottles, and this is easily my favorite brand. The Pop & Fill lid is the reason I keep coming back. You don’t have to completely remove the lid to refill it—just pop it open to add ice, water, or your favorite drink. It’s so much more convenient than traditional bottles. As a breastfeeding mom, I especially appreciate that I can open it and drink with one hand while holding my baby. That alone makes it worth it for me. The insulation keeps my drinks cold for hours, it’s leakproof, and it’s become my go-to bottle for everyday use and travel. The only thing to know is that the 32 oz version is a little too large for most cup holders, but that’s pretty typical for bottles this size. I also own the 22 oz version, which fits much better in cup holders if that’s important to you. Overall, I absolutely love this bottle and recommend it to anyone looking for a high-quality insulated water bottle—especially busy parents.

reviews.title: I loved it.... but it broke
reviews.body: Pros: very functional and cute! Cons: not durable. This water bottle is incredibly cute and worked perfectly for making drinks at home and transporting them to the office without worrying about it leaking in my backpack. The top fully opening without unscrewing the lid made adding ice and drink mixes super easy! I even sent pics of it to my friends cuz of how cute the colors are. Being able to toss it in the dishwasher was a huge plus too. BUT. I bought this in May, probably used it less than 30 times... but the lid has already broken. The latch on the clear lid broke off, so there's no way to stop it from leaking out of the mouth piece. This means I can't use it for its intended purpose (carrying it in my backpack). I wasn't rough with it either, I never dropped it, I only used the clear lid when it was on my backpack so I didn't stress the latch frequently, and it was placed very carefully in my dishwasher away from other items... this was just a cheap product. So I can't recommend this product, because it ended up costing me about $1 per use and that's frankly ridiculous. I am very sad :/

reviews.title: Best water bottle EVER-till it wasn't.
reviews.body: I searched for years for a decent water bottle that met a very specific criteria and wasn't crazy in price. During that time, I also tried several that didn't meet their promises. I was so excited to find this model that surprisingly checked all the boxes and I loved it even more than I thought I would, until one of the most important features failed randomly after a couple of months. I travel frequently for work so having a spill proof bottle, that doesn't sweat, and keeping my hands as far from where my mouth goes is important for my line of work too. But having a lid that locks was an absolute non negotiable! When out of the blue one day I noticed my lid was open. I thought maybe I just forgot to close it, push it close. NOPE! The little nubbin that holds the lock shut broke off while sitting on my table. I LOVED this water bottle and I hesitate to buy another after this experience and seeing many others. There's no replacement tops available to buy from them and the knock offs don't fill without removing the top. Am I going to pay $25 to have a second cup without a lid, no! This cup was so easy to wash, carry, fill and drink from. No having to risk my safety or set a lid down on random counters, in airports, train stations, construction sites, public bathrooms, or labs to fill. No concern about a random persons germs, dirt, or a toxic substance being placed in or on my drink. No sweating, keeps drinks cold, no weird plastic taste. I'm honestly devastated.

reviews.title: On point and has every feature you could need.
reviews.body: This bottle is perfect for what I use it for! I work for the Railroad so I am very hard on my things and they need to last. This is extremely sturdy and made with high-quality durable parts. I have only used it for cold drinks because I don’t need any type of hot drink for 12 hours, but it does keep very cold and keeps ice floating around up to 48 hours without sweating or building condensation. Despite how heavy and awkward it can get when you are putting 128 ounces of fluid into it on top of its already solid construction, I find it very easy to carry, move, and drink from. The included flip top handle is great and can be adjusted up or down. The handles on the side are also great for carrying it and if you are not wanting to use them, they fold into the bottle itself. I think having both options for a straw and for a chug cap is an awesome feature that I didn’t realize the handiness of before I bought it. It has been perfect for filling up at home and especially at the gas station or wherever you get your drinks from. I believe out of every bottle I researched to buy, which was quite a few, the opening on this one was the widest allowing you to add many different types of ice or fill it using different types of spouts and machines at the gas station. Adding to that, so far the height has been just right. You can slide it under spouts or ice machines without having to tip it at an awkward angle. If you make sure you are properly tightening the top, the cap, and pushing the straw all the way down then you will have zero leakage at all. You can flip it around, roll it around in the car, or simply hold it upside down and it does not leak a drop. I searched for quite a while for a water bottle that met all of my needs and had all the features I wanted. I liked quite a few, but they all had something that I would’ve had to settle for or didn’t like. This one includes everything that I was wanting plus it is extremely affordable for all that it does. It is 1/2 up to even 1/4 the price of other insulated gallon jugs that do not have the same features. Finally, their customer service is responsive and cares about the customer. I left an email with pictures and videos on a Friday because I thought my jug was leaking. They responded within a day or two, which was still over the weekend, and made a detailed markup of my pictures respectfully showing me that I was more than likely using it incorrectly and causing the leaks. However, they told me I didn’t even need to try the solutions they recommended if I didn’t want to and if I wanted a replacement, refund, or anything else they would be more than happy to oblige. 100% recommend to buy

reviews.title: My New Best Friend!
reviews.body: This water bottle is simply awesome. So many well-thought-out features! I love how big it is - it holds a gallon! It is really solidly built. The double handles on the side are really sturdy, but fold completely away. There are small cleats on one side so the bottle can be stable when placed on its side on a level surface. The lid is really nicely designed. It tightens down in about a half turn and seals tightly. It includes a pour nozzle with a captured cap, so you can't lose it. And the flip-up sipper makes for easy access whenever you're thirsty, no lifting or pouring needed. But the BEST part is inside. The inside is a seamless stainless steel liner, evidently double-wall. There are no penetrations of any sort, so no place for bacteria to collect, and absolutely easy to clean. And, IT WILL KEEP LIQUIDS COOL FOR THREE DAYS! I'm not kidding. I routinely mix up almost a gallon of Gatorade in it, add some ice, and drop in a frozen water bottle. I've sipped on one for three days, and when it was empty there were still chunks of ice in it! If you work outdoors, or in an un-air conditioned shop (I do both) this water bottle is a life saver!

reviews.title: Durable and well insulated
reviews.body: I do HVAC work, so a lot of time spent in the hot sun, hot attics, etc. so I drink a lot of water, and this bottle gets me through just about every single day. It does a really great job at keeping beverages cold. I had it in a 130+ degree attic for like 4 hours and it was still ice cold by the time I was done. I have it sitting in direct sunlight outside for multiple hours quite often, and same deal. Not only that, but it’s sturdy. The handle is super robust and doesn’t feel like it’s gonna break or come loose at all, and I’ve dropped this bottle (while full of water) onto rocks, pavement, concrete, you name it, and aside from minor scratches it doesn’t show any signs of damage, even the smallest dent in the metal or crack in the plastic. It is very heavy when full, but that’s pretty obvious considering it holds a gallon. A cool feature that I want to point out too is the feet it has on the side to prevent rolling. It’s about time somebody did something like this. I can leave it sitting on the side and it won’t roll away, if I drop it and it starts rolling it’ll stop pretty quickly. I love that feature. I highly recommend this bottle!!

reviews.title: Does not keep ice water cold for more than a few hours
reviews.body: I bought this to take to work and have ice cold water I can fill out as I sit in my office, which is inside and AC controlled. The product states it will keep liquids cold for up to 3 days. This is not the case at all. I filled it up with cool water from my fridge, added plenty of ice in it, and the ice is melted within hours while sitting inside my house. I even filled it up the night before work with more ice and it was completed melted the next morning at 6am while sitting inside on my counter. The bottle is actually freezing cold to the touch on the outside, which leads me to think it is either defective or there is simply no insulation. No way it could keep anything hot or cold for very long. I ensure the lid was secured, and that the flip up lid was clicked closed. Hopefully the seller can make this right or I will be requesting a refund. Will update review after I hear back. Ice was completely melted within 1-2 hours while being inside at 70 degrees. Very disappointed.

reviews.title: A very good, well-designed insulated water bottle.
reviews.body: I wasn't sure if this one gallon size might be too big for me or not. But it turns out it's not. It's a perfect size to last me for my long days at work. I sometimes work 12 hours or more. It doesn't leak at all and it's got a wide mouth for cleaning. Along with a sipping straw and another screw on cap for pouring it into my smaller Yeti water bottle. It has solid fold away plastic handles for carrying and for pouring. Thats a very nice addition. I couldn't get the lid on where the spout would be on the opposite side of the fold out handles. The threads would never line up to achieve this. But then it occurred to me, it's designed this way. It's better to have the pour spout at a 90° angle on either the right or the left side of the fold out handles. That way you can actually see the water pouring, so you don't spill it. And it doesn't feel awkward or lopsided when you're pouring, which you might think it would. If it was the full 180 degrees from the handles your view would be blocked and you're likely to miss your container or glass. That was well thought out. It does a very good job keeping water cold for at least 24 hours. I put cold water in it in the morning along with a tray of ice cubes and when I get home late that evening I'll usually have just a little bit of water left and still some ice. By the next morning if I haven't drank it all, the water is still cold. The metal swing down carry handle is very sturdy and strong. I have no worries about that breaking. The bottle is also designed so that you can lay it on it side and it won't roll. I honestly can't think of anything else that they could have done to improve it. It has everything I'm looking for in an insulated water bottle. I'm pretty sure most of these insulated stainless steel water bottles all keep liquids cold for roughly the same length of time. In fact I read on a website where they've tested many many different insulated water bottles and they say the same thing. So save yourself some money and buy a good one like this Powcan.

Other than that, it’s a great water bottle and has worked very well for me.

reviews.title: This water bottle REFUSES to break OR spill!
reviews.body: I have been through TOO MANY water bottles in my life. The plastic ones shatter when dropped, the metal ones dent when dropped, and they're all just so easy TO DROP. And the LEAKS! I can't even tell you how many puddles I've caused from toting my water bottles around with me on the daily. I bought this water bottle for one reason: the PRICE. I was not looking for a good water bottle at the time, I guess because I stopped believing they were out there in the world, so I bought a cheap one assuming that it would have some kind of design flaw or break when I dropped it in a couple of weeks. I was WRONG! This is, hands down, THE BEST WATER BOTTLE I HAVE EVER OWNED. I have had it for over a year now, and I tote it with me on the daily, always on the move walking from class to class on a large outdoor college campus. There are THREE things that make this the best water bottle in the world: 1. It is HARD TO DROP, even for me! I just hook my finger through that little bendy hooky thing up top, close my fist, and that sucker stays on me! I walk everywhere with this thing, and when I'm holding it through the loop, it is basically UNDROPPABLE! When I'm drinking from it, the little hand indentation up at the top of the water bottle is a very comfortable fit, and even when the bottle is full and heavy, it feels very balanced. 2. WHEN I drop it, it DOESN'T BREAK! Let's face it: I am forgetful and clumsy. There are times when I don't hold the bottle the undroppable way. There are times when the bottle is sitting on my desk and I accidentally swipe it off. There was even this one time when I threw it into the air and then failed to catch it. But through all these drops, this bottle has not cracked yet. And a couple of my drops have been when the bottle was fullish. That being said, I haven't had TOO many major drops (thanks to the bottles undroppableness) so I wouldn't try pushing your luck with this one. But alot can be said just from the fact that this bottle has survived a year of daily use with ME, a certified water bottle destroyer. 3. IT DOESN'T LEAK! This bottle has something that's hard to find these days: A TOP THAT ACTUALLY WORKS! I have NEVER experienced a single leak with this bottle - NOT EVEN ONE! I throw my bottle into my bookbag all the time, with precious lecture notes and expensive textbooks, some of which are rented and must be returned, and I can do so with FULL CONFIDENCE that my water bottle will not leak on them! I'm not talking the side pocket of my bookbag, I am talking in the main zipper with all of my other stuff. I make ZERO EFFORT to be careful when the bottle is in my bookbag. All day long that bookbag bumps into desks, walls, people, gets turned upside down, gets thrown on the floor, sat on, turned upside down, etc. This sucker doesn't leak. And that's it. THREE things that go into making the PERFECT WATER BOTTLE. This water bottle also has the added benefit of having a killer price (I was happy to pay the price I paid for it even when I was still assuming it was nothing special). It also holds 40 ounces of water, which is kind of a large amount of water compared to most water bottles. I bought this bottle with ZERO EXPECTATIONS, and it has turned out to be one of my favorite buys from Amazon to date. It definitely sparks joy in my life! Thank you, Pogo water bottles. You have created something of VALUE.

reviews.title: Very Aesthetically Pleasing, Doesn't Leak, Easy to Carry Around
reviews.body: I love this water bottle. I had been lugging around a 64oz bottle that could barely fit in the side pockets of my backpack, and while it was nice to have during 12 hour shifts, I got sick of it. I got the purple bottle with the chug lid. The color is beautiful, the design of the bottle is very cute and elegant, and the actual hole you drink from is much more desireable to me than the straws/nips a lot of bottles use nowadays. Even though it is only 32oz, I find that I don't mind refilling it once a day to get in my 64oz. I actually prefer it to a 64oz bottle, since I know I'll be getting fresh, cool water after the first fill runs out. I've seen some comment that you can't actually "chug" with this bottle...well, of course you can't! The bottle isn't the thin, bendable plastic that you get with the water bottles from the store...it's sturdy!! And while you can't "chug," you can most certainly get some big gulps in! I'm not a slow water drinker. I don't want tiny sips, I want to get that +64oz in! This bottle is definitely good for that. You can easily get 4oz, and even more, in a single gulp. Haha, I even did it now, just to be sure... I really love this thing. It is exactly what I was looking for, and the price is great. The lid is also very easy to open and close, but still very sturdy and secure. It also seems quite easy to clean, though I haven't had to do so just yet. For those who have seen mold growth on their water bottles...you must wash these things at LEAST once a week, if not more often, especially if you wear anything on your lips like chapstick, lipstick, etc. Even the slight bit of backwash from out filthy human mouths is enough to contaminate the insides of the bottle. If you live in a warmer climate, this is especially true and will result in the bacteria from your backwash contaminating the bottle resulting in the growth of things like mold. It has happened to me before and I was absolutely mortified. Another reason I prefer chug lids as opposed to straws...the things are a hell of a lot easier to clean. No hidden crevices harboring disgusting human bacteria...lol. I definitely recommend this water bottle for those of you looking to increase your intake. Very pretty, convenient, and simple to clean with the chug lid.

reviews.title: Ottima
reviews.body: Ho acquistato questa borraccia sportiva QLUR da 1 litro per usarla durante allenamenti e uscite all’aperto, e devo dire che mi ha davvero convinto. La capacità da 1 litro è perfetta perché permette di bere abbastanza durante la giornata senza doverla riempire continuamente. È comoda sia per palestra, escursioni o semplicemente per tenerla sulla scrivania mentre si lavora o si studia. La cannuccia integrata è molto pratica: basta aprire il tappo e si può bere facilmente anche mentre si cammina o si fa attività. Inoltre il sistema di chiusura sembra abbastanza sicuro e finora non ho avuto problemi di perdite nello zaino. Il materiale è leggero ma resistente e la borraccia è facile da impugnare, anche grazie alla forma ergonomica. Mi è piaciuto anche il fatto che sia semplice da pulire. Nel complesso è una borraccia molto pratica, capiente e ben fatta, perfetta per chi vuole bere di più durante la giornata o per attività sportive. Per me merita tranquillamente 5 stelle.
reviews.body_en: I purchased this 1 liter QLUR sports bottle to use during training and outdoor outings, and I must say that it really convinced me. The 1 liter capacity is perfect because it allows you to drink enough throughout the day without having to continually refill it. It is convenient whether for the gym, hiking or simply keeping it on your desk while working or studying. The integrated straw is very practical: just open the cap and you can drink easily even while walking or doing activities. Furthermore, the closure system seems quite secure and so far I have not had any problems with leaks in the backpack. The material is light but resistant and the bottle is easy to hold, also thanks to the ergonomic shape. I also liked the fact that it is easy to clean. Overall it is a very practical, spacious and well-made bottle, perfect for those who want to drink more during the day or for sporting activities. For me it easily deserves 5 stars.

reviews.title: Love love my Yeti!
reviews.body: My old water bottle has been a source of annoyance to my husband pretty much since it arrived. He hated washing it. It was one of those with a very narrow neck which required a special brush. I liked it fine, but after I replaced my coffee mug he suggested (with not much subtlety) that I should grab one of these without delay. Iced coffee won. I tried my best to object. It was a good show. Really. But I couldn’t get that in my old bottle and I certainly could in this. I wish I’d have gotten it in black, or even navy or dark green and I got the alternate lid right away. The local Ace hardware said they can’t keep that item in stock it’s so popular. Properly outfitted, except for the colour, I’m one happy camper. My husband is even happier. He’s our resident dishwasher. He says that this is as easy to clean as anyone could wish for. Even the fancy new lid breaks all the way down and goes back together without any instructions needed. Neither nooks nor crannies where stuff hides from washing. So far, it is every bit as durable as I’d hoped but it’s way too early to say much. It’s easily handled everything I’ve thrown at it, which nothing else has. Not so much as a ding. I don’t mean to sound like I treat stuff badly. I don’t. But when you spend time in a wheelchair things will occasionally roll off, get too close to the wheels or whatever. The truth is this is the first one to still look anywhere near new after this much time, little as it’s been. It may not sound impressive, but it is. Stuff that stripped my old bottle(s) down to stainless just make a little mark on this. Wipe it down with a microfibre towel and it’s gone. I’m adjusting to the new way as best I can. This is my new jugs’ personality. Tidy, just like me. I like it better than what’s passed for personality in the past. From a practical standpoint it does everything just as it should. It holds temperature incredibly well. Yesterdays ice is still there in morning and I tend to imagine it would do just as well with hot drinks. Not that I’m likely to test that out in a cup this size. But my husband may try this bottle with the alternate cap for his coffee in an 18oz. Someday. When his Zojirushi is ready for replacement. Which brings us to: Gifting: to me this seems like it would make a nice gift. Unless the person is one of those that doesn’t like practical gifts in which case my heart goes out to you. I’ll find out when it’s time. Little caveat. It didn’t arrive in the whole Yeti package. It came in bubble wrap and would need dressing up. I fully expect I’ll be back to upgrade this to 5 stars in a few months. I don’t like to do that until at least a year. Durability is hard to address sooner than that. It’s too soon, really, but this is the Internet. I hope this is helpful to someone. Thank you.

reviews.title: It's perfect for what it does! But...
reviews.body: For the price, I'd say go for it if you need a bottle that simply excels... at being a bottle. If you want something more consistent, I'd suggest looking for something different. However, this bottle works perfectly for me. Pros: For starters, it holds 1 liter, which is exactly what I need. Second, you can squeeze it for pressure, I personally like drinking water as fast as possible and the squeezing helps a lot! Finally, it's not over-complicated, it's easy to refill and carry with you anywhere you go. Cons: Don't expect the graphic to last, it's going to scrape off eventually, regardless of wether you are somewhat 'aggressive' with your bottle or not, but I'd say that makes sense especially given the price. Second, the lid can unscrew easily and it can be somewhat tedious to screw it back on, you won't believe how often I've had cases where the lid was screwed improperly, you can't screw it if you are on a rush. I've also had instances where I screwed on the lid properly and then the bottle unscrewed itself from the motion of my bag, that was really annoying, but it only happened once, so it might possible that I didn't screw tight enough. Finally, the bottle doesn't have a conventional 'lid', it's just somewhat of an open 'nozzle' that opens whenever you squeeze the bottle. You don't have anything to close the nozzle with, so I wouldn't recommend this bottle if you plan on placing it somewhere tight where it might be squeezed and spill all over the place.

reviews.title: Fantastic T-shirts for men
reviews.body: These T-shirts are some of the best that I have found. The fit is great I ordered a regular size Medium. They have a great selection of colors to choose from, so it fits well with most styles out there. The fabric is soft; the stitching has held up very well to washing and drying so far. As the shirts start to get older with repeated wear over a year or so of use, I have noticed a bit of crinkling in the collar and some pilling across the body but not too much. The colors do not fade very quickly however I have experienced some discoloring around the collar if you have to use any sort of face washes for acne like I do. The weight of the material is nice not to heavy but thick enough to wear even during colder months of the year and still light enough to wear in the summer. The fit is great through the shoulders, and torso not tight but definitely not baggy, the arms of the shirt are at a perfect length about 2.5 inches above the elbow. They are decently priced when compared to similar brands out there. I would for sure recommend buying just one or two at a time before buying the multi packs as those a bit pricy. The pictures on Amazon for the T-shirts do truly match what the T-shirts look like in real life.

Material & Build Quality The cotton fabric feels soft and comfortable against the skin, and the long sleeves provide a little extra warmth for cooler weather. The construction is simple and practical for regular wear. All in All This is a good basic long-sleeve tee to have in the wardrobe. It's comfortable, versatile, and easy to dress up or down, making it useful for everything from relaxing at home to casual everyday wear.

reviews.title: Comfortable casual shirt, decent build
reviews.body: A long sleeve t-shirt from COOFANDY in a cotton blend with a crew neck. The label says preshrunk and from what I can tell it holds its size after washing without noticeable shrinkage. The fabric is lighter than a typical thermal but heavier than a summer tee, which makes it work well as a layering piece in spring and fall or as a standalone shirt on mild days. The weave is tight enough that it does not pill after a few washes like some blended fabrics do. The fit is on the relaxed side, which I prefer for a shirt I wear casually rather than anything fitted. The sleeves are long enough to cover my wrists without being excessive. The crew neck sits flat and does not curl up after washing. The stitching looks solid at the seams and the collar has held its shape through multiple laundry cycles. The fabric softens up a bit after the first few washes without getting that worn-out look. For the price, this is a comfortable everyday shirt that works as part of a casual rotation. Nothing special about it but it looks presentable and holds up like it should.

reviews.title: Great value and quality
reviews.body: I'll start out by saying I rarely give five stars, t-shirts that fit well are difficult for me to find. I usually go through several Brands before I find one I like and then I have to try several sizes to settle on one. With all of that being said, the shirts are a great quality for the price especially, and they are true to size. The fabric, stitching, and packaging are great for the price you're paying. I would consider these right in between a muscle fit and a slim fit, flattering in the arms and chest but not too tight in the waist, and the length seems to be just right. reviews.title: Excellent shirts if this is what you're looking for
reviews.body: During COVID I ordered some Hanes shirts that were the exact style that I already had and when they arrived they were extremely short and poorly sewn. This almost made me stop wearing Hanes completely but after wearing them for 20+ years it's hard to change, so I gave them another try recently. Seems to me that Hanes is back! These shirts are excellent. They fit perfectly and they look and feel l great. However, here are a few things people should know. 1) They may actually be thinner than in previous years. For me, that is a good thing. I'm not wearing a t-shirt because I need extra warmth but because I want cotton between my skin and the outter. It's softer, cooler, and catches my sweat. Thick undershirts make no sense IMO, but not feels that way (as you can see in the other reviews). 2) Out of the package, they feel kind of crusty. This made me worried at first, but I Googled it and learned that they should soften up after a few washes. Today they are on wash number three and they feel like a normal soft t-shirt (which is why I'm leaving this review now). So it may take a couple of washes for them to feel the way you want.

title: Gildan Men's Crew T-Shirts, Multipack, Style G1100

reviews.title: Excellent value
reviews.body: For years I’ve purchased t’s based on price and there always seemed to be a combo deal that was cheaper than this company’s multipack. Problem is those shirts would be stretched out at the neck and generally look and feel awful after a few weeks. Clearly, these shirts are more than worth the few extra dollars because they look incredible and I’ve never had a better fitting shirt. I often wear these under dress shirts so the neck shows and it’s snug and looks perfect - professional. And, there are long options so they don’t ride up and show the torso. I could easily tuck them into my pants if I wanted to. Great color assortment, soft, fit perfectly. Wish I’d found these sooner, highly recommend .

reviews.title: Great value and quality
reviews.body: I'll start out by saying I rarely give five stars, t-shirts that fit well are difficult for me to find. I usually go through several Brands before I find one I like and then I have to try several sizes to settle on one. With all of that being said, the shirts are a great quality for the price especially, and they are true to size. The fabric, stitching, and packaging are great for the price you're paying. I would consider these right in between a muscle fit and a slim fit, flattering in the arms and chest but not too tight in the waist, and the length seems to be just right. I wasn't really sold by the pictures of people trying them on but when I got the shirts in hand they seem to fit way better and look much nicer. If I have one thing that I could point out that isn't a complete positive it would be that the neck could be just slightly tighter and a bit more sturdy but that's really nitpicking because the neck does not sag at all, after a wash this might tighten up slightly and all the shirts seem to be identical and well made whereas usually when I order there might be one or two shirts that just aren't up to par. I got a 12 pack of the black and I will be ordering more for my day-to-day t-shirts, including a 12 pack of the whites. For a little perspective in rating these shirts, I used to buy the Haynes that were on Amazon and (I've noticed that the quality had gone down a bit) but those shirts usually run anywhere from 8 to $12 a piece and these are right up there with them if not better. Uptdate- i would settle at 4 stars, after a wash on cold and a no heat air dryin the dryer, the neck did firm up. The shirts definitely retain a thinner cotton feel and appearance. Great for every day or gym but youll want a nicer T for other occasions. Still great value but i would definitely see a xxl shrinking to a xl on heat in the dryer. Fantastic right out of the package, good after a wash.

reviews.title: Good quality and value for my son!
reviews.body: I bought the Gildan Men’s Crew T-Shirts multipack on Amazon for my 12-year-old son, who is on the heavier side and thus sometimes difficult to shop for. Pre-teen kids grow fast and go through clothes quickly, so I didn’t want to spend a lot of money on basics he’ll probably outgrow in a year. These shirts are really affordable, especially for a multipack, and the quality is surprisingly good for the price. The fabric is soft and comfortable, and my son says they feel good to wear all day at school. They’re lightweight and did not shrink after washing. I also like that the shirts don’t get stretched out like some cheaper T-shirts do. The fit works well for him too. They’re simple, classic crew neck tees that can be worn on their own or layered under hoodies and jackets. We’ve used them for school and just everyday wear. Another thing I appreciate is that they’re easy to care for. I just toss them in the wash and dryer and they come out looking fine every time. Overall, these are a great value. If you need affordable, comfortable basic T-shirts for a growing kid (or an adult!), this pack is definitely worth buying.

title: Hanes Men's Undershirt Packs, Stay-Tucked Soft Cotton Undershirts, Best Undershirts for Men, White/Black/Asstd Multipacks

reviews.title: Excellent shirts if this is what you're looking for
reviews.body: During COVID I ordered some Hanes shirts that were the exact style that I already had and when they arrived they were extremely short and poorly sewn. This almost made me stop wearing Hanes completely but after wearing them for 20+ years it's hard to change, so I gave them another try recently. Seems to me that Hanes is back! These shirts are excellent. They fit perfectly and they look and feel l great. However, here are a few things people should know. 1) They may actually be thinner than in previous years. For me, that is a good thing. I'm not wearing a t-shirt because I need extra warmth but because I want cotton between my skin and the outter. It's softer, cooler, and catches my sweat. Thick undershirts make no sense IMO, but not feels that way (as you can see in the other reviews). 2) Out of the package, they feel kind of crusty. This made me worried at first, but I Googled it and learned that they should soften up after a few washes. Today they are on wash number three and they feel like a normal soft t-shirt (which is why I'm leaving this review now). So it may take a couple of washes for them to feel the way you want.

reviews.title: Great value and quality
reviews.body: I'll start out by saying I rarely give five stars, t-shirts that fit well are difficult for me to find. I usually go through several Brands before I find one I like and then I have to try several sizes to settle on one. With all of that being said, the shirts are a great quality for the price especially, and they are true to size. The fabric, stitching, and packaging are great for the price you're paying. I would consider these right in between a muscle fit and a slim fit, flattering in the arms and chest but not too tight in the waist, and the length seems to be just right. I wasn't really sold by the pictures of people trying them on but when I got the shirts in hand they seem to fit way better and look much nicer. If I have one thing that I could point out that isn't a complete positive it would be that the neck could be just slightly tighter and a bit more sturdy but that's really nitpicking because the neck does not sag at all, after a wash this might tighten up slightly and all the shirts seem to be identical and well made whereas usually when I order there might be one or two shirts that just aren't up to par. I got a 12 pack of the black and I will be ordering more for my day-to-day t-shirts, including a 12 pack of the whites. For a little perspective in rating these shirts, I used to buy the Haynes that were on Amazon and (I've noticed that the quality had gone down a bit) but those shirts usually run anywhere from 8 to $12 a piece and these are right up there with them if not better. Uptdate- i would settle at 4 stars, after a wash on cold and a no heat air dryin the dryer, the neck did firm up. The shirts definitely retain a thinner cotton feel and appearance. Great for every day or gym but youll want a nicer T for other occasions. Still great value but i would definitely see a xxl shrinking to a xl on heat in the dryer. Fantastic right out of the package, good after a wash.

reviews.title: Good quality and value for my son!
reviews.body: I bought the Gildan Men’s Crew T-Shirts multipack on Amazon for my 12-year-old son, who is on the heavier side and thus sometimes difficult to shop for. These shirts are really affordable, especially for a multipack, and the quality is surprisingly good for the price. The fabric is soft and comfortable, and my son says they feel good to wear all day at school. They’re lightweight and did not shrink after washing. I also like that the shirts don’t get stretched out like some cheaper T-shirts do. The fit works well for him too. They’re simple, classic crew neck tees that can be worn on their own or layered under hoodies and jackets. We’ve used them for school and just everyday wear. Another thing I appreciate is that they’re easy to care for. I just toss them in the wash and dryer and they come out looking fine every time. Overall, these are a great value. If you need affordable, comfortable basic T-shirts for a growing kid (or an adult!), this pack is definitely worth buying.

reviews.title: Good shirt.
reviews.body: I'm between M and L sizing. The M is too tight to wear on its own but is excellent as an undershirt. The L is still very fitted, but good on its own. Keep that in mind when ordering. Once you find the size/fit you like, can't really beat the shirt. To clarify, the Navy version sold here does indeed have the Drifire logo printed on both the front outside AND inside back of the shirt. So in contrast to the answer listed above, there is a Drifire Logo with CAT 1 printed on the front of the shirt, dead center, under the collar on the Navy version. As for this particular seller, at the time of this review, I am unsure on whether the desert sand variant sold here has a logo printed on the front. My guess would be that yes, it does, per the photo on the product info page. Sterile versions of desert sand and coyote colored Drifire shirts can be bought elsewhere, most likely from retailers catering towards military consumption. As for quality, it's average. It's not the greatest shirt I've ever owned, nor do I find it the most durable. But it works for its intended purpose. You MUST wash this shirt according to label instructions printed inside the shirt and wash with like fabrics. To be safe only was these with other Drifire shirts. Two of mine were totally pilled and destroyed after washing with other items that have proven to be safe with other shirts. The Drifire's couldn't handle them. I haven't experienced the pilling problem with the military issue Drifire t-shirts though. ***If you wash these alone, in warm, and dry on low the shirts will last 100%.*** Also, be advised: if you are used to military unit issue variants which lack seams on the right and left sides of the shirt body (tube construction), this HAS seams there. In my opinion, this makes no difference, and may indeed have a more balanced fit.
