reviews.title: A Stunning, High-Tech Twist on a Classic Scented Candle
reviews.body: This is an exceptionally unique and high-quality scented candle that delivers a true "wow" factor the moment it is lit. It comes securely presented in branded, factory-sealed manufacturer packaging with molded foam insert protection, making it an ideal option for easy gift wrapping. Design & Build Quality Jar & Aesthetics: The heavy glass vessel features a vibrant, glossy finish reminiscent of a shiny candy apple red—making it an absolute showstopper for holiday decor or ambient home accents. Dimensions: It stands roughly 3.85 inches tall with a 3.25-inch diameter. Wax & Fragrance: Made with a smooth, creamy soy wax blend and a central cotton wick that provides a steady, clean burn. Upon removing the top protective label, it emits a soothing, well-balanced aroma of soft lavender blended with fresh eucalyptus that subtly fills the room. Functionality & Heat-Activated LED Display What sets this candle apart is its clever heat-activated lighting mechanism: How It Works: A subtle metal sensor prong sits near the wick, connected to a battery-powered circuit in the base. Once the wick is lit, heat travels down the sensor and immediately triggers micro-LED lights embedded within a liquid-gel ring inside the double-walled glass. The Effect: The entire red jar glows with a gorgeous, warm ambient light while burning and turns off automatically when extinguished. Longevity: The internal power source is permanently sealed in the base for safety. While non-replaceable, it is designed to last through the full burn life of the 12oz soy wax. (Note: If you decide to clean out the jar to repurpose or refill it later, just take care around the sensor prong so a new wick can sit adjacent to it!) Durability & Value From the solid weight of the glass to the flawless execution of the LED sensor, this candle offers fantastic build quality, functionality, and charm. It elevates a standard scented candle into a captivating centerpiece. It makes a marvelous, memorable gift or personal indulgence, and offers incredible value for such a creative concept.

reviews.title: Nice, Cute Candle but Scent Doesn’t Match Description
reviews.body: The Viyffo 18 oz anniversary candle arrived nicely packaged in a cute box with a small red ribbon on top, which made it feel gift-ready. Inside, the candle was well-protected in thick foam, so there were no issues with damage during shipping—definitely a plus. The candle itself comes in a sturdy glass jar and is visually appealing, with white soy wax decorated with colorful candy sprinkles around the outside. The gold screw-on lid adds a nice touch, and overall it has a fun, festive look. However, there were a couple of downsides. The label had some noticeable glue or grease marks, which took away from the otherwise polished look. Also, while the scent is advertised as vanilla and candy, it came across more citrusy to me. It’s not an unpleasant smell, just not what I expected. The scent is fairly light, so it works best in smaller spaces if you want to actually notice the fragrance. On the bright side, the candle burns slowly, which helps it last longer. For $9, it’s a decent-sized candle and a good value, but the mismatch in scent is a bit off-putting.

Is the light activated by the flame somehow? It must be, but I still don’t understand how it works—I truly wish it gave you more detail.

reviews.title: Be aware of wick length before burning…
reviews.body: I’ve been ordering and using these tealights for years because they live up to their description: long burn life, clean burning. However, with the recent order (12/2025) I noticed that the wicks are mushrooming, which has never happened before. Mushrooming create more carbon in the air which builds up on paint, walls, and in air filters. I know this because I burn a LOT of candles and try to keep carbon to a minimum. In this recent batch, the wicks are too long for size of the candle which can lead to mushrooming. I’ve started to trim the wick before burning, hoping this well help. Still a great product, but this is definitely a change from previous orders. Fyi only.

reviews.title: Perfect quality non-drip candles for the value
reviews.body: I have lit these candles at dinner on multiple occasions and every morning when I enjoy my espresso ritual 🥰 The result has been consistently as I expect. The color of the candles are spot on as described. They fit perfectly with the standard holders. There has been no dripping wax through out the whole burning time until I blew them all out. As you can see in the attached pictures, I set these candles super straight on the holders. We talked, laughed when dining at the table and also moved around in the kitchen. The burning wicks were not completely straight up, and yet, didn’t make the hot wax streak down at all. In fact there was very minimum hot wax where the flame was. There was no direct breeze in the kitchen area. There was no opened windows either. The furnace was also not on and I do not use space heater or AC, or electric fan. About the promised burning time, please understand that the “up-to-8-hour” suggestion is just an “estimate” of the maximum burning time. That time varies depending on certain conditions such as how high the flame is, how long the burning wick is…If I constantly trim the wick down to minimum and keep the flame very short, the candles can burn up to that promised hours for sure. This is a legal and lawful way that all vendors use to market their product’s details and descriptions. It has been applied to so many different products out there in the market (not just these items) such as meds/drugs (they all mention that results may vary), or gasoline usage per mile can also vary,…I am just a regular consumer/shopper. I do not write reviews in exchange for free products or incentive from vendors/sellers. I am very pleased with the performance of these candles. I do not mind if they do not burn the full 8 hours. Like I said, that detail is not important to me. The burning time can fluctuate and does not affect the quality of these candles which is the non-dripping part that is far more important to me. I do not want to keep removing layers of wax from the holders after burning candles, or having hot wax on my table or furniture, or ruining my table cloths.

reviews.title: Great candles, all arrived whole during transport
reviews.body: Pleasant smell. Lasts a long time, due to size and to slow burn rate. They burn well, and the fire doesn't go out by itself, or get too strong or weak. Not too much smoke. Eventually, as the candle burns down, the top of the glass container gets covered in black soot, affecting esthetics for some. Still, there's no risk of wax dripping, so they're clean. No tunneling, but you do have to let it burn until all the wax is melted (no hard walls on the sides). The glass feels strong and substantial. I haven't had issues with glass breaking during use or during transport. They're shipped to you in sturdy, thick, well-insulated packaging. Since my area is prone to blackouts, I keep a lot of candles at hand. I also like them for smell and ambiance. I bought about 10 of these when they were on sale, and none arrived broken! If you lay one on its side in warm weather (which happened to one of mine during transport), then the wax softens and pools sideways, and can make the wick inaccessible. What I did was set the candle upright in a pot of hot water (in such a way that the hot water touched the walls of the jar and would soften the wax, but without there being so much water that it poured inside the jar). That reset the wax and revealed the wick. Problem solved. Amusingly enough, Amazon wants me to review this candle's "taste"! I can't speak to that!

reviews.title: Warm, Cozy, and Perfect for Fall!
reviews.body: I bought this spiced pumpkin candle to get into the fall mood, and it has quickly become my favorite seasonal scent. The fragrance is strong enough to fill the room within minutes but not overpowering—it’s the perfect balance of pumpkin, cinnamon, and a hint of vanilla. It makes the whole house feel warm and cozy, almost like fresh pumpkin bread just came out of the oven. The burn time has been impressive. I’ve been lighting it in the evenings for about two weeks now, and it’s still going strong with an even melt (no tunneling, which is a big plus). The wax burns cleanly, and the wick is easy to trim, so maintenance is minimal. I also appreciate the design of the jar—it’s simple and seasonal without being overly flashy, so it looks nice on my coffee table and blends well with my other fall décor. If I had to mention one small drawback, it’s that the scent is so good that I find myself burning it every day—I may run out sooner than planned! My tip: grab two if you want it to last the whole season. Overall, this candle is a must-have for anyone who loves fall scents. It’s cozy, long-lasting, and makes your home instantly feel festive.

reviews.title: Hands down the best
reviews.body: This is by far and away my favorite candle. The smell is both comforting and arousing. When you open the candle for the first time the aroma alone, without burning the candle is enough to fill a room. Commonly that is what I will do. Just open the candle, not light it, and let the fragrance fill the room for a few hours. Eventually it is time to light it. Both wicks need to be burning for it to evenly burn down. I hate candles that leave wax in the jar as they burn. This one does not do that. All of the wax burns off as it is used up. At the bitter end all that is left is a jar with two burnt up wicks and a very small amount of the wax residue. This also burns for a very long time. I’d say, end to end, if you light it and just let it burn it would keep burning for about a week total. Maybe 10 days. I have bought many of these and burning it about an hour or two per night I’d say I get roughly 4 to 5 weeks of use out of it. Maybe a little less than that with weekend burning a bit longer sometimes. It normally comes in a very sturdy package. I like to order it with other goods so as to give it extra protection in shipping. But I have had them deliver it in the original shipping container no problem. That being said I have also gotten one broken like some other reviewers mentioned. What I did was take a small ball peen hammer and carefully broke away the glass outside. Piece by piece. Cut myself doing this but not bad, so follow these instructions with caution. Nevertheless, once I got all of the glass away and carefully removed the bottom glass (which is glued to the candle wicks so use a knife [again carefully] to separate the wick bottoms from the glass) so I could put the candle into a container and light it. It worked. But again that happened once and I have bought MANY of these over the years with no issues. Let me also say that pumpkin spice is my favorite. And the ladies like it too. Good for getting in the mood if you know what I mean. But I have burned other flavors and they all seem to be top quality. Very fragrant and delicious smelling. Everybody loves the smell of my house when I burn these. I don’t write reviews unless I truly hate or believe in a product. So just know that I think this product is worth the cost, definitely. Hope you enjoy one as much as I do.

reviews.title: One of the most satisfying and best scented candles out there!
reviews.body: Hello everyone, my name is John and this is my honest opinion on this product. You can buy candles almost anywhere. With so many retailers and brands, it is hard to choose which ones to buy. Maybe you like how one smells but it is too small. Maybe you like how one smells but it is too expensive. Well my fellow candle buyers, look no further than the Vanilla Bean Woodwick Jar Candle by Virginia Candle Company. Now I have to say this was a gift for a friend but I have owned many different Virginia Candle Company Candles in the past and I have loved them all. They are a conversation piece around the holidays and whenever family is over I always hear, "What is that smell? It smells great!" or "What is that crackling sound, is that the candle?" Now, for someone who has never bought one of these candles before, you may not know that these candles actually do make a nice crackling noise as they burn. Nothing dramatic enough to make the in-laws think there is a raging, crackling fire in the other room at thanksgiving, but not quiet enough that you have to tell everyone to quite down so you can admire that satisfying crackling and popping coming from the candle. It is honestly probably my favorite attribute to these candles. I just love that little crackle so much because of how satisfying it is .Anyway, you are probably tired of reading me talking about my obsession of crackling candles so here is what I can tell you about the smell. They have many great scents that are a pure delight to your nostrils. These candles give off a scent that is noticeable, but not too faint. The scent is strong, but not overpowering. Each of these candles smell just perfect. Now the reason I choose to review this specific scent of candle is because it is my favorite. It truly smells like vanilla bean, one of my favorite smells. Another notable attribute to these candles is the duration of burn time you have. Unlike your traditional wick, these candles burn longer and better. Plus they give a pretty little flame which looks a bit different from your generic candle. Anyway, thats all I really have to say. In conclusion, I would highly recommend this candle or any other candle by Virginia Candle Company. If you ask me how high these candles raise the bar, I would tell you that they are the bar. Nothing can beat them. But in all seriousness, I really do enjoy these candles and have given quite a few of them to my friends and family as gifts after they had asked me about them. These candles really are unique from any other because of the wick they use. If you are considering these candles, I really would encourage you to purchase one because you will not be disappointed with it. I will admit they are a bit pricey compared to your generic candle, (I mean seriously, 18 dollars for a candle) but these truly are a higher quality of candle compared to other brands. Anyway I hope this review was helpful, thanks for reading! ;) (Disclamer: I was not payed or sponsored in anyway to review this product. This is my honest and unbiased opinion on this product. Once again, I hope this review was helpful.)

Nothing dramatic enough to make the in-laws think there is a raging, crackling fire in the other room at thanksgiving, but not quiet enough that you have to tell everyone to quite down so you can admire that satisfying crackling and popping coming from the candle. It is honestly probably my favorite attribute to these candles. I just love that little crackle so much because of how satisfying it is .Anyway, you are probably tired of reading me talking about my obsession of crackling candles so here is what I can tell you about the smell. They have many great scents that are a pure delight to your nostrils. These candles give off a scent that is noticeable, but not too faint. The scent is strong, but not overpowering. Each of these candles smell just perfect. Now the reason I choose to review this specific scent of candle is because it is my favorite. It truly smells like vanilla bean, one of my favorite smells. Another notable attribute to these candles is the duration of burn time you have. Unlike your traditional wick, these candles burn longer and better. Plus they give a pretty little flame which looks a bit different from your generic candle. Anyway, thats all I really have to say. In conclusion, I would highly recommend this candle or any other candle by Virginia Candle Company. If you ask me how high these candles raise the bar, I would tell you that they are the bar. Nothing can beat them. But in all seriousness, I really do enjoy these candles and have given quite a few of them to my friends and family as gifts after they had asked me about them. These candles really are unique from any other because of the wick they use. If you are considering these candles, I really would encourage you to purchase one because you will not be disappointed with it. I will admit they are a bit pricey compared to your generic candle, (I mean seriously, 18 dollars for a candle) but these truly are a higher quality of candle compared to other brands. Anyway I hope this review was helpful, thanks for reading! ;) (Disclamer: I was not payed or sponsored in anyway to review this product. This is my honest and unbiased opinion on this product. Once again, I hope this review was helpful.)

reviews.title: The Candle That Took Me Camping Without Leaving My Couch
reviews.body: Okay, listen. This isn’t just a candle—it’s basically a personality. It’s huge enough to make me feel like I got my money’s worth, and when I lit it, the wick started crackling like I’d just built a five-star campfire in my living room (minus the mosquitoes and questionable s’mores hygiene). The scent situation? Wild. This candle has three layers, three different colors, and three totally different vibes. It’s like aromatherapy speed-dating: one minute I’m sniffing warm vanilla woods, then boom—suddenly I’m transported to a citrus grove, and before I can process that, I’m chilling in a pine forest wondering if I should be chopping firewood. My nose has never been so entertained. The wide wick is basically the MVP—no tunneling, no sad little wax puddles. Just big, bold, “I’m a candle and I know it” energy. Honestly, if this candle had legs, it would probably roast marshmallows for me. 10/10 would buy again. In fact, I’m low-key worried this thing is going to give me main-character energy every time I light it.

The jasmine adds a soft floral touch, while the oud and sandalwood give it that deeper, clean, slightly earthy scent. It makes my room smell calm and relaxing, especially in the evenings. The throw is pretty good for a 9 oz candle, and I could still smell it even after blowing it out, which I loved. It also burned evenly for me and seems like it’s going to last a while. The jar itself is simple but cute and looks nice sitting on a nightstand or coffee table. My only small complaint is that I wish the scent was just a little stronger when first lit, because it took a bit for it to really fill the room. Once it got going though, it smelled amazing. Overall, I’d still definitely buy it again and would recommend it if you like warm, elegant scents that aren’t overly sweet.

Whether you’re unwinding after a long day, reading a book, or simply creating a relaxing atmosphere, this candle instantly elevates the space. It also burns evenly and lasts much longer than many candles I’ve tried, making it well worth it. If you enjoy luxurious, warm fragrances with a touch of floral elegance, I highly recommend giving this one a try—it feels like bringing a high-end boutique hotel right into your home. ✨

The bamboo scent is kind of perfect for anyone, especially couples. Not flowery, powdery, or musky, the Bamboo scent is fresh and lush without being heavy. After years with my three wicks, I bought the NEST lid—cool and silvery—to keep it free from dust. I also tried NEST candles in different sizes for different places, and I’ve come to appreciate every NEST chic etched glass surround. Long after the candle is gone, the empty three-wick becomes a vase for spring flowers, shiny Christmas ornaments, or berries at brunch. Smaller candle jars hold candies, stamps, Q-Tips, and lip glosses. Brace yourself—you’ll be hooked!

reviews.title: Un set aromático, decorativo y muy agradable para regalar 🕯️🍂
reviews.body: Este set de 6 velas perfumadas otoñales AOOVOO está pensado para quienes disfrutan creando ambientes cálidos y acogedores en casa. La selección de aromas gira en torno a fragancias típicas del otoño, como tarta de manzana, canela, manzana especiada, pastel de calabaza y nueces, especias de calabaza y especias de repostería. Es una propuesta muy orientada a quienes buscan una sensación hogareña, dulce y confortable. 🍎🎃 Cada vela viene presentada en un frasco de vidrio con diseño cuidado, por lo que no solo funciona como vela aromática, sino también como pequeño elemento decorativo. Además, el conjunto llega en una caja de regalo, algo práctico si se compra para cumpleaños, detalles de temporada, Navidad o simplemente para sorprender a alguien sin tener que añadir demasiado envoltorio. 🎁 Aspectos a destacar ⭐ 🍂 Variedad de aromas muy otoñales. El set incluye seis fragancias diferentes, todas con una línea aromática cálida y dulce. Es una buena opción para quienes disfrutan de olores tipo repostería, canela, manzana o calabaza, especialmente en salones, dormitorios o rincones de lectura. 🕯️ Cera de soja. Las velas están elaboradas con cera de soja, una alternativa bastante habitual en velas de mejor calidad. Suele ofrecer una combustión más limpia y uniforme que otras ceras convencionales, siempre que se usen correctamente. ⏳ Buena duración total. El conjunto suma 1197 g de cera, con una duración anunciada de hasta 300 horas en total. Esto permite utilizarlas durante bastante tiempo si se alternan las fragancias o se encienden en sesiones moderadas. 🎁 Presentación cuidada para regalo. La caja y los tarros de vidrio con etiquetas doradas hacen que el set tenga una apariencia agradable sin necesidad de preparar un embalaje adicional. Es un detalle sencillo, pero suma bastante si se compra como regalo. 🏡 Aportan ambiente sin complicaciones. Son velas pensadas para crear una sensación acogedora en casa: una cena tranquila, una tarde de lectura, una reunión familiar o una noche de otoño. No requieren instalación ni accesorios especiales, más allá de las precauciones habituales al usar velas. Aspectos que se pueden mejorar ⚠️ 🍰 Aromas dulces que no serán para todo el mundo. La selección está muy centrada en fragancias cálidas, especiadas y de repostería. A quienes prefieran aromas frescos, florales o más neutros quizá les resulten algo intensas o dulces. 🏠 Mejor para estancias medianas o pequeñas. Aunque el set es completo, la intensidad real del aroma puede variar según el tamaño de la habitación. En espacios muy amplios puede notarse menos, especialmente si hay ventilación. 🔥 Requieren las precauciones habituales. Como cualquier vela, deben utilizarse con vigilancia, lejos de telas, corrientes de aire, niños o mascotas. Es algo evidente, pero importante en un producto de este tipo. Valoración final: ⭐⭐⭐⭐☆ (4,5 sobre 5) 🕯️🍂 Este set de velas AOOVOO ofrece una combinación muy agradable de aromas otoñales, buena presentación y duración generosa. Destaca especialmente como regalo o como complemento decorativo para quienes disfrutan de ambientes cálidos y aromas dulces. No le doy las cinco estrellas porque la selección aromática es bastante específica y puede resultar demasiado dulce para algunos gustos. Aun así, es un set muy recomendable para quienes buscan velas acogedoras, bonitas y fáciles de regalar.

They do not require installation or special accessories, beyond the usual precautions when using candles. Aspects that can be improved ⚠️ 🍰 Sweet aromas that won't be for everyone. reviews.title: Idée cadeau pour l'automne.
reviews.body: J’ai acheté ce coffret principalement pour parfumer la maison pendant l’automne et l’hiver, et je le trouve très réussi. Dans le sens où la signature olfactive donne vraiment une ambiance chaleureuse dans la maison. Idéal en automne quand il pleut. On va avoir plaisir à rentrer à la maison et sentir ces parfums rassurants. Le premier point fort est la variété des parfums. Les différentes senteurs gourmandes, comme le gâteau aux pommes ou la cannelle, créent une ambiance chaleureuse et réconfortante sans être trop écœurantes. Cela permet de changer de parfum selon l'envie ou la pièce dans laquelle on les utilise. Malgré tout on reste sur les même famille de senteur, avec quasiment la présence de cannelle dans toutes. Les bougies sont bien présentées et les pots en verre offrent un rendu soigné. Elles peuvent facilement être laissées en décoration sur une étagère, une table basse ou un bureau. La combustion est régulière et la cire de soja fond de manière homogène lorsque l'on respecte les bonnes pratiques d'utilisation (laisser fondre toute la surface lors des premières utilisations). Les parfums se diffusent progressivement et créent une atmosphère agréable sans être trop envahissants. Évidemment je ne suis pas un fan de la cire de soja...on preferrerait une cire d'abeille pour des bougies qui durent plus longtemps. J'apprécie également le fait d'avoir six bougies différentes. C'est un coffret qui convient aussi bien pour soi que pour offrir, surtout à l'approche des fêtes. C'est une bonne idée cadeau qui peut plaire ! Comme pour la plupart des bougies parfumées, l'intensité varie selon la taille de la pièce. Dans un grand séjour, le parfum sera naturellement plus discret que dans une chambre ou un bureau. Malgré tout, attention ce sont des fragrance très présente ! Elles vont prendre le dessus sur tout autre odeur de la maison ! Il faut avoir envie que votre intérieur sente comme la bougie, et pas juste une bougie qui parfume discrètement. Au final, c'est un coffret agréable qui met parfaitement dans l'ambiance de l'automne. Les senteurs sont variées, la présentation est soignée et les bougies offrent un bon rapport qualité/prix pour ceux qui aiment créer une atmosphère chaleureuse à la maison.
reviews.body_en: I bought this set mainly to scent the house during the fall and winter, and I find it very successful. In the sense that the olfactory signature really gives a warm atmosphere in the house. Ideal in autumn when it rains. We will enjoy coming home and smelling these reassuring scents. The first strong point is the variety of flavors. The different gourmet scents, like apple cake or cinnamon, create a warm and comforting atmosphere without being too cloying. This allows you to change the perfume according to your desire or the room in which you use them. Despite everything, we remain on the same family of scents, with almost the presence of cinnamon in all of them. The candles are well presented and the glass jars look neat. They can easily be left as decoration on a shelf, coffee table or desk. The combustion is regular and the soy wax melts evenly when good usage practices are followed (let the entire surface melt during the first uses). The scents diffuse gradually and create a pleasant atmosphere without being too intrusive. Obviously I'm not a fan of soy wax...we would prefer beeswax for candles that last longer. I also like that I have six different candles. It is a box that is suitable both for yourself and as a gift, especially as the holidays approach. It's a good gift idea that people will like! As with most scented candles, the intensity varies depending on the size of the room. In a large living room, the scent will naturally be more discreet than in a bedroom or office. Despite everything, be careful, these are very present fragrances! They will take over any other smell in the house! You have to want your interior to smell like a candle, and not just a candle that smells discreetly. In the end, it's a pleasant box set that perfectly sets the mood for fall. The scents are varied, the presentation is neat and the candles offer good value for money for those who like to create a warm atmosphere at home.

Too bad, because every single other thing about this was fantastic

title: FEIDUSUN Sunglasses Men Polarized Sunglasses for Mens and Womens,Black Retro Sun Glasses Driving Fishing UV Protection

reviews.title: Great Polarized Sunglasses for the Price
reviews.body: I picked up a pair of the FEIDUSUN Polarized Sunglasses a few months back, and they've honestly become one of my go-to accessories whenever I head out. I was on the hunt for a good pair of polarized sunglasses that were both stylish and effective at protecting my eyes, and I think I've definitely found that with these. The black retro design is really classic and versatile. They go with pretty much any outfit I wear, whether I'm dressed casually or a bit more put-together. I like the clean and simple look of them, and more importantly, they feel really comfortable on my face. They're not too heavy, and they don't pinch my nose or the sides of my head, even after wearing them for several hours, which is a big plus for me. I've had sunglasses in the past that become uncomfortable after a while, but these have been great. But beyond the looks, what really stands out about these sunglasses is their performance. The polarized lenses make a significant difference in reducing glare. I notice it most when I'm driving on a sunny day or when I'm around water. The clarity of vision is so much better, and my eyes feel less strained. I've even worn them while fishing, and the difference in being able to see below the surface of the water was noticeable. It really cuts down on that harsh reflected light. UV protection is, of course, crucial, and I feel confident that my eyes are well-protected with these sunglasses. That gives me peace of mind, especially during those really bright sunny days we get here. Knowing that I'm shielding my eyes from harmful rays is a big factor in why I choose to wear them. After using them pretty regularly for the past few months, I can also say that they seem to be quite durable. They've been tossed into my bag countless times, and they still look and function perfectly. The hinges feel sturdy, and the lenses haven't scratched easily, which is always a concern with sunglasses. I'm not exactly the most careful person with my accessories, so the fact that these have held up well is a testament to their build quality. One thing I appreciate is that they don't feel flimsy or cheap. For the price point, I was pleasantly surprised by the overall quality. They feel like a more expensive pair of sunglasses than they actually are. Whether I'm driving, walking around town, or just relaxing outdoors, these FEIDUSUN sunglasses have become my constant companion. They provide the right amount of shade without making everything look too dark, and the polarization really enhances visual clarity. In short, the FEIDUSUN Polarized Sunglasses are an excellent buy for anyone looking for a stylish, comfortable, and effective pair of polarized sunglasses. They do a fantastic job of reducing glare and protecting against UV rays, and they seem to be built to last. I'm really happy with my purchase and would definitely recommend them to others.

reviews.title: Amazing price for good sunglasses (3 brown pairs)
reviews.body: These are very inexpensive, but excellent for the price. Vision through them is exceptionally clear with the brown polarized lenses. The degree of darkness is perfect, and the color is great. The frames are extremely light and comfortable and sturdy. The hinges are springy and firm, not floppy. They snap closed, and snap open. When they snap closed, the ends of the temple pieces cannot touch the lenses. So that potential source of scratching is avoided. Each pair comes in a cloth bag, AND has a little cloth to clean the lenses with. Nice extras. The only negative I can think of is the style. The lenses are a bit on the square side, covering more vertical area than I'd probably like. And the lenses don't wrap around my face as much as I'd like, failing to filter my peripheral vision at all. Still, the style isn't so bad that I'm embarrassed wearing them in public. Three pairs for $20 is a great price. I've stored two pairs for when the first pair breaks or wears out. I wonder how long that will take.

reviews.title: Not Dark Enough
reviews.body: I’m a nocturnal creature, always have been. Naturally I am up until dawn, and only rouse at dusk. Being that I do 12 hour night shifts, I really don’t have a need “flip” my schedule, and can exclusively live the vampire life. I don’t know if it is cause or effect, but I’ve always been photosensitive as well. As a child, I didn’t realize that it wasn’t normal to squint constantly on a sunny day. I ruin every photo from the flash. I even get light-triggered debilitating migraines. I NEED my sunglasses. So after losing my second pair of Ray-Bans, I couldn’t stomach the cost knowing that I have a tendency to set things down and walk away absent mindedly. Most likely I had dropped them in a parking lot from my purse or hoodie pocket, as I had done in numerous occasions, documented by the scrapes and scuffs on the lenses. It’s just not practical for me to splurge on the item I never prioritized when juggling keys, phone, and bag. My first lost ones were black and silver Clubmasters which I’ve had a hell of a time replacing in those classic colors, much less the polarized ones. I really missed how stylish they were. Then my classic Wayfarers disappeared. In scoping out to actually buy new Clubmasters, did I come across this package deal with both styles and super affordable. I wouldn’t feel shame about my treatment of sunglasses at this price point. When I received them I was super impressed. They were a little lighter weight, but overall seemingly sturdy and nice quality. Superb style, I wouldn’t be ashamed of not wearing designer. So I threw them in my bag to leave for work in the evening, to keep one in the car and save one for my purse. The next morning leaving work, it was nice and bright outside, and after a long shift, it is just the worst to be tired and blinded on a congested commute home. As soon as I hit the exit, I whip out my new glasses, and noticed I still had some eye strain, chalking it up to physical fatigue. Drive home, same thing. The next day I used the other glasses, and it again felt too bright. It only then occurred to me that these are not as dark as I was used to with my Ray Bans. I gave it a few more days, and realized these just don’t seem to make a difference for me. Feels like I’m wearing nothing at all. (Nothing at all, nothing at all…) Taking them on and off, I feel as if there is barely a difference, like they’re a placebo. I had focused so much on getting polarized, I forgot how the most crucial part of sunglasses is the darkening effect. They appear to be dark when you look at them, so it’s kind of an odd thing, and why it took me a day or so for it even to click with me with what was wrong. These are so weak, I feel like the polarized effect didn’t even do much for glare. I can even see clearly LCD displays that I couldn’t see previously even with other discount brands, so I’d say even this feature isn’t as good as it could be. Perhaps these may be useful in other sporting uses that people wear these glasses for, or could even be tinted enough for some, but absolutely not for me. If you’re truly dependent on eye protection and can’t leave the house without them like me, just keep looking.

reviews.title: Excellent all rounder sunglasses.
reviews.body: I have had cataract surgery on both my eyes 4 weeks ago, after wearing glasses for 55 years. I can now see mid to long distances perfectly (reading glasses only required now)... Because I no longer need my prescription glasses I needed to get some new sunglasses, and, as I do a lot of bike riding, I thought I might as well get some that are multi-purpose. What I like about these glasses is the wrap around feature which blocks out the glare and wind, coming in from the sides. I also like that there is no gap over my nose, meaning I have a wider field of view. Also, the nose bridge is adjustable, meaning I can set each side up exactly to fit my nose. ***** The frame is also quite flexible too, as well as being extremely light (total weight is approx 26 grams) which is way less than my old glasses. There are also many colours available... And finally, the lens is fully polarised (i.e. turn them sideways, and it totally blacks out a computer monitor, confirming that they definitely polarised). IMO best sunglasses I've bought, EVER ! So good, I have bought a 2nd pair (Black on Black) 2 months after this original review.

reviews.title: Finally, She Found Glasses That Do Both
reviews.body: My wife usually buys glasses based on how they look, not necessarily how they function. God forbid you get a pair of glasses that actually protect your eyes. No, they have to match the purse, sandals, dress, watch, and underwear all at the same time. I kind of like it that she matches the underwear, but the rest isn't that big of a deal to me. So imagine my surprise when she finally found a pair that "look cute" AND actually do something useful. We're making progress! She pulled them out of the box and was immediately happy with them. They look good, they fit well, and they're polarized. Then I noticed something. Here's What I Found... One of the lenses wasn't sitting quite right in the frame. I was able to pop it back into place, but unfortunately, it looks like it had been sitting that way in the packaging for long enough to leave a slight warp along the top of the lens. See the pictures for what I'm talking about. That's probably a quality-control issue that should have been caught before they left the factory. Other than that, though, they're actually pretty nice glasses. And the polarization is a big deal for us. My wife and I spend a lot of time outside, especially at the beach, and polarized lenses make a noticeable difference in bright sunlight. My wife can get headaches from the sun, so having properly polarized sunglasses is much more useful than simply having really dark lenses (or trendy cute ones). There's a difference between dark and actually cutting the glare, and these do the latter. Well, I'll Be... Maybe next time we see dolphins at the beach, she'll actually be able to see them. Usually the sequence goes something like this: "Look! Dolphins!" "Where?" "Right there!" "Where?! I can't see them!"* So I hand her my polarized sunglasses, she sees the dolphins, and I spend the next hour squinting into the sun with a headache. Marriage is all about sacrifice ya know. But apparently, it doesn't have to be that much sacrifice. My 2 Cents... Apart from the lens arriving slightly warped from the way it was sitting in the packaging, these are nice sunglasses. They're attractive, they fit well, and they're actually polarized—which, in my opinion, is far more important than simply having a dark lens. I do wish the quality-control department had caught the lens issue before shipping them. If it weren't for that, I'd have no complaints. My wife likes them, and I'm glad she finally found a pair that checks both boxes: They look cute AND they actually protect her eyes from the sun. Now if we could just get her to stop having to coordinate her sunglasses with her underwear, we'd really be making progress. On second thought... I wonder if I can get her to only match those.

reviews.title: Cute shape but flat lenses created strange reflections I couldn't handle
reviews.body: I really wanted to like these sunglasses. The shape is so cute and I like they way they look on me. In fact, I like the look so much that I kept wearing them long after I realized I had a problem with them. Here's the problem, the lenses are flat, which I don't think has ever been the case in sunglasses I've worn--they always have at least a little curve to them. I realized that the flat lenses create these odd reflections that just catch my eye in my peripheral vision on both sides and makes me think I'm seeing motion where there isn't anything. I finally stopped wearing them not only because they made me crazy but also because it wasn't safe for me to drive with them on.

title: Ray-Ban RB3025 Classic Aviator Sunglasses for Men for Women

reviews.title: The Real Deal
reviews.body: My Ray-Ban 3025 Aviator sunglasses arrived today, and I'm completely satisfied. What I received was undoubtably the REAL Ray-Ban product: packaged in a Ray-Ban box with sticker on the end including the 'Made in Italy' statement and including the Ray-Ban sunglasses case, a small 'manufacturer's information note' paper that is written in no less than 24 languages (!!!) - and I'm not joking (I counted). Plus a small marketing brochure 'The Icons' telling the story of Ray-Ban, and finally a lens cleaning cloth with the Ray-Ban logo. The sunglasses themselves have the Ray-Ban logo etched on the right lens prominently, and very subtly etched on the left lens. So, that's the package. It's as pictured here, and I start with that description because there is always going to be some trepidation at buying something like this online. Will you get The Real Deal, or a cheap knock-off? Well, I purchased mine from Amazon, not from a third-party seller, to reduce that risk, and I am not disappointed. Now to the sunglasses themselves. I think that there are a few things to know, for someone considering Ray-Ban sunglasses: - they come in a very wide variety of frame sizes, lens tints and colors, polarized and non-polarized, and with different frame colors and finishes. If you are not already familiar with these sunglasses and know what you want, then my recommendation is that you first go to the Ray-Ban website and familiarize yourself with those variations, especially if you think that you will want something other than the Traditional Gold Frame, Green Lens sunglass. Once at the Ray-Ban website, select 'customize' at the top, and you'll find yourself on a page where you have the full ability to vary the choices I've summarized below. These variations can all be found on Amazon although navigating through all of the sellers and product pages on Amazon that list the different variations of these sunglasses can be very time consuming and confusing. - For the 3025 Aviator style, the following variations are available: --- There are no less than 35 choices of lenses - 'classic', 'legends', 'gradient', 'mirrored and flash', and 'polarized' --- There are 8 variations in frame color - basic colors of gold and matte gold, and 'trendy' colors of black and 5 others --- There are 5 choices of temple tips (the end of the earpiece) - black or white as basic choices, and brown, beige or transparent also available --- There are a three different sizes available for the Ray-Ban Large Aviator RB3025. THIS IS IMPORTANT: ----------- 58 14 135: the basic standard size is 58 mm lens diameter, 14 mm bridge width, with temple length 135 mm ----------- 55 14 135: slightly smaller lens size, with same bridge width and temple length ----------- 62 14 140: larger lens size and temple length --- There are also further variations to the Aviator sunglass: ----------- Large Aviator II RB3026: only available as 62 14 140 ----------- Small Aviator RB3044: only available as 52 14 135 ----------- Folding Aviator RB3479: available in 55 14 140 and 58 14 145 ----------- Outdoorsman II RB3029 (includes 'brow bar' or 'sweat bar'): available in 62 14 140 ----------- Outdoorsman RB3030 (includes ''brow bar' or 'sweat bar' plus cable temples): available in 58 14 160 ----------- Outdoorsman II Rainbow RB3407 (with 'brow bar' in pink and possibly other color variations): available in 55 14 135 and 58 14 135 ----------- Outdoorsman II Craft RB3422Q (with 'brow bar' and temple pads in genuine hand stitched deer leather): available in 58 14 135 ----------- Shooter RB3138 (with 'brow bar' or 'sweat bar' and a small circle just below the brow bar. Also the lenses are placed closer together than other Aviator models): available in 58 09 135 - once you have figured out what you want, then the complexity is reduced and it's simply a matter of determining which seller is offering the best price. My own choice was to purchase from Amazon, not from a third-party seller, and I actually ordered two different pairs of sunglasses because I wanted to try both the polarized and non-polarized lenses, and the choices I found also had some variation in frame color that I thought would be worth checking out. I therefore purchased for myself, from Amazon, the following two pairs: - Ray-Ban Men's Aviator Large Metal Sunglasses, RB3025, 58mm, polarized lens, grey frame, 135 mm temple - Ray-Ban Men's Aviator Large Metal Non-Polarized Sunglasses, RB3025, 58mm, gold frame, 135 mm temple The quality of these sunglasses is apparent from the first moment when you remove them from the case. The frames are very high quality, and the gold frame in particular is finished to a high polish and looks absolutely fabulous. The gray frame is less distinctive but equally handsome. I haven't used them in the sunlight for long enough yet to be able to know the difference between the polarized and non-polarized lenses, but my expectation is that the polarized lenses will be my choice for the brightest days and outdoor use, particularly occasions such as on the water. Both glasses provide a good degree of sun protection without darkening my vision overmuch. And both provide the UV protection that my eye doctor told me to get. I think that some adjustment is going to be necessary, to the nose pieces as well as the temples, to get these to fit exactly right. I'll take them to one of the local optometrist shops and see if I can get them to help with that, so that they are adjusted correctly. Ray-Ban 3025 Aviator. I'm pleased with my choice.

reviews.title: These particular Ray Ban sunglasses are genuine, Italian maed, so are of great quality
reviews.body: I can't say for sure where other so-called Ray Ban sunglasses sold by Amazon are made, but I can assure you the RB3025 are genuine Ray Ban sunglasses made in Italy. Lexottica Group is the name of the company that makes genuine Ray Ban so watch for this clue in any description regarding Ray Ban products to avoid Chinese knock-offs. This world with Chinese garbage and Artificial Intelligence is getting more and more difficult to deal with. There is very little honesty left among humans. These particular glasses are of the highest quality materials available and fit perfectly right out of the box. If you need to and are capable of bending them slightly for additional adjustment, they are made strong enough to do so. Some of my previous Ray Ban sunglasses required slight adjustment, which I did without any difficulty. These glasses come in 3 width sizes. The size I chose is the "58", which is right in the middle. My face is apparently of average width for an adult male. My wife tells me I have an oval-shaped face. However, since Amazon offers free returns, it's possible to return your purchase for a larger or smaller size if you need to. The only loss to you will be time.

reviews.title: Fabulous!!! 58mm is perfect for women!
reviews.body: WOW. I am IN LOVE with these fabulous, classic Ray-Ban aviators, by far my favorite sunglass style. The reason I never owned a real pair is because the original size was too big for my female face and the juniors size was too small. Well, Ray-Ban finally made a middle size, 58mm, that’s absolutely perfect for a woman’s face. These are so incredibly flattering. The gunmetal frame with dark G15 lenses (they look black to people looking at you) gives these shades a very edgy, cool vibe. I wear black every day, so these are right up my alley. I really like the darkness and sun-blocking ability of the G15 lenses. I live in Arizona and have chronic migraines that can be triggered simply by exposure to bright sunlight. Having very dark sunglasses is a must for daytime driving, due to glare. These are super comfortable for all-day wear. The difference in quality is profound between these glasses, made in Italy, and the 6 pairs of $12 aviators in many colors that I bought on Amazon. There is no comparison, whatsoever. The country that made the $12 glasses is known for cheap products and it shows. Every thing I’ve ever purchased that was made it Italy is top notch & lasts forever. Most definitely, you get what you pay for. The lens quality and construction are superb. Invest in at least one pair of exceptional sunglasses. It’s worth it. You won’t be disappointed if you choose Ray-Ban. To fit my slender nose, I very gently adjusted the nose pieces, by bending them slightly inward. I also very gently curved the arms in a smidge so the glasses don’t move if I look straight down. Easy adjustments. Get these glasses! I got them on sale for about $125 yesterday & they’re $150 today. If you see them for $135 or less, grab them on the spot!

reviews.title: Great value for the price!
reviews.body: Not bad overall, can't complain with the low price. True polarized, and you are getting 3 identical glasses with different lens colors. Simple and straightforward. The glasses wrap around pretty nicely, and the nose piece and arms are fairly comfortable during long runs or fast intervals (haven't tried them with any sports yet). My main complaint is they sit too high and you can't adjust the nose piece up. So if it was just raised slightly, the glasses themselves would sit lower in your face. Maybe some people wouldn't like that if the bottom of the lens is touching their cheeks, but I have a very lean and long face so I would prefer them to sit lower. Plenty of protection and vision above and to the sides; there's a slight blond spot in the upper right corner where the lens is notched and you can notice it when wearing them. And once again the lower part of the lens doesn't cover enough...so on windy days, dust can still come through the sides and top. (I'm not saying sunglasses will have a perfect seal, but the gap is bigger than other sport glasses I've tried) Besides that, you really can't beat the price. Great for Spartans/Trail runs/ beach days/field sports, anything you want the overall protection, but also don't care of they get damaged cause you'll have 3 ans they're so cheap.

reviews.title: Yeah, this ain't it. Real review right here.
reviews.body: I wear Maui Jim's, Smiths, and Suncloud (also by Smith). I am used to high quality lenses, but I've always thought that "high quality" lenses were fairly common and easy to make, and I was just aa brand snob. These look exactly like Maui Jim's. I want a new style so... Ordered them. The fit: great. The wright: great. They feel durable. They feel comfortable. The style is great. The lenses: useless and I would honestly say no chance I'd wear these sunglasses. Literally zero chance. Why? 1. Put these on and look at a regular light bulb. Any light bulb at home. You'll see three images of that light bulb, one to the left which is faint, one to the right which is faint, and the bulb itself in the middle. Not joking. It's as if there is a "glare". This is because the lenses are not perfect thickness and magnification, and the lens coating are layered poorly (I am guessing here). Put on a pair of Maui Jim's (or other high end brand) and you'll see just one light bulb. I'm not making this up. Try it. This will affect everything you look at, brighter objects more. 2. Look at these glasses while wearing high end glasses. You'll see the polarization film -- especially around the bridge and arms. Now, look at the high end glasses through these. You wont see the polarization film (it's there, you just can't see it). High end lenses have much better and even polarization. The lenses on these glasses are simply too cheap, the flaws are really noticeable. I wish they were better, really do. I love this rimless style.

reviews.title: Excellent all rounder sunglasses.
reviews.body: I have had cataract surgery on both my eyes 4 weeks ago, after wearing glasses for 55 years. I can now see mid to long distances perfectly (reading glasses only required now)... Because I no longer need my prescription glasses I needed to get some new sunglasses, and, as I do a lot of bike riding, I thought I might as well get some that are multi-purpose. What I like about these glasses is the wrap around feature which blocks out the glare and wind, coming in from the sides. I also like that there is no gap over my nose, meaning I have a wider field of view. Also, the nose bridge is adjustable, meaning I can set each side up exactly to fit my nose. ***** The frame is also quite flexible too, as well as being extremely light (total weight is approx 26 grams) which is way less than my old glasses. There are also many colours available... And finally, the lens is fully polarised (i.e. turn them sideways, and it totally blacks out a computer monitor, confirming that they definitely polarised). IMO best sunglasses I've bought, EVER ! So good, I have bought a 2nd pair (Black on Black) 2 months after this original review.

For some people, they may like that so the glasses stay on, but it somewhat hurt my head while wearing these & driving. The size of the lenses themselves were also slightly too small vertically, so I could see out the bottom of the glasses and a little bit on the sides, which particularly could be annoying/dangerous if the sunlight hit the side of my eye while driving. I wish they made the legs less bent inwards and the lenses slightly bigger (or have another model that's slightly bigger lenses) and I would buy these.

reviews.title: Great value for the money
reviews.body: I usually don't spend a lot of money on sun glasses as they are typically lost or broken in a few a months. I live in Florida and had previous eye surgery so I'm always cautious about sun exposure and frequently wear eye protection. I previously purchased the Forster grant line, (which has similar pricing) but I believe that these have them beat. They are light, have polarization protection that really works against glare, UV, etc.. They also come with a great case for travel and an eye cloth. They clean up nice, seem to be rugged enough for the price range. Comfortable fit for me. I would be cautious of the size since it may not fit all faces. For me it worked well. While the plastic seems to be well built I would suspect that over time if I leave them in the car they will start deteriorate like many steering wheels and dashboards that are constantly exposed to sun and heat in Florida. But for the money, its well worth buying a few pairs. Bought the first one and then a second for my wife who also liked them. They look good and protect against wind abrasion. Haven't had them long enough to see how scratch resistant they are compared to others. However, they have a thick lens.

reviews.title: Not Dark Enough
reviews.body: I’m a nocturnal creature, always have been. Naturally I am up until dawn, and only rouse at dusk. Being that I do 12 hour night shifts, I really don’t have a need “flip” my schedule, and can exclusively live the vampire life. I don’t know if it is cause or effect, but I’ve always been photosensitive as well. As a child, I didn’t realize that it wasn’t normal to squint constantly on a sunny day. I ruin every photo from the flash. I even get light-triggered debilitating migraines. I NEED my sunglasses. So after losing my second pair of Ray-Bans, I couldn’t stomach the cost knowing that I have a tendency to set things down and walk away absent mindedly. Most likely I had dropped them in a parking lot from my purse or hoodie pocket, as I had done in numerous occasions, documented by the scrapes and scuffs on the lenses. It’s just not practical for me to splurge on the item I never prioritized when juggling keys, phone, and bag. My first lost ones were black and silver Clubmasters which I’ve had a hell of a time replacing in those classic colors, much less the polarized ones. I really missed how stylish they were. Then my classic Wayfarers disappeared. In scoping out to actually buy new Clubmasters, did I come across this package deal with both styles and super affordable. I wouldn’t feel shame about my treatment of sunglasses at this price point. When I received them I was super impressed. They were a little lighter weight, but overall seemingly sturdy and nice quality. Superb style, I wouldn’t be ashamed of not wearing designer. So I threw them in my bag to leave for work in the evening, to keep one in the car and save one for my purse. The next morning leaving work, it was nice and bright outside, and after a long shift, it is just the worst to be tired and blinded on a congested commute home. As soon as I hit the exit, I whip out my new glasses, and noticed I still had some eye strain, chalking it up to physical fatigue. Drive home, same thing. The next day I used the other glasses, and it again felt too bright. It only then occurred to me that these are not as dark as I was used to with my Ray Bans. I gave it a few more days, and realized these just don’t seem to make a difference for me. Feels like I’m wearing nothing at all. (Nothing at all, nothing at all…) Taking them on and off, I feel as if there is barely a difference, like they’re a placebo. I had focused so much on getting polarized, I forgot how the most crucial part of sunglasses is the darkening effect. They appear to be dark when you look at them, so it’s kind of an odd thing, and why it took me a day or so for it even to click with me with what was wrong. These are so weak, I feel like the polarized effect didn’t even do much for glare. I can even see clearly LCD displays that I couldn’t see previously even with other discount brands, so I’d say even this feature isn’t as good as it could be. Perhaps these may be useful in other sporting uses that people wear these glasses for, or could even be tinted enough for some, but absolutely not for me. If you’re truly dependent on eye protection and can’t leave the house without them like me, just keep looking.

title: Ray-Ban RB3025 Classic Polarized Aviator Sunglasses

reviews.title: The Real Deal
reviews.body: My Ray-Ban 3025 Aviator sunglasses arrived today, and I'm completely satisfied. What I received was undoubtably the REAL Ray-Ban product: packaged in a Ray-Ban box with sticker on the end including the 'Made in Italy' statement and including the Ray-Ban sunglasses case, a small 'manufacturer's information note' paper that is written in no less than 24 languages (!!!) - and I'm not joking (I counted). Plus a small marketing brochure 'The Icons' telling the story of Ray-Ban, and finally a lens cleaning cloth with the Ray-Ban logo. The sunglasses themselves have the Ray-Ban logo etched on the right lens prominently, and very subtly etched on the left lens. So, that's the package. It's as pictured here, and I start with that description because there is always going to be some trepidation at buying something like this online. Will you get The Real Deal, or a cheap knock-off? Well, I purchased mine from Amazon, not from a third-party seller, to reduce that risk, and I am not disappointed. Now to the sunglasses themselves. I think that there are a few things to know, for someone considering Ray-Ban sunglasses: - they come in a very wide variety of frame sizes, lens tints and colors, polarized and non-polarized, and with different frame colors and finishes. If you are not already familiar with these sunglasses and know what you want, then my recommendation is that you first go to the Ray-Ban website and familiarize yourself with those variations, especially if you think that you will want something other than the Traditional Gold Frame, Green Lens sunglass. Once at the Ray-Ban website, select 'customize' at the top, and you'll find yourself on a page where you have the full ability to vary the choices I've summarized below. These variations can all be found on Amazon although navigating through all of the sellers and product pages on Amazon that list the different variations of these sunglasses can be very time consuming and confusing. - For the 3025 Aviator style, the following variations are available: --- There are no less than 35 choices of lenses - 'classic', 'legends', 'gradient', 'mirrored and flash', and 'polarized' --- There are 8 variations in frame color - basic colors of gold and matte gold, and 'trendy' colors of black and 5 others --- There are 5 choices of temple tips (the end of the earpiece) - black or white as basic choices, and brown, beige or transparent also available --- There are a three different sizes available for the Ray-Ban Large Aviator RB3025. THIS IS IMPORTANT: ----------- 58 14 135: the basic standard size is 58 mm lens diameter, 14 mm bridge width, with temple length 135 mm ----------- 55 14 135: slightly smaller lens size, with same bridge width and temple length ----------- 62 14 140: larger lens size and temple length --- There are also further variations to the Aviator sunglass: ----------- Large Aviator II RB3026: only available as 62 14 140 ----------- Small Aviator RB3044: only available as 52 14 135 ----------- Folding Aviator RB3479: available in 55 14 140 and 58 14 145 ----------- Outdoorsman II RB3029 (includes 'brow bar' or 'sweat bar'): available in 62 14 140 ----------- Outdoorsman RB3030 (includes ''brow bar' or 'sweat bar' plus cable temples): available in 58 14 160 ----------- Outdoorsman II Rainbow RB3407 (with 'brow bar' in pink and possibly other color variations): available in 55 14 135 and 58 14 135 ----------- Outdoorsman II Craft RB3422Q (with 'brow bar' and temple pads in genuine hand stitched deer leather): available in 58 14 135 ----------- Shooter RB3138 (with 'brow bar' or 'sweat bar' and a small circle just below the brow bar. Also the lenses are placed closer together than other Aviator models): available in 58 09 135 - once you have figured out what you want, then the complexity is reduced and it's simply a matter of determining which seller is offering the best price. My own choice was to purchase from Amazon, not from a third-party seller, and I actually ordered two different pairs of sunglasses because I wanted to try both the polarized and non-polarized lenses, and the choices I found also had some variation in frame color that I thought would be worth checking out. I therefore purchased for myself, from Amazon, the following two pairs: - Ray-Ban Men's Aviator Large Metal Sunglasses, RB3025, 58mm, polarized lens, grey frame, 135 mm temple - Ray-Ban Men's Aviator Large Metal Non-Polarized Sunglasses, RB3025, 58mm, gold frame, 135 mm temple The quality of these sunglasses is apparent from the first moment when you remove them from the case. The frames are very high quality, and the gold frame in particular is finished to a high polish and looks absolutely fabulous. The gray frame is less distinctive but equally handsome. I haven't used them in the sunlight for long enough yet to be able to know the difference between the polarized and non-polarized lenses, but my expectation is that the polarized lenses will be my choice for the brightest days and outdoor use, particularly occasions such as on the water. Both glasses provide a good degree of sun protection without darkening my vision overmuch. And both provide the UV protection that my eye doctor told me to get. I think that some adjustment is going to be necessary, to the nose pieces as well as the temples, to get these to fit exactly right. I'll take them to one of the local optometrist shops and see if I can get them to help with that, so that they are adjusted correctly. Ray-Ban 3025 Aviator. I'm pleased with my choice.

reviews.title: Order somehow switched and still 10% doubt to the authenticity
reviews.body: I was very concerned about all the counterfit Ray Bans on amazon. I did alot of research on what to look for to spot the fakes. Even people who have said "if the glass is etched on the left lense they are authentic". Well the counterfitters will go to extreme lengths to make them look as real as possable. Nearly every detail is copied. So, after looking at different sellers, watching videos of real and fake glasses I searched for SunglassHut on Amazon. They are the brick and morter authorized sellers. I saved my order to my shopping cart from the Sunglasshut page on Amazon and they were $199.95. When I checked out I noticed it said "sold by and fullfilled by Amazon for $118. This made me a little worried. I wanted to pay the extra money to be sure they were authentic.Why the seller changed I have no idea. Now my review. I am still not 100 percent they are authentic but about 90 percent sure. All the research I have done and the fakes I have seen have all the same markings on the glasses and the case. The only thing the real ones have that the fake ones do not are that the ends of the plastic ear pieces curve a little bit. all the pictures and videos I have seen show the fakes with straight ear pieces at the very ends. The lenses are indeed polarized as you can tell from looking at different peoples rear windows of their cars in the sun. The glass has an invisable checkerboard pattern with the glasses on and it goes away with them off. The blue mirroring is nice and you cant see your eyes from other peoples perspective unless sunlight is coming in from the sides. The fit is good and I will go to my local Sunglasshut store to have them adjusted. Overall 4 stars because of placing in my cart from the sunglasshut page and then it being changed to sold and fullfilled through Amazon, and the fact I still have that 10% doubt they could be fakes.

title: Maui Jim Men's and Women's Stingray Polarized Wrap Sunglasses

reviews.title: 6 month update
reviews.body: I purchased these in July of 2014. I paid $189 for the black frame/netural gray Glass lenses. They have held up very well. No scratches, and the temple springs are as good as they were when new. I take good care of them, keeping them in their case when not in use, and clean them regularly using a bit of dish soap. I love the clarity and weight of the glass lenses, as they are superior to any of the composite lenses I've had a chance to compare them to, including their own brand's plastic lenses. (I spent some time in a Bass Pro Shop comparing these to Costas, Smiths, and Oakleys) These are my everyday casual and business wear glasses. These are great for driving; the polarization on these lenses is superior to Oakley in my opinion, and I love how well the polarizing lenses cut glare. These also work fantastic for cutting glare on watery surfaces like lakes and rivers, but honestly I am too fearful of losing these in the water to wear them near it! I would not wear these for any activity requiring a lot of movement, such as playing sports, since they are heavy, and because most of the weight is in the lenses, they are likely to fall off. During every day use though, these are secure enough that them falling off your head is a non-issue (unless you try to "store" them on the top of your head when not in use - DON'T do that!). My only grip with these is that after wearing them continuously for more than an hour, they do become a bit uncomfortable on the bridge of my nose.. taking them off for a brief period helps with any discomfort, but this is the sacrifice I'm willing to make to wear glass lenses. I will admit I keep a pair of Oakley flak jackets around for outdoor activities, and for times when I worry about scratching the lens (such as bumming on the beach). However, the quality of these are fantastic and I am glad I purchased them... I will buy another when the time comes. Couple of tips: - In my opinion, I would NOT suggest purchasing these glasses in a composite lens... the glass lenses are so much clearer. In my opinion, these frames are designed to hold a heavy glass lens in place. I would prefer to purchase a composite lens in a "frameless" or "semi-frameless" option to take advantage of the lighter weight of the composite lenses, and the ability to swap lenses on some brands of frames. - The shiny black frame, on the inside of the frame actually reflects light at some angles, and can be distracting. Wearing a hat eliminates this completely, but if you're looking for a frame that completely blocks the sun due to the way it wraps and fits your face, this probably isn't going to be sufficient.

reviews.title: Clarity and color perfect
reviews.body: After a visit to the eye doc it was presumed that my "fave" sunglasses may not be up to the protection job they might have had when new. I was told that many brands of glasses only lightly "coat" the lenses for UV protection especially the "plastic" lenses. Cheap glasses may not have any UV protection at all despite the claims...who tests them?? Nobody?? What apparently isn't told is that these coatings may/do deteriorate over time AND using alcohol lens cleaners and dish soaps may also remove coatings. My research indicated that the more expensive brands have higher quality and more durable UV coatings (impregnated or baked into the glass) that are important to protect your eyes from sun damage -- not just shading. Although my "Faves" were not inexpensive, they were 4 or 5 years old and apparently had inferior to perhaps zero UV blocking abilities today! Long story short, I researched the MJs and found that these glass lenses have superior harmful UV blocking. my Polycarbonate "faves" lenses...less so and were (only effective when new) likely "coated". I did a side by side comparison between these and my old "faves" and I was blowen away by the superior clarity and color crispness of these Maui Jim glasses. You only have one set of eyes...treat them with respect and invest in quality eye ware...not for fashion but, so you don't lose you vision acuity in later years when it's too late to undo damage. Suffice it to say....these are GREAT sunglasses and even look good...a bonus!!! My eyes deserve the investment. Yours do too!!

reviews.title: Stylish Protection and Clarity – Perfect for Outdoor Adventures!
reviews.body: I’ve been using the Maui Jim Stingray Polarized Wrap Sunglasses for a few years now, and I’m seriously impressed. Right off the bat, the polarization is excellent—there’s no glare, even in bright sunlight, which has been a game-changer for me, especially while driving and out on the water. The clarity of the lenses is top-notch. Everything looks sharper, with a slight boost in color contrast that makes my surroundings pop without feeling unnatural. The wraparound design offers great coverage, protecting my eyes from light coming in at the sides, which is something I hadn’t realized I needed until I started using these. They’re also very lightweight and comfortable to wear for long periods. I’ve worn them on hikes and while driving long distances, and they never felt heavy or like they were pressing into my temples. One thing I appreciate is the build quality—it feels premium. The frame is durable without being bulky, and the hinges are smooth. Plus, they look great! I’ve gotten compliments on the sleek design more than once. The only downside I’ve noticed is that the price might feel steep for some, but given the durability, protection, and how comfortable they are, I think they’re totally worth it. This is actually my 4th pair as I have always appreciated the quality of Maui Jim and see this as an investment. If you’re outdoors a lot or need high-quality sunglasses for everyday use, I’d highly recommend the Maui Jim Stingray.

reviews.title: Great Sunglasses!! Cardboard case is Junk!
reviews.body: I recently purchased my 3rd pair of Maui Jim’s. Love how they fit and the clarity of the lens, especially when driving. Very disappointed in Maui Jim’s decision to downgrade from the quality protective case to the cheap cardboard “sunglass case” that was sent. The previous pairs I have purchased both came with very solid cases. The first pair came with a hard case that had strong hinges that snapped closed and kept my sunglasses safe and I never worried about it coming open on its on and my sunglasses being damaged. My second pair came with a case that had zipper closure with a latching hook at one end. I was able to attach the case for easy access. Great case that made it easy to grab my sunglasses from my bag or off a belt loop always providing a safe place to keep my sunglasses whenever I took them off. That sunglass case was even shown in a photo on the Maui Jim website when I was scrolling through the photos and specifications for the Stingrays I purchased from their website. I thought my sunglasses would be shipped inside that case as the previous pair. I was happy when my sunglasses arrived but very disappointed in the folded cardboard “case” that came with them. I don’t feel confident at all tossing it into my bag as I was accustomed to doing with the two previous cases that my Maui Jim’s arrived in. Cutting corners over there?? Why not just tack on an extra $10 to the purchase price and keep your customers happy and our purchases better protected?
reviews.body_en: I recently purchased my 3rd pair of Maui Jim’s. Love how they fit and the clarity of the lens, especially when driving. Very disappointed in Maui Jim’s decision to downgrade from the quality protective case to the cheap cardboard “sunglass case” that was sent. The previous pairs I have purchased both came with very solid cases. The first pair came with a hard case that had strong hinges that snapped closed and kept my sunglasses safe and I never worried about it coming open on its on and my sunglasses being damaged. My second pair came with a case that had zipper closure with a latching hook at one end. I was able to attach the case for easy access. Great case that made it easy to grab my sunglasses from my bag or off a belt loop always providing a safe place to keep my sunglasses whenever I took them off. That sunglass case was even shown in a photo on the Maui Jim website when I was scrolling through the photos and specifications for the Stingrays I purchased from their website. I thought my sunglasses would be shipped inside that case as the previous pair. I was happy when my sunglasses arrived but very disappointed in the folded cardboard “case” that came with them. I don’t feel confident at all tossing it into my bag as I was accustomed to doing with the two previous cases that my Maui Jim’s arrived in. Cutting corners over there?? Why not just tack on an extra $10 to the purchase price and keep your customers happy and our purchases better protected?

reviews.title: you’re not just paying for functionality — you’re upgrading the quality of what you create.
reviews.body: A couple weekends ago I decided to finally film some progress clips of my aquascape and DIY projects, but every handheld video looked shaky and amateur. I grabbed this Liphisy 64″ Tripod with the remote and phone holder, and suddenly my clips looked way more polished — like I actually intended them to look that good. 📸 Story: From Shaky Hands to Steady Shots The first time I set it up, I clumsily bumped it while trying to angle the phone for a timelapse. Instead of toppling over like my old mini tripod usually did, this one stayed planted, and I just laughed — because that little bit of stability made such a difference in every shot I took after. 📏 Sturdy & Adjustable The height range up to 64 inches is genuinely useful — whether I’m standing tall for overhead shots or crouching down for detail work, the tripod adjusts smoothly. The legs feel solid and stable, even when fully extended, and it holds heavier phones or small cameras without wobbling. 📐 Multi-Angle Flexibility It’s easy to tilt and rotate the phone mount to whatever angle I need. I’ve used it for vertical videos, landscape framing, and even side-angled product shots — all without feeling like I was fighting the setup. 📱 Remote & Phone Holder The included remote control is a small but actually handy addition. I can start/stop recording or take photos without rushing back to tap the screen. The phone holder grips the device securely — no slipping or awkward readjustments in the middle of a shot. 🛠 Build & Ease of Use Assembly was intuitive — nothing confusing about the knobs or height settings. It feels durable yet lightweight, so I don’t mind moving it from room to room or bringing it outside for midday shots. 🎥 Everyday & Creative Use Whether I’m filming lessons, timelapses of tanks, cooking clips, or just group photos with friends, this tripod adapts well. It makes videos look way more intentional than anything I’ve done handheld. 💰 Value for Money For a tripod that reaches a full 64″, includes a remote, and works with both phones and lightweight cameras, this feels like good value. You’re not just paying for functionality — you’re upgrading the quality of what you create.

The base has non-slip silicone pads that do a good job of preventing the stand from moving on a desk surface when using the touch screen of the phone. Similarly, the upper part of the phone bracket has two silicon pads to stabilize the phone. When using my phone while charging, the cord can be passed through the back of the stand to keep it out of the way. The bracket piece that holds the phone is the proper height for placing the phone in either the vertical or horizontal position. Finally, the stand folds flat for storage in a backpack or a small bag. In summary, this product is a winner.

reviews.title: Works for my Galaxy S25 phone
reviews.body: I used to have trouble remembering where my cell phone was in the house because I'd lay it down flat and then papers or other things would get laid on top of it and I couldn't find it again. Also, it can be difficult to see the screen when it's laying flat on a table and there's light from above you. This stand solved both of those problems. I liked it so much I bought two more of them so I can have one in the bedroom, one next to my computer and one on our dining table. It's adjustable so I use it with the holder part of it more vertical than the photo on Amazon, so it holds my phone at a better angle for viewing and is not as easy to tip backward. There is a hole in the back of the stand part of it for a charger cord but I don't use that. Even with the holder part having an open area for the cord to attach to the phone, the cord has to make a tight bend to get plugged in and it would eventually ruin the cord. I charge it with the cord coming from the front or side of the holder.

reviews.title: Great for the price, not super stable
reviews.body: Super easy to put together, well constructed, and cute! The rose gold/pink color is a light pastel pink. The rubber grips on the base and on the actual holder help the stand to stay in place, and keep devices from sliding. For less than $10, it’s definitely worth the purchase. I also like that I can use it for my phone and my iPad, and works as a backup to hold/display my switch while not in use. Very versatile! I can also see myself using it to prop up notes for school, maybe a light textbook. CONS: If you have the stand extended all the way up (or at all) and are tapping on your device, the device and the whole stand shakes, which is annoying. So if you plan on using it to stream it’s not a big deal, but it makes it difficult if you’re planning to touch the device for any reason (like to press pause), and in this sense isn’t very study. I will not be using my iPad on it while it’s extended, as the stand falls this way, but if it’s not extended it’s more sturdy. If you don’t have it extended, it will still shake when tapped but not too bad. If you’re using a phone on it to FaceTime, the rubber holder blocks the mic and you’ll need to adjust it every now and then (which is kind of disappointing because I mainly purchased this to make it easier to FaceTime a loved one who’s far away). If you use a pop socket, you’ll need to remove it before using this stand or the phone slides off. Overall though, for less than $10, it’s an excellent stand. This is also a great gift idea.
